cases.title: Analog Collage Brand Poster Template
cases.prompt:
[BRAND NAME]

Act as a Collage Art Director and Editorial Photographer creating an analog-aesthetic campaign poster where physical collage elements, fabric swatches, printed photographs, and the hero product are layered together on a neutral background — mimicking a designer's mood board or a zine editorial spread. The entire composition is driven by [BRAND NAME]'s real brand identity, real campaign narrative, and real product. References: Bitis Hunter sustainability campaign, Supreme zine aesthetics, Palace Skateboards collage editorials, analog fashion mood boards, cut-and-paste magazine collage tradition.

---

PHASE 0: BRAND INTELLIGENCE — AUTONOMOUS EXTRACTION

Perform a complete brand decode of [BRAND NAME] from training data before generating anything.

COLOR PALETTE: identify the exact primary and accent colors from [BRAND NAME]'s official brand guidelines. These colors appear in: the fabric swatches, the brand label/tag element, the typography at the bottom. Identify the specific colors [BRAND NAME] uses across their products and campaign materials.

TYPOGRAPHY CHARACTER: identify [BRAND NAME]'s typographic style — the typeface character used in campaign materials and on product labels. Identify if the brand uses handwritten, brush, stamp, or clean sans-serif type for campaign headlines. Identify the typeface used for the brand name lockup at the bottom.

BRAND NARRATIVE: identify the most current or most resonant real campaign message or brand value of [BRAND NAME] — sustainability, innovation, cultural heritage, community, performance, or other. Extract a real campaign slogan or brand statement that can be used as the poster headline. This message must be authentic to [BRAND NAME]'s documented brand story.

HERO PRODUCT: identify the most iconic or most current signature product of [BRAND NAME] — the single product most associated with the brand's identity. This product is the physical hero of the collage, placed at the bottom of the composition breaking out of the collage layer.

BRAND WORLD: identify the visual world and cultural community [BRAND NAME] belongs to — streetwear, sport, luxury, outdoor, music, youth culture. All photographic elements in the collage must authentically belong to this world.

---

PHASE 1: BACKGROUND

A large sheet of warm off-white or light warm grey paper — #F2F0EB to #E8E5DF range. Matte, slightly textured — like heavy bond paper or thin cardstock. The texture is subtle — visible as a very fine grain at close inspection, smooth at normal viewing distance. The paper fills the entire frame edge to edge. Very slight natural vignette at the extreme corners only — as if the paper is lit from above by a diffused overhead light. No gradient. No dramatic lighting. The background is a neutral stage for the collage elements above.

---

PHASE 2: COLLAGE LAYER SYSTEM — CRITICAL

The collage is built from multiple physical-feeling layers stacked on top of each other. Each layer element has physical properties — real paper edges, real shadows, real depth. The layers are arranged in a loose organic cluster occupying the upper 65 to 70% of the poster. The cluster is centered horizontally, slightly irregular — not a perfect symmetrical arrangement. The elements overlap each other at varying angles: no element is perfectly horizontal or vertical — everything is rotated between 3 and 15° in either direction, giving the arrangement its casual hand-placed quality.

LAYER ELEMENT 1 — LARGE BACKGROUND PHOTO: the largest photograph in the collage, positioned as the base layer. A full-color lifestyle or editorial photograph relevant to [BRAND NAME]'s brand world — a person, a scene, an environment that is authentically part of the brand's visual universe. This photo has slightly torn or roughly cut edges — the paper tears are irregular and organic, not perfectly straight. Very slight curl at one or two corners. The photo has a thin white border like a printed snapshot or developed film print.

LAYER ELEMENT 2 — MEDIUM PORTRAIT PHOTO: a second photograph, smaller than Element 1, overlapping it at a slight angle. This photo shows a person relevant to [BRAND NAME]'s culture — a figure wearing or using [BRAND NAME] products, in a context authentic to the brand world. Same torn/cut edge treatment. Positioned to overlap the large background photo in the center-left zone.

LAYER ELEMENT 3 — SMALL DETAIL PHOTO: a third photograph, the smallest of the three, cropped tightly on a detail — a close-up of hands, feet wearing the product, a texture, a material, or an environmental detail. Positioned in the right zone of the collage cluster, slightly rotated clockwise.

LAYER ELEMENT 4 — FABRIC SWATCHES: 2 to 3 small pieces of fabric in [BRAND NAME]'s brand colors — cut irregularly, slightly frayed edges, one corner slightly folded. These are placed around the edges of the photo cluster — one upper left, one right side, possibly one partially tucked under a photo. Colors match [BRAND NAME]'s documented palette exactly.

LAYER ELEMENT 5 — BRAND TAG OR LABEL: a physical woven or printed brand label — the kind sewn into garments. Rectangular, slightly at an angle, placed along the left or bottom edge of the photo cluster. The label shows [BRAND NAME]'s name or logo in the brand's documented typographic style. Slightly worn, authentic to the brand's product language.

LAYER ELEMENT 6 — TEXTURE FRAGMENT: a small piece of mesh, gauze, or other material relevant to [BRAND NAME]'s product materials — partially transparent, slightly crumpled, tucked behind or between photo layers.

All layer elements cast soft drop shadows onto the layer beneath them — 2 to 4mm shadow offset, very soft edge, 15 to 25% opacity. These shadows confirm the physical depth of each layer and make the collage feel real.

---

PHASE 3: HERO PRODUCT BREAKOUT — CRITICAL

The hero product identified in PHASE 0 is placed at the bottom of the composition, partially overlapping the lower edge of the collage cluster. The product exists in a different spatial layer than the collage — it is more sharply lit, more precisely rendered, more physically present than the layered photos above. It appears to physically rest on or emerge from the collage, as if placed on a real surface. Product lighting: soft directional light from upper left — creates subtle shadow beneath the product on the background paper surface. This shadow confirms the product is sitting on the paper, not floating. Product presentation: the product is shown at a natural viewing angle — slightly elevated, 3/4 view, or from the side — whichever best shows the product's design and [BRAND NAME] branding. The product partially covers the bottom portion of the photo collage above — this overlap confirms the product is the closest element to the viewer in terms of depth.

---

PHASE 4: BOTTOM TYPOGRAPHY ZONE

The lower 25 to 30% of the poster below the hero product is the typography and brand information zone. This zone sits on the plain paper background — clean, no collage elements.

Headline element: a real [BRAND NAME] campaign statement or brand value message from PHASE 0. Typography style: matches [BRAND NAME]'s documented campaign type character — handwritten brush style if the brand uses that register, stamp style if appropriate, or bold sans if the brand is more clean. Color: [BRAND NAME]'s primary accent color. The text is slightly imperfect — consistent with the analog handmade aesthetic of the overall poster.

Stamp or certification element: a small rectangular or circular stamp-like graphic element — a border with rounded corners, a small icon or logo mark inside, positioned to the left of or above the headline. This element references [BRAND NAME]'s brand certification, sustainability mark, or campaign badge — authentic to the brand's documented visual language.

Repeating micro-text line: a single short phrase — [BRAND NAME]'s tagline, campaign hashtag, or product descriptor — repeated horizontally in very small type, creating a text rule or pattern below the headline. Very small, tracked out, [BRAND NAME]'s accent color at 60% opacity.

Body copy: 1 to 2 sentences of real [BRAND NAME] campaign copy — authentic to the brand's voice and message. Small regular weight type, dark neutral color, left-aligned.

Brand name lockup: [BRAND NAME]'s official wordmark or brand name set in the correct brandbook typeface, positioned at the bottom center or bottom right. This is the final anchor of the composition.

---

PHASE 5: LIGHTING

The entire scene is lit as a flat-lay — single large diffused overhead light source. Even illumination across the background paper. The only lighting variation comes from: the soft drop shadows beneath each collage layer element (confirming physical depth), the slightly stronger soft shadow beneath the hero product (confirming it sits on the paper surface), very subtle ambient shadow at the extreme corners of the paper background. No dramatic lighting. No colored light. No flash. The lighting is documentary and neutral — designed to show the collage elements clearly without overpowering them.

---

PHASE 6: COMPOSITION

Aspect ratio: 2:3 portrait — consistent with poster and social media portrait format. The collage cluster occupies the upper 60 to 65% of the total frame. The hero product bridges the collage and typography zones — its upper portion overlaps the bottom of the collage, its lower portion sits above the typography zone. The typography zone occupies the lower 25 to 30%. The composition has a clear top-to-bottom reading: collage cluster → hero product → campaign message → brand name.

---

PHASE 7: TECH SPECS

Render: photorealistic CGI or real photography-level output. Collage layer shadows: physically accurate soft drop shadows from each element. Paper texture: real surface displacement on background. Torn photo edges: real irregular geometry — not a filter or texture map. Fabric swatches: real cloth material with fiber detail and frayed edges. Product render: product photography quality — clean, sharp, accurate to real [BRAND NAME] product. Typography: crisp, anti-aliased. Color palette: exactly [BRAND NAME]'s documented colors from PHASE 0. No film grain unless brand-authentic. Output feel: this poster is published in a print magazine, used as an outdoor campaign poster, or posted on [BRAND NAME]'s official social media as a campaign announcement.

cases.title: Luxury City Stamp Poster Template
cases.prompt:
Design a premium 4:5 collectible postal-stamp poster for [CITY], where the entire composition is one monumental luxury postage stamp filling the frame edge-to-edge like a rare national artifact. The stamp should dominate the canvas with oversized tactile perforation edges, elegant engraved borders, and immersive object-focused composition.

The artwork should capture the city’s true atmosphere through architecture, skyline rhythm, transportation, landscape, cultural motifs, climate, geometry, and environmental identity - interpreted in elegant graphic forms rather than cliché tourist postcards.

The composition should feel dynamic and asymmetric. One dominant city element should rise diagonally through the stamp while secondary forms flow around it to create depth and movement. Preserve intentional negative space for a refined premium feel. Avoid clutter and over-detailed realism.

Typography is a major part of the design. The city name “[CITY]” must appear massive and integrated directly into the stamp artwork like a luxury masthead, partially interacting with the illustration through masking, overlap, or depth. Typography style should adapt naturally to the city’s personality — refined serif for historic cities, sleek modern grotesk for futuristic cities, softer flowing forms for coastal or tropical cities, expressive handcrafted lettering for artistic cities.

Keep all secondary typography minimal and authentic: tiny denomination number, AIR MAIL / POST text, issue year, serial numbers, microscopic postal marks, engraved information strip, and subtle cancellation details integrated into the borders without cluttering the composition.

Lighting should feel like premium collectible print photography: soft directional highlights revealing tactile matte paper grain, embossed ink edges, subtle print pressure, delicate shadow depth around perforation cuts, and refined ink density. No dramatic cinematic lighting.

Color palette must intelligently adapt to the city while remaining restrained, elegant, and atmospheric:
• coastal → turquoise, coral, faded cream
• desert → terracotta, saffron, dusty pink
• neon megacity → cobalt, magenta, deep navy
• historic → olive, parchment, burgundy
• tropical → emerald, mango, sea blue
• snowy northern → icy blue, muted pine, silver gray

Final result should feel like an ultra-rare commemorative stamp sold in a luxury museum design store — sophisticated, tactile, immersive, collectible, and timeless.

Negative: generic travel posters, floating landmarks, souvenir aesthetics, busy collages, excessive typography, fake vintage distress, stock vector icons, random gradients, low-detail illustration, centered layouts, generic stamp mockups, noisy textures, over-rendered realism.

【最重要ルール】
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

別絵柄化禁止。
リアル化禁止。
3D化禁止。
AI特有の別人化禁止。
顔立ち改変禁止。

メイクは、
「元からそのキャラクターがしていた」
ように自然に統合。

キャラクター本人だと一目で分かる状態を維持。

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【タイトル生成ルール】
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

タイトルは毎回完全新規生成。

毎回オリジナルタイトルを生成。

・「重力反抗型ドールフェイス」
など。

毎回違う雑誌特集のように。

【メイク設計】
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

・顔立ち
・瞳色
・目の形
・髪色
・髪質
・肌色
・骨格印象
・服装
・世界観
・性格性
・感情
・配色
を分析。

その結果から、
最も魅力を引き出す専用メイクを設計。

重要：
キャラクター本人に、
実際に完成後メイクを施した状態で描写する。

メイクは自然に馴染ませる。

例えば：
・瞳色と連動したアイシャドウ
・髪色と調和するチーク
・性格性と一致するリップ質感
・世界観に合うラメ粒子
・服装とリンクした彩度

など。

過剰加工ではなく、
“キャラクター性を増幅する”
方向でメイクする。

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

画面内に配置される全てのコスメと、
キャラクターに施された完成メイクの

・艶感

・粉感

コスメは装飾ではなく、

・透明感ベース

など。

未来的・幻想的・透明感ある、

完全架空ネーミング。

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

cases.title: Photorealistic Brand Hero Website Template
cases.prompt:
[BRAND NAME] | [HEADLINE = user text or AUTO] | [SUBHEADLINE = user text or AUTO] | [BUTTON TEXT = user text or AUTO] | [COLOR = your color or AUTO]

Act as a Senior Web Art Director and CGI Artist creating a photorealistic hero section of a premium brand website — a single wide-format image showing the full above-the-fold view of a hero webpage. The composition combines a dramatic 3D sculptural logo object with editorial typography and minimal UI elements. References: Stökt agency website, Apple product launch pages, high-end creative agency hero sections, Awwwards-winning website design.

---

PHASE 0: BRAND INTELLIGENCE — AUTONOMOUS EXTRACTION

Perform a complete brand decode of [BRAND NAME] from training data before generating anything. Every visual decision in the image is derived from this phase.

COLOR SYSTEM — PRIMARY COLOR DETERMINATION: if [COLOR] is provided by the user — use that exact color as the primary driver for the entire image color system. Do not override it with brand colors. If [COLOR] is AUTO — identify the exact primary brand color of [BRAND NAME] from their official guidelines — the single most iconic, most documented color associated with the brand. In both cases: this one color drives the entire image's color system — background gradient, 3D object material, atmospheric lighting, all derived from this single color.

BACKGROUND GRADIENT DERIVATION: from the determined primary color derive exactly two gradient stops. Inner stop: the most saturated vivid version of the primary color at full intensity — this is the atmospheric glow behind the object. Outer stop: the darkest possible version of the same hue — near black but with a visible trace of the color's hue remaining (#0A to #12 lightness range). Both stops are derived exclusively from the primary color. No neutral black. No grey. The darkness has color in it — it is a very dark tinted black, not a neutral one. Examples: red primary → inner #CC0000, outer #1A0000. Green primary → inner #1DB954, outer #001A0A. Blue primary → inner #0057FF, outer #00060F. Orange primary → inner #FF6600, outer #1A0500.

3D OBJECT MATERIAL DERIVATION: from the primary color derive the metal material — base/shadow color: the darkest near-black version of the color hue (same as gradient outer stop). Highlight color: the most vivid saturated version of the color (same as gradient inner stop), appearing on edges and high points facing the light source. Mid-tone: a medium value of the color on surfaces at 45° to the light. The entire metal object is one color family — dark in shadow, vivid and bright in highlight, all derived from the same hue. No neutral grey metal. No silver. The metal has the brand or user color in its DNA.

TYPOGRAPHY: identify [BRAND NAME]'s official typeface character — the visual weight, width, and style used in their brand communications. Apply consistently to all text elements.

BRAND SYMBOL: identify the single most iconic reduced form of [BRAND NAME]'s logo — the symbol, monogram, or letterform most recognizable as the brand. This becomes the 3D sculptural object. If [BRAND NAME] has no standalone symbol — use the first letter of the wordmark as the 3D form.

BRAND LANGUAGE: if [HEADLINE] is AUTO — extract the most powerful real brand statement or campaign headline associated with [BRAND NAME]. If [SUBHEADLINE] is AUTO — extract a real brand descriptor sentence describing what [BRAND NAME] does or stands for. If [BUTTON TEXT] is AUTO — identify the primary CTA phrase [BRAND NAME] uses in their marketing. If any variable has user-provided text — use that exact text, do not override it.

FOUNDING INFORMATION: extract [BRAND NAME]'s founding year for the bottom corner attribution.

---

PHASE 1: BACKGROUND

Full-bleed background filling the entire image. A radial gradient emanating from the center-right zone where the 3D object sits — not a flat color, not a linear gradient, a circular atmospheric glow. Inner zone: the saturated vivid color derived in PHASE 0 — deep, rich, atmospheric, occupying approximately 40 to 50% of the total background area. Outer zone: the very dark tinted black derived in PHASE 0 — envelops the composition at all edges. The transition is soft and organic — a gradual atmospheric fade, not a hard edge. The gradient creates the sensation of a warm spotlight behind and to the right of the 3D object — as if the object itself is the source of this atmospheric light.

---

PHASE 2: 3D LOGO SCULPTURE — HERO ELEMENT

The brand symbol from PHASE 0 rendered as a massive three-dimensional sculptural object. Occupies the right 55 to 65% of total image width — monumental, partially cropped by the right and bottom frame edges. The cropping is deliberate — we see most but not all of the object, implying it extends beyond the frame. Rotated approximately 20 to 35° on the vertical axis and 10 to 20° on the horizontal axis — a dynamic three-quarter view revealing multiple faces simultaneously. Camera angle: 5 to 10° below center — adds imposing low-angle presence.

MATERIAL SYSTEM — DERIVED FROM PRIMARY COLOR: the object is premium dark brushed metal. All material colors derived exclusively from the primary color as determined in PHASE 0. Base/shadow color: very dark near-black color-tinted metal on faces away from the light. Brushed texture: fine parallel directional micro-scratches on each face following the face geometry — industrial brushed metal quality. Highlight zones: faces angled toward the primary light source catch the vivid saturated color as warm bright highlights — ranging from mid-tone color to near-white at absolute specular peaks. Edge highlights: every sharp edge of the object catches a thin continuous bright specular line tracing the full logo geometry — this edge glow defines the form against the background. The contrast between near-black shadowed faces and bright vivid-colored highlighted edges is the defining visual characteristic. Scale feel: monumental — as if 3 to 5 meters tall in physical space.

---

PHASE 3: NAVIGATION BAR

Minimal navbar at the very top — height approximately 4 to 5% of total image height. Background: very dark semi-transparent — the tinted dark color from PHASE 0 at 85 to 90% opacity. Left: [BRAND NAME] wordmark or logomark in correct official form, small white type. Center: 4 to 6 navigation categories in small all-caps tracked white type — autonomously determine relevant categories based on [BRAND NAME]'s business. Right: language switcher pill and primary CTA button — dark background, light border, small caps "[BUTTON TEXT]" with right arrow →. All navbar elements small, precise, minimal — do not compete with hero elements.

---

PHASE 4: TEXT BLOCK — LEFT SIDE

Positioned in the left 35 to 40% of the image, vertically centered, left-aligned with appropriate margin. The left side is in the darker zone of the background gradient — white text is fully legible without additional treatment.

Label line: small bracketed label above the headline — "{ WE ARE [BRAND NAME] } →" or brand-appropriate equivalent. Very small type, white, tracked out, thin weight.

Headline: [HEADLINE] — set in [BRAND NAME]'s typographic character, bold, uppercase or sentence case per brand convention. Large — approximately 8 to 10% of total image height per line. White. Two to three lines maximum. Left-aligned.

Body copy: [SUBHEADLINE] — one to two sentences, small regular weight, white at 70 to 80% opacity. Below headline with appropriate spacing. Maximum 35 to 40 characters per line.

CTA buttons: two side-by-side buttons. Primary: dark fill, white border, white text "[BUTTON TEXT]" with right arrow →. Secondary: outline only, white border, white text with secondary action autonomously determined from [BRAND NAME]'s context. Both buttons small and minimal — slightly rounded rectangle, small caps type.

---

PHASE 5: BOTTOM ELEMENTS

Bottom left: "Scroll for more ↓" in very small white type — 2 to 3% of image height, subtle.

Bottom right: "Est. in [FOUNDING YEAR]" in very small white type — founding year from PHASE 0, same scale.

---

PHASE 6: LIGHTING

Single primary light source: warm dramatic light positioned behind and to the upper right of the 3D object. Light color: the vivid saturated primary color from PHASE 0 — it is the color expressed as atmospheric light, consistent with the gradient inner stop. This light creates both the background radial glow and the warm highlights on the metal object — they are the same light, the same color, the same source. Secondary ambient: very subtle cool ambient from directly above — 5% intensity, barely lifts the absolute darkest shadow zones. No fill lights. No rim lights. The dramatic contrast between lit and unlit faces is intentional and must be preserved.

---

PHASE 7: COMPOSITION

Aspect ratio: 16:9 landscape — website hero section proportions. Left 35 to 40%: text zone (darker background, UI elements). Right 60 to 65%: 3D sculpture zone (object dominates). Text block and object do not overlap — clear spatial separation. Reading direction: text left → sculpture right.

---

PHASE 8: TECH SPECS

Render: Octane Render or Redshift — physically accurate brushed metal with correct anisotropic highlight behavior. All material colors derived from the primary color as determined in PHASE 0 — no neutral greys, no off-color elements anywhere in the image. If [COLOR] was user-provided — that color overrides any brand color in all material and lighting calculations. Ray tracing: on — for accurate edge highlights and metal inter-reflections. Background gradient: physically accurate radial atmospheric light — real volumetric light contribution, not a composited gradient overlay. Typography: crisp, anti-aliased, flat white — zero shadows, zero blur, zero effects. UI elements: clean flat design, no drop shadows, no gradients on UI elements. Color palette: exclusively the color system derived in PHASE 0 plus white for text — no additional colors introduced anywhere. Sampling: minimum 2048 samples. Anti-aliasing: maximum. Output feel: the actual above-the-fold screenshot of [BRAND NAME]'s relaunched premium website — Awwwards front page quality.

cases.prompt:
请生成一张高完成度的「中文主导餐饮商业美食海报」。

品类:[主题品类]
主标题:[中文主标题]
副标题:[英文辅助副标题](可选,小字辅助)
主视觉食物:[主视觉食物]
食材标注:[食材标注](4-6个,中文为主)
底部卖点:[底部卖点文案](4条,中文短句)

整体要求:
这是一张面向中国大陆市场的高质感餐饮商业海报,不是普通摆拍,不是菜单截图,不是低质电商图。整张图必须以中文信息为主,英文仅作为辅助点缀,所有文字尽量清晰、可读、真实,不要乱码,不要伪英文,不要无意义占位文字。

画面顶部放一个非常醒目的中文主标题,字体要大、厚重、有视觉冲击力,适合餐饮海报,可带一点毛笔刷写感、手写感或粗犷质感。主标题下方可配一行较小的英文副标题,用来辅助说明品类或风味。

画面中间必须有一个足够饱满、立体、诱人、具有强烈食欲感的主视觉食物主体。主视觉应占据画面核心区域,份量感强,食材外露明显,层次丰富,细节清晰,具有真实商业美食摄影质感。食物要看起来"刚做好、热腾腾、很值、很好吃",可以带
有轻微热气、酱汁光泽、肉类纹理、蔬菜水润感、芝士拉丝感、汤面热气感等真实细节。

主体周围可搭配少量相关辅助食材与小道具,如酱汁碗、香草、辣椒、柠檬、芝麻、蔬菜碎、小料、筷子、木板、餐盘等,用来增强氛围,但不能喧宾夺主。整体背景建议采用深色木桌、炭黑、深棕、暖暗调环境,以衬托食物主体更突出。

在主视觉周围加入4-6个精致的中文食材标注,使用细线连接对应食材或部位。标注框要简洁清晰,像高级餐饮海报里的说明标签,不要太像工业图纸。

底部设计一排4个卖点信息模块,每个模块包含一个简洁图标和一条中文卖点短句。整体看起来像高完成度餐饮品牌海报、菜单主视觉图或电商详情页头图,兼具商业感、品牌感、传播感。

视觉风格:
真实商业美食摄影 + 海报设计感,暗调高质感,暖光布光,强食欲感,高清细节,层次鲜明,色彩浓郁但不脏,画面清晰,主体突出,构图完整,整体高级、诱人、有冲击力。

版式结构:
上方为大标题区,
中间为主视觉食物区,
周围为食材标注区,
底部为卖点信息区。

cases.title: Chinese Retro Food Emblem Logo
cases.prompt:
请根据用户输入的【品牌名 / 项目名】【副标题 / 产品名】【类型 / 行业】【地域风味】【品牌定位】【核心关键词】【核心图形】【核心食物 / 品类元素】【情绪气质】【主色调】【辅助色】【画幅比例】，设计一个高完成度的「国潮复古餐饮徽章 Logo / Chinese Retro Food Emblem Logo」。

【用户输入】
品牌名 / 项目名：[品牌名 / 项目名]
副标题 / 产品名：[副标题 / 产品名]
类型 / 行业：[类型 / 行业]
地域风味：[港式 / 粤式 / 湘味 / 川味 / 炭火 / 夜宵 / 茶餐厅 / 烧味 / 海鲜 / 小酒馆等]
品牌定位：[品牌定位]
核心关键词：[复古、国潮、招牌感、老字号感、烟火气、江湖感、新消费感等]
核心图形：[龙 / 凤 / 鹤 / 虎 / 牛 / 蛙 / 鹅 / 鱼 / 龙虾 / 器具 / 图腾 / 吉祥纹样等]
核心食物 / 品类元素：[烧鹅 / 烧烤 / 茶饮 / 龙虾 / 面食 / 牛肉 / 冰室 / 酒馆等]
情绪气质：[热闹、霸气、复古、经典、地方感、烟火气、江湖感、年轻化等]
主色调：[主色调]
辅助色：[辅助色]
画幅比例：[画幅比例]

【核心目标】
这次要设计的是一个真正可用于餐饮品牌的「国潮复古餐饮徽章 Logo」。它不是普通海报，也不是简单卡通插画，更不是只写几个字。请以中文主字标为核心，融合强识别图形、餐饮品类符号、复古中英文排版和完整徽章式结构，打造一个具有门头感、包装感、品牌系统感和传播感的餐饮 Logo。

最终结果应让人一眼感受到：
1. 这是一个餐饮品牌；
2. 它有明确品类和个性；
3. 它像一个成熟的品牌主标，而不是一张装饰性图案。

【设计本质】
这类 Logo 的核心不是单一图形或单一字体，而是以下五层整合：
1. 中文主字标：负责品牌识别；
2. 图形符号：负责记忆点与品类联想；
3. 徽章结构：负责整体完整性；
4. 中英文排版：负责层次感与复古品牌氛围；
5. 颜色系统：负责强化餐饮调性和品类情绪。

【最重要的原则】
1. 中文品牌名必须醒目、清楚、具有招牌感；
2. Logo 必须是一个完整标识，而不是零散元素拼贴；
3. 图形必须与品牌名或品类相关，不能为了装饰而装饰；
4. 英文为辅助，中文为主，英文不能喧宾夺主；
5. 整体必须有餐饮品牌属性，适合门头、菜单、包装和社媒头像；
6. 画面必须有复古感，但不能老气、脏乱或失去现代品牌完成度；
7. 必须有“国潮复古餐饮徽章”的味道，而不是美式卡通或日式商铺字标。

【中文主字标要求】
1. 中文品牌名为绝对主角；
2. 字体要有复古餐饮招牌感、老包装感或国潮标题感；
3. 可以厚重、粗壮、有黑体 / 宋黑 / 商业手写感；
4. 可以做适度变体，但必须清晰可读；
5. 不要极简细字体，不要弱，不要像普通系统字；
6. 需具备门头感和品牌标识感。

【图形系统要求】
请根据【核心图形】与【品类元素】设计一个与品牌高度相关的主图形。
可选方向包括：
- 动物 / 神兽：龙、凤、虎、牛、鹅、鱼、蛙、鹤等；
- 食材 / 菜品：龙虾、烧鹅、牛肉、面碗、火焰、茶杯等；
- 传统图腾：章印、纹样、牌匾、吉祥图案；
- 器具 / 场景符号：烤架、火焰、碗筷、冰室元素等。

图形要求：
1. 要有记忆点；
2. 要与品类和名字有明确关系；
3. 不要做得太复杂写实；
4. 要适合与字标整合为徽章；
5. 可以偏复古插画、版画感、老商标感、国潮线描感。

【徽章结构要求】
请把整体设计成一个完整的“餐饮品牌徽章 Logo”，而不是简单横排。
结构可参考以下方式：
1. 上方英文拱形 + 中央图形 + 下方中文主字标；
2. 中央大图形 + 左右小标签 + 下方副标题；
3. 圆章 / 椭圆章 / 牌匾式构图；
4. 中心主图 + 上下分层文字；
5. 对称排版 + 小图章 + 小圆标系统；
6. 老招牌 / 老商标 / 包装主标式版式。

【中英文排版要求】
1. 中文为主，英文为辅；
2. 英文可用于拱形主标题、品类名、店型说明、口号、年份、ESTD 等；
3. 英文参与构图，增强复古商标感；
4. 英文不需要过多，但要精致、清晰、服务整体结构；
5. 可以使用如：
   - HOUSE
   - TAVERN
   - BARBECUE
   - ROAST GOOSE
   - TEA RESTAURANT
   - LOBSTER HOUSE
   - ESTD / SINCE / CLASSIC / SPECIALTY
6. 不要让英文压过中文，也不要变成纯英文品牌。

【辅助元素要求】
可以加入少量增强品牌系统感的小元素，例如：
- ESTD 年份
- 小圆章
- 小图标
- 小标签
- 小印章
- 地域说明
- 品类说明
- 横线 / 点阵 / 小边框
- slogan 小字

但必须克制，不能把画面做成复杂海报。

【色彩要求】
请根据品牌品类选择更合适的国潮复古餐饮色彩系统，例如：
1. 黑 + 红：烧烤、卤味、烧味、小酒馆；
2. 黑 + 金 / 棕金：老字号、熟食、烧鹅、粤式餐饮；
3. 绿 + 红 + 米白：港式冰室、茶餐厅；
4. 蓝 + 红 + 白：海鲜、龙虾、年轻夜宵餐饮；
5. 黑 + 蓝：更年轻、更理性一点的夜宵或酒馆；
6. 红 + 米白：老长沙粉面、传统小吃等。

要求：
- 色彩有餐饮招牌感；
- 颜色不宜过多，2~4 个主色最稳；
- 高饱和点缀可以增强吸睛度，但必须控制统一性。

【画面呈现要求】
1. 这是独立 Logo 展示图，不是菜单海报；
2. 背景简洁，建议浅灰白、米白、纸白或纯净浅底；
3. Logo 主体完整、清晰、居中；
4. 结构完整、信息有层次；
5. 整体看起来像一个成熟餐饮品牌的主 Logo 提案。

【风格关键词】

画面需要有一个清晰的核心主体：[主体物]，主体带有柔软真实的质感，可以是食物、物件、植物、人物配件或任何符合主题的核心符号。主体放在画面中心偏下，比例较大，像一个承载情绪的小舞台。

cases.title: Restaurant Standee AI Image Prompt Template
cases.imageAlt: Restaurant Standee AI Image Prompt Template
cases.prompt:
请生成一张高完成度的「餐饮异形展架 / 立牌」设计图，用于展示餐饮门店的新品推荐、招牌产品、套餐促销或品牌活动信息。

【基础信息】
品牌名：[品牌名]
主标题：[主标题]
副标题：[副标题]
辅助短句：[短句1]｜[短句2]｜[短句3]
主题方向：[主题方向，例如：爆辣夜市风 / 金黄浓郁风 / 清新轻食风 / 山野自然风 / 甜品下午茶风 / 快餐促销风]
主色调：[主色调]
辅助色：[辅助色]
点缀色：[点缀色]
画幅比例：[建议 3:4 竖版]

【产品内容】
主推产品：[主推产品]
辅助产品1：[辅助产品1]
辅助产品2：[辅助产品2]
辅助产品3：[辅助产品3]
辅助产品4：[辅助产品4]
加料 / 配角产品：[加料或配角产品，例如：饮品 / 小食 / 配菜 / 酱料 / 甜品]

【卖点标签】
[卖点1]
[卖点2]
[卖点3]
[卖点4]
[卖点5]
[卖点6]

【促销信息】
[促销信息1]
[促销信息2]
[促销信息3]

【最重要要求】
这不是门店场景效果图，也不是海报贴在墙上的展示图。
请直接生成“一张完整的异形立牌成品展示图”：
- 背景必须为纯白色
- 画面中只保留一个完整的异形餐饮立牌主体
- 不要餐厅环境
- 不要商场背景
- 不要玻璃门、桌椅、墙面、人物、地面透视场景
- 不要任何真实空间背景
- 立牌主体必须完整显示
- 异形轮廓必须完整清晰
- 底座必须完整露出
- 整体像一张已经抠好的门店物料成品图 / 设计提案展示图 / 电商展示图

【画面形式】
这是一张“门店异形展架 / 立牌”的完整设计，不是普通矩形海报。
整体应采用明显的“不规则异形裁切轮廓”，有完整外边缘，边缘可带白色或浅色描边，具有真实门店物料感。
立牌应有明确底座，整体像可落地摆放的 KT 板 / 泡沫板 / 亚克力 / 写真喷绘展架成品。

【构图结构】
整体采用竖版、中心聚焦、信息分层清楚的结构：

1. 顶部区域：
放超大主标题，标题必须醒目、有冲击力、有餐饮 POP 招贴感。
字体可以厚重、手写感、招贴感、潮流感，但要清晰易读。
标题是整张图的第一视觉焦点。

2. 中部核心区域：
中间放最大主推产品，作为主视觉主体。
主菜必须最大、最饱满、最诱人，突出食欲感。
围绕主菜搭配 2~5 个辅助产品，形成丰富的产品组合，前后层次明确，主次分明。

3. 周边信息区域：
在主菜和辅助产品四周加入少量标签元素、推荐标、贴纸框、手写箭头、卖点说明、小标题、小气泡标签等，使其具有“餐饮门店促销物料”的视觉特征。
但要控制层级，做到“热闹但不乱”。

4. 底部促销区域：
底部放价格信息、套餐信息、活动信息或新品尝鲜信息。
价格数字要相对突出，易读清晰。
如果没有特别要求，默认不要二维码。

【视觉风格要求】
整体风格应属于“餐饮转化型视觉 + 门店 POP 异形立牌”：
- 强调食欲感
- 强调信息可读性
- 强调商业落地感
- 强调门店物料感
- 强调异形轮廓感

不是极简杂志海报，也不是电商详情页，也不是纯平面插画海报。

【食物表现要求】
所有食物必须采用真实商业美食摄影质感：
- 食物清晰真实
- 有食材颗粒感
- 有酱汁、汤汁、油光、热气、层次感
- 有丰富细节，如葱花、辣椒、芝士、香草、蔬菜、水果、虾仁、肉块等
- 主食要饱满，不能扁平
- 看起来必须“能激发食欲”
禁止过度插画化、卡通化、低质拼贴化。

【版式与信息层级】
整张立牌的阅读顺序应为：
主标题 → 主推产品 → 辅助产品 → 卖点标签 → 价格 / 活动信息

信息量可以较丰富，但必须有明确层级：
- 主标题最大
- 主菜次大
- 辅助菜稍小
- 卖点标签较小
- 底部促销清晰醒目

【适配范围】
该模板需要适用于不同主题餐饮内容，例如：
- 面 / 饭 / 粉 / 小吃
- 火锅 / 菌汤 / 地方菜
- 轻食 / 沙拉 / 咖啡简餐
- 早餐 / 套餐 / 快餐
- 茶饮 / 甜品 / 下午茶
- 节日促销 / 新品上市 / 爆品推荐 / 双人套餐

【输出要求】
请输出一张高清、清晰、商业完成度高的异形立牌设计图，满足以下条件：
- 白色背景
- 完整异形轮廓
- 完整底座
- 只展示立牌本体
- 不带真实场景环境
- 不带人物
- 不带门店背景
- 默认不带二维码
- 适合用于系列案例展示、设计提案、社交媒体发布、模板复用

cases.title: Camel Wildlife Infographic Handbook Page
cases.prompt:
Create a premium square “reference-style wildlife infographic” centered around the camel, designed as a beautifully curated desert-survival handbook page rather than a basic educational poster.

The composition should feel like a modern visual encyclopedia mixed with an elite zoology field guide and high-end editorial infographic system.

Visual Direction:

• 1:1 square composition
• Warm desert-inspired background with subtle sand textures, faded expedition-map overlays, and natural-history sketch aesthetics
• Elegant earthy palette using sand beige, camel brown, warm ivory, dark mocha, bronze, and muted desert-gold accents
• Refined editorial typography hierarchy with natural-history aesthetics
• Rounded modular information cards with clean spacing
• Gentle realistic shadows and premium museum-style dividers
• Minimal scientific wildlife iconography
• Extremely detailed central camel render viewed in dramatic three-quarter perspective in a realistic desert environment during golden-hour lighting
• Thin precision annotation lines pointing toward anatomical survival adaptations
• Clean, organized “knowledge-first” layout with high information density but breathable spacing

Main Subject Presentation:

A stunning ultra-detailed realistic render of a camel placed at the center, featuring realistic fur textures, desert lighting, anatomical accuracy, expressive eyes, weathered skin detail, muscular legs, detailed hump structure, and premium wildlife-documentary realism.

Surround the camel with scientific callouts and magnified detail circles explaining:

• hump fat-storage system
• water-conservation adaptations
• broad desert feet structure
• long eyelashes and sand protection
• nostril-closing mechanism
• heat-resistance biology
• digestive system adaptations
• skeletal endurance structure
• desert locomotion efficiency
• behavioral survival traits

Include modular infographic sections such as:

• Camel Overview
• Scientific Classification
• Desert Survival Adaptations
• Anatomy Highlights
• Water Conservation System
• Diet & Digestion
• Life & Behavior
• Uses of Camels in Human Civilization
• Camel vs Horse Comparison
• Foot Structure & Desert Mobility
• Camel Milk & Nutritional Value
• Baby Camel Development
• Geographic Distribution Map
• “Did You Know?” Facts Section
• Conservation & Environmental Importance

Add small premium visualization modules like:

• anatomical skeletal diagrams
• desert habitat maps
• digestive-system illustrations
• camel footprint closeups
• water-retention workflow graphics
• heat-resistance visual charts
• survival adaptation callouts
• species comparison tables
• desert caravan silhouettes
• biological cross-section illustrations

Style Keywords:

“premium zoology encyclopedia”
“editorial desert wildlife handbook”
“museum-quality camel reference page”
“scientific animal infographic”
“high-end natural-history poster”
“modular wildlife knowledge system”
“ultra-detailed desert animal visualization”
“luxury biology editorial design”

Avoid:

• cartoon camel aesthetics
• overly colorful tourist-poster looks
• cluttered infographic layouts
• fantasy desert creatures
• unrealistic anatomy
• exaggerated cinematic action scenes

The final result should resemble a professionally published natural-history reference-book page created for wildlife enthusiasts, zoologists, museums, biology institutions, desert researchers, and educational archives.

cases.title: Fresh Fruit E-commerce Brand Proposal
cases.prompt:
请根据以下设定，创作一套高完成度、具有统一视觉系统的「原创鲜果电商品牌商品化提案 / 4-Board Fresh Fruit Brand Commercialization Proposal」。

注意：这不是四宫格，也不是把4张内容合成在一张图里，而是同一个品牌系统下的4张独立图片，需要依次分别生成。每次只生成当前这一张，并自动延续前面已经建立好的品牌视觉DNA，直到4张全部完成。画幅比例统一为竖版 3:4。

【品牌设定】
品牌名：枝上初红
英文辅助名：FIRST RED ON THE BRANCH
品牌类型：高端鲜杨梅电商品牌 / 夏日鲜果品牌 / 轻礼赠鲜果品牌
一句话定位：把山里的第一口夏天，送到你手里。
核心关键词：杨梅季、当季现摘、产地直发、冷链保鲜、酸甜爆汁、山野感、夏日果礼、电商商品化
目标人群：城市家庭、年轻白领、注重品质和时令感的消费者、轻礼赠用户、电商水果消费人群
整体风格：夏日鲜果电商美学 × 高级写实商品摄影 × 轻果礼品牌提案
主色：杨梅深红、鲜果红紫
辅助色：叶片绿、奶白、冰白、浅灰蓝
点缀色：露珠银灰、少量微金属浅金
视觉元素：杨梅果粒纹理、枝叶、果梗、山形线描、晨露、水滴、冰感、果园气息、冷链保鲜符号、夏日清爽氛围
品牌口号：把山里的第一口夏天，送到你手里。

【IP设定】
需要轻IP，不要只有Logo。IP名为「枝枝灵 / ZHI ZHI SPIRIT」。
它不是大眼睛卡通杨梅人，而是一个克制、可爱、轻拟人化的品牌果灵识别物，可以表现为小徽章、小吊牌、小挂件、小贴纸、小印章、小摆件或包装守护灵。它应有杨梅、叶片、枝头的气质，轻可爱但不低幼，不廉价，不喧宾夺主，应自然融入品牌系统与商品系统中。

【产品线 / SKU】
1. 尝鲜装：250g
2. 轻享装：500g
3. 家庭装：1kg
4. 精选礼盒装：2kg
5. 高端果礼装：精品礼盒版
配套内容：果盒内托、吸水垫、冰袋、冷链保温袋、快递外箱、手提礼袋、品牌卡片、果园介绍卡、食用建议卡、封签、贴纸、吊牌、等级标签

【整体要求】
1. 四张图必须明显属于同一个品牌系统，品牌名、色彩、字体气质、图形语言、IP形象、包装逻辑、商品调性全部统一。
2. 不是普通水果海报，也不是廉价促销图，而是一套可销售、可传播、可复用的鲜果电商品牌系统提案。
3. 画面必须非常写实，要有真实鲜果质感、真实包装材质感、真实商品摄影感、真实冷链与电商场景感。
4. 文字尽量准确，品牌名“枝上初红”、英文“FIRST RED ON THE BRANCH”、IP名“枝枝灵”尽量清晰正确，不要乱码，不要大段无意义小字。
5. IP要存在，但要轻，不要低幼卡通，不要像儿童零食包装。
6. 整体要通透、清亮、新鲜、有果汁感、有夏日感，同时具备品牌提案感和商业感。

【第1张：品牌主视觉封面图 / Brand Hero Board】
这张图负责定调，是第一视觉记忆点。
重点展示：
- 品牌名“枝上初红”
- 英文辅助名“FIRST RED ON THE BRANCH”
- 品牌口号
- 高端鲜杨梅主包装或礼盒主视觉
- 饱满、新鲜、深红、带颗粒、带露珠的真实杨梅特写
- 枝叶、果梗、山野清晨、微雾、水滴等氛围元素
- 轻IP“枝枝灵”以徽章、吊牌、小摆件或品牌识别物的方式出现
- 核心卖点：当季现摘、产地直发、冷链保鲜、酸甜爆汁
要求：更偏封面图 / Hero Image，而不是说明书；有种草感、新鲜感、高级感和第一眼食欲感。

【第2张：品牌识别与IP系统图 / Identity & IP System Board】
这张图负责解释品牌视觉系统和IP语言如何构成。
重点展示：
- 品牌字标 / Logo
- 品牌配色系统
- 杨梅果粒纹理、枝叶、果梗、山形线描、水滴、冰感图形等辅助视觉语言
- 轻IP“枝枝灵”系统：IP形象、小徽章、小挂件、贴纸、吊牌、印章、封签、简化图标
- 规格标签系统
- 甜度 / 果径 / 新鲜度 / 冷链图标系统
- 小型应用系统：标签、贴纸、封签、吊牌、卡片
要求：像高端品牌识别提案板，但不要僵硬，不要低幼；模块清晰，信息完整，有设计感和统一性。

【第3张：商品与包装系统图 / Product & Packaging System Board】
这张图负责展示品牌如何落到真实商品与包装系统上。
重点展示：
- 250g、500g、1kg、2kg、精品果礼装的商品矩阵
- 鲜果包装盒、礼盒、内托、吸水垫、冰袋、保温袋、手提礼袋、冷链外箱
- 品牌卡片、果园介绍卡、食用建议卡
- 封签、标签、吊牌、等级贴
- 鲜果近景、果径分级或品质表达
- 轻IP“枝枝灵”自然融入包装系统
要求：像真实可以上架销售的鲜果电商品牌商品系统，不要只摆一堆盒子；要看得出规格层级、包装逻辑和品牌统一性。

【第4张：电商传播与销售场景图 / Campaign & Sales Scenario Board】
这张图负责展示品牌进入真实电商与传播场景后的效果。
重点展示：
- 手机端电商首页 / 商品详情页主视觉
- 社交媒体种草图 / feed 风格传播图
- 开箱场景：打开鲜果盒，看到杨梅、冰袋、卡片等
- 冷链配送场景：外箱、配送、到家开箱
- 送礼场景 / 家庭分享场景 / 夏日下午茶场景
- 可选门店快闪 / 柜台 / 展示台小场景
- 品牌色、包装、IP符号、商品系统在不同场景中保持统一
要求：比第3张更强调真实销售与传播场景，不是简单包装展示，而是完整电商链路和品牌应用效果。

【负面要求】
不要四宫格，不要把4张图拼在一张里。
不要廉价水果促销海报感。
不要低质电商模板感。
不要拼贴素材感。
不要过度传统土特产感。
不要把IP做成大眼睛卡通杨梅人。
不要幼稚、低龄、廉价。
不要虚假的CG摆拍感。
不要照搬任何现成品牌或已有IP。

【执行方式】
请先统一“枝上初红”的品牌视觉DNA，再按顺序生成：
第1张：品牌主视觉封面图
第2张：品牌识别与IP系统图
第3张：商品与包装系统图
第4张：电商传播与销售场景图
每次只生成当前这一张独立图片，并自动延续前面已经建立好的品牌系统，直到4张全部完成。

The entire scene glows with warm golden lighting, deep shadows, and richly textured paper layers that enhance the handcrafted diorama effect. At the very bottom center, mounted on a stylized carved wooden plaque, the title “A SPIRITUAL JOURNEY OF HAJJ” is elegantly displayed in a refined serif font. The surrounding frame incorporates intricate Islamic arabesque carvings and suspended lanterns, unifying the holy atmosphere and bringing the sacred pilgrimage experience to life through the depth and artistry of layered paper craftsmanship.

围绕具体主题内容生成一张竖向结构视觉作品，让主题核心先被压缩成暗色骨架、负形空洞和局部识别边缘，再从大面积主题场域内部显影；主体不完整站在背景前，而像被透明介质包裹、遮挡、折射后只留下必要的质量、方向和边缘。画面建立一个高明度、低噪声的主场，主场承担空间、记忆和信息呼吸的功能，必须直接切过主体边缘，使轮廓出现轻微断续、弯折、漂浮和被吞没的感觉。主视觉沿一条强轴线展开，中部形成最密的识别核心，下部或边缘被画幅裁断，保留画外延展感；对象细节被删减为少量断片、轮廓方向、结构空洞和暗色质量块，让主题由边缘取舍成立。背景不是装饰纹理，而是由主题自身推导出的可见介质层，带有尺度不同的场域扰动、透明覆盖、表面折射和低噪声痕迹；这些扰动应跨过主体、文字和空白，让整张图像像隔着一层湿润透明表面被观看。色彩保持大面积高明度主色、少量低明度结构色、透明轻高光和极小高能注记的比例关系，主题变化只改变色温、明度倾向和语义来源，不改变场域大、结构重、注记小、过渡轻的层级。暗色结构集中承担主体、细线和标签的重量，轻色高光只停留在介质弧线、边缘过渡和表面反射处，不能与主体争夺层级。必要文字采用克制的技术感无衬线，字形清楚、尺度小、宽字距，像坐标、年份、索引、边界或标签贴近信息轴；文字与图像同层，被场域轻微压住，形成横向测量感和低声说明感。只在一个关键小信息节点放入极小面积的高能色轨迹或圈注，让它成为冷静画面中的精确记忆点，面积必须被严格控制，像一次标记而不是一套装饰。整体完成度像平面印刷被透明湿润表面重新观看，保留轻微扫描颗粒、细折痕、青白高光和被介质软化的暗色边缘。画面应清楚、克制、潮湿、图形化，以强轴线、低细节主体、场域吞没、微型信息和单点注记构成同一套视觉系统，使不同主题都像被同一位设计者压入同一种场域逻辑中。

cases.title: Cyberpunk Anime Fashion Illustration Template
cases.prompt: I’m uploading a character/PFP reference image. Your task is to completely reimagine this character in the style of a high-end cyberpunk anime fashion illustration similar to a luxury Japanese streetwear poster. The uploaded image is BOTH the identity reference and the clothing/fashion inspiration reference. Preserve the core facial identity, recognizable hairstyle, facial proportions, silhouette, personality, anime identity, and overall fashion energy of the original character. The new outfit must feel directly inspired by the uploaded character’s original clothing design, including the jacket shape, layered styling, color palette, Japanese streetwear influence, rebellious anime aesthetic, silhouette language, graphic placement style, and overall fashion attitude. Do not copy the outfit 1:1, do not create unrelated futuristic clothing, and do not replace the fashion with generic techwear. Instead, create an elevated luxury-editorial reinterpretation of the original outfit that feels fashionable first and cyberpunk second. The outfit should feel like a premium futuristic redesign by an elite Japanese fashion concept artist, featuring designer-inspired construction, luxury fabric layering, futuristic tailoring, elegant straps and hardware, subtle cyberpunk detailing, and premium sneaker aesthetics while remaining unmistakably connected to the uploaded character’s original fit. The image should feel clean, minimal, cinematic, stylish, expensive, fashion-forward, and highly polished. Prioritize simplicity, negative space, elegant color blocking, strong silhouette readability, premium composition, and soft painterly rendering. The rendering style should be painterly anime illustration with semi-realistic anime rendering, soft cel-shaded hybrid shading, subtle brush textures, atmospheric gradients, smooth ambient shading, minimal linework, elegant edge control, and polished anime poster quality. Use soft gradient shadows, colored shadows instead of black, atmospheric bounce lighting, subtle reflected light, soft contact shadows, and diffused studio lighting. The character must be shown full body from head to toe, standing naturally in a relaxed fashion-editorial pose, facing toward the camera with subtle eye contact, centered in frame with relaxed posture and luxury campaign energy. Do not generate a side profile, action pose, combat pose, anime attack pose, cropped body, waist-up framing, exaggerated motion, or extreme perspective distortion. Use an eye-level camera angle with full-body fashion photography framing, minimalist editorial composition, balanced negative space, clean silhouette readability, and poster-like symmetry. The composition should feature a minimalist background with a dominant magenta, pink, or red flat-color backdrop, subtle gradients, soft shadows behind the character, simple graphic design elements, and a subtle circular graphic shape behind the subject. Avoid detailed cityscapes, cluttered cyberpunk environments, tactical armor aesthetics, and heavy sci-fi machinery. Use a controlled color palette of hot pinks, magentas, soft cream whites, coral gradients, dusty rose shadows, muted warm skin tones, and subtle mauve shading with vaporwave-inspired harmony. The final image should feel like a premium anime fashion campaign illustration created by a top-tier AAA concept artist for a luxury Japanese streetwear brand while remaining unmistakably connected to the uploaded character’s original outfit and identity. Aspect ratio 3:4.

主体构图与透视（核心真实感）

画面以五档尼卡形态路飞为绝对唯一主视觉，大面积占满画面。胸部以上半身肖像，人眼平视镜头，近距离怼脸近景透视。人物右手笔直伸向镜头前景，手掌因近大远小透视自然放大，形成极强画面纵深感、视觉压迫感、破屏张力，动作自然写实，无僵硬AI摆拍感。人物姿态松弛且充满力量感，动态呼吸感十足。

人物真实细节（去二次元、极致真人CG写实）

人体解剖结构100%精准真实，肩颈、胸腔、手臂肌肉线条流畅自然，肌肉起伏符合人体发力逻辑，不夸张不畸形。皮肤为真实人类肌肤质感：细腻毛孔、淡淡皮肤绒毛、清晰自然的皮下血管纹路、轻微肌肤肌理、真实肤色通透感，无磨皮、无塑料感、无光滑假皮。

面部五官立体深邃，比例真实协调，尼卡形态标志性锐利眼神，瞳孔光影通透、眼神坚定霸气，情绪张力饱满。发丝根根分明、蓬松有层次、光影贴合头发生长结构，自然飘逸不僵硬。

服饰面料极致写实：尼卡形态标志性纯白+鎏金服装，布料纹理、针织肌理、轻微褶皱、垂坠感真实自然，金边描边质感立体，金属磨蚀、微光鎏金真实材质，面料光影过渡细腻，无平涂色块、无廉价贴图感。

光影氛围（电影棚拍真实质感）

专业影视棚布光：主光柔和塑形，强对比冷暖双光勾勒，人物边缘高亮轮廓光，分离主体与背景；细腻体积光、空气微尘光束、浅景深虚化效果。明暗层次高级，暗部不死黑、亮部不过曝，光影贴合人体结构，立体厚重、真实高级。

画面视觉文案与科技UI排版

画面左侧竖排超大艺术字：GEAR 5 / NIKA，字体硬朗粗粝，自带复古印刷做旧质感：自然斑驳墨迹、不规则细微划痕、锋利切割边缘、复古海报颗粒磨损纹理，立体浮雕质感，不突兀、贴合整体影视调性。

文字下方搭配极简科技风角色档案UI面板，包含：专属ID编号、人物基础资料、战斗数值参数、条码标识、细微警告小字、极简伪科技数据文本，排版规整高级，赛博军事档案风格，极简不杂乱，点缀画面层次。

整体色调与氛围

以尼卡形态标志性纯白、暖金、淡暖黄为主色调，搭配低饱和深阴影对比，色调干净通透、高级治愈又充满战力压迫感，整体风格：超写实真人CG、暗黑轻奢、热血高级、电影海报质感。

严格规避（防AI瑕疵）

杜绝畸形手脚、错误透视、错乱解剖、模糊纹理、油画糊感、二次元塑料感、过度锐化、色彩脏污、文字乱码、UI错位、画面空洞、光影虚假、面部崩坏、对称僵硬、模板感。

Create the artwork specifically for an iPhone lock screen wallpaper (1290×2796 vertical composition). Design around the lock screen UI. Leave the upper 25–30% of the image intentionally clean with minimal visual detail to provide negative space for the clock, date, widgets, and notifications. POSE:

cases.imageAlt: New Chinese Summer Sweet Soup Branding
cases.prompt:
请根据以下品牌信息，创作一套高完成度、具有统一视觉系统的「4张品牌视觉提案」。

注意：
这不是一张四宫格拼图，也不是把4张内容合并在同一个画面里的总图，而是一套需要“依次分别生成”的4张独立图片。请在同一个品牌视觉系统下，连续完成这4张图的生成。4张图必须明显属于同一个品牌，但每一张图承担不同职责，不能只是4张重复变体。

【品牌信息】
品牌名：清甜小馆
英文辅助名：QINGTIAN SWEETS
品牌类型：新中式夏日清润糖水品牌 / 年轻化东方甜品品牌
一句话定位：把夏日清润糖水，做成年轻人更愿意吃、愿意拍、愿意分享的新中式甜品品牌。
Slogan：夏天这一碗，清甜刚刚好。

核心关键词：
新中式、夏日清润、东方轻甜、冰镇糖水、轻养感、器皿美学、通透感、真材实料、夜晚来一碗、年轻化

目标人群：
18–35岁年轻人，喜欢轻养甜品、夏夜宵夜、拍照打卡、精致外卖和新中式生活方式的人群。

整体风格方向：
清润、通透、东方、克制、有留白感、有器皿美感、有食材层次感。不是传统老派糖水铺，也不是网红奶茶店，而是年轻化的新中式糖水品牌。

主色调：
米白、莲子白、椰奶白、竹青绿、藕粉色、琥珀金

辅助色：
浅茶棕、青灰、淡杏色

点缀色：
少量芒果黄、西柚橙、西瓜红，仅用于个别产品提亮

辅助图形：
水波纹、碗形轮廓、小印章、中式小签条、竹叶/荷叶简化图形、云纹/回纹极简变体、食材 icon（桃胶、银耳、莲子、绿豆、仙草、芋圆、椰奶、芒果）

器皿风格：
白瓷碗、青瓷碗、玻璃碗、小盖碗、透明外带杯、木托盘、白瓷勺、小木勺

核心产品：
1. 椰香清补凉
2. 桃胶银耳露
3. 绿豆百合冰糖水
4. 杨枝甘露
5. 莲子银耳羹
6. 芋圆仙草糖水

【统一要求】
1. 四张图必须属于同一个品牌系统，品牌名、配色、字体气质、辅助图形、器皿逻辑、产品逻辑保持统一。
2. 所有图片统一采用竖版 4:5，适合社交媒体展示和品牌提案展示。
3. 每张图独立生成，不要四宫格，不要拼成一张总图。
4. 整体要有高完成度、信息量足够、设计感强、品牌提案感强，不要太简陋，不要太空。
5. 不要太古风，不要太老字号，不要太像奶茶品牌。要突出新中式、夏日清润、年轻化、糖水器皿感。
6. 画面中的中文标题要清晰，英文字样仅作辅助，版式要有设计感。
7. 产品必须看起来真实可口，食材清晰，糖水通透，器皿精致。
8. 4张图依次生成：第1张 → 第2张 → 第3张 → 第4张。

【第1张图】
IMAGE 1｜SUMMER SWEET SOUP HERO BOARD / 夏夜清润主视觉

任务：
生成整套提案的封面图。第一眼就让人感受到：新中式、夏日、清润、舒服、年轻化、糖水品牌。

画面结构：
- 顶部：品牌名“清甜小馆”、英文辅助名“QINGTIAN SWEETS”、slogan“夏天这一碗，清甜刚刚好。”，以及“新中式夏日清润糖水品牌”等小标签
- 中部：以一碗“椰香清补凉”为核心主视觉，使用青瓷碗或玻璃碗，放在木托盘上，碗中清晰看到椰奶底、芋圆、绿豆、椰果、杂豆、少量水果粒，整体通透清爽、层次丰富
- 周围：适量摆放椰子、莲子、绿豆、桃胶、银耳、竹叶等原材料，可有轻微冷雾、水珠、水波纹、东方窗格光影
- 底部：展示4个主打产品小卡片：椰香清补凉、桃胶银耳露、绿豆百合冰糖水、杨枝甘露；加入卖点icon：清润解暑、真材实料、新中式甜品、夏夜推荐

要求：
画面要像高完成度品牌封面，不要像普通糖水海报。要有清润感、器皿美感、东方气质和品牌提案感。

【第2张图】
IMAGE 2｜QINGRUN VISUAL SYSTEM / 清润视觉系统档案

任务：
生成品牌识别系统图，展示这个品牌的视觉系统是如何构成的。要比第1张更系统、更结构化，但依然保持清润、年轻和新中式气质。

画面结构：
- 顶部：品牌名、英文辅助名、slogan，右侧可摆放一小碗代表性糖水图像
- 中部模块化展示以下内容：
  1）品牌标识系统：中文“清甜小馆”、英文“QINGTIAN SWEETS”、简化品牌印章或图形符号
  2）色彩系统：米白、莲子白、椰奶白、竹青绿、藕粉色、琥珀金、青灰、浅茶棕
  3）字体系统：中文标题字体、正文示意、英文辅助字体
  4）图标系统：桃胶、银耳、莲子、绿豆、芋圆、仙草、椰奶、芒果
  5）标签系统：夏日清润、冰镇推荐、真材实料、新中式糖水、轻养甜品、夜晚来一碗
  6）辅助图形系统：水波纹、小印章、碗轮廓、竹叶/荷叶、中式轻线条、食材纹理
- 底部：展示6个产品小卡片：椰香清补凉、桃胶银耳露、绿豆百合冰糖水、杨枝甘露、莲子银耳羹、芋圆仙草糖水，每个有小图、食材icon和简短说明

要求：
不要做成普通VI手册，要更像“清润视觉系统档案板”，信息丰富但有秩序，有设计方法感和记忆点。

【第3张图】
IMAGE 3｜PRODUCT & PACKAGING BOARD / 产品与包装应用图

任务：
生成产品与包装应用图，展示这个品牌如何真正落地为可售卖的产品系统。让人一眼觉得这个品牌真的可以开店、可以堂食、可以外卖。

画面结构：
- 顶部：陈列4个重点产品：椰香清补凉、桃胶银耳露、杨枝甘露、芋圆仙草糖水；用青瓷碗、白瓷碗、玻璃碗、小盖碗等不同器皿呈现，产品需真实可口，食材层次清晰，糖水通透、带冰镇清凉感
- 中部：展示包装和物料延展，包括透明外带杯、外带碗、封签、手提袋、纸袋、菜单小卡、点单贴纸、外卖贴签、双人分享装等；统一延续品牌系统：清淡配色、小印章、水波纹、小签条、新中式标签感
- 底部：展示6个完整产品卡片：椰香清补凉、桃胶银耳露、绿豆百合冰糖水、杨枝甘露、莲子银耳羹、芋圆仙草糖水；加入卖点：清润解暑、真材实料、冰镇推荐、新中式甜品、夏夜来一碗；如空间允许可增加加料推荐：椰奶、西米、芋圆、仙草、桃胶加量

要求：
必须有“真能卖”的感觉。不能只是堆食物，要体现系统性、包装感、器皿感和品牌感。

【第4张图】
IMAGE 4｜CAMPAIGN & SPACE BOARD / 传播与场景应用图

任务：
生成传播与场景应用图，展示《清甜小馆》进入真实场景后的传播效果和空间应用。重点呈现“夏夜糖水铺 + 年轻化新中式门店 + 社媒传播”。

画面结构：
- 左侧大主场景：展示“新中式糖水铺 / 夏夜糖水店 / 门店场景”，门头写“清甜小馆”，可带英文辅助“QINGTIAN SWEETS”，店面年轻、干净、有轻中式元素，不要太老派；场景中有柜台、成品糖水展示、器皿展示、柔和灯光，可少量出现年轻顾客或店员，整体氛围是夏夜、温柔、清润、舒服
- 右上：展示商场快闪或小型糖水摊位，包含品牌海报、产品展示、小菜单、器皿与外带产品
- 右中：展示两张宣传海报，一张主打椰香清补凉，一张主打桃胶银耳露或杨枝甘露；海报文案可用“夏天这一碗，清甜刚刚好。”、“一口清润，刚好入夏。”、“夏夜，适合来一碗糖水。”
- 左下：模拟3–4张手机竖图式社媒内容，可包括新品推荐、夏夜推荐、冰镇清润推荐、真材实料展示
- 右下：展示品牌纸袋、纸巾、杯垫、封签、小卡片、外卖贴等品牌触点
- 底部：加入应用场景标签：夏夜糖水铺、新中式甜品、轻养甜品、冰镇推荐、年轻社群；可加一句情绪化标语：“夏夜，来一碗刚刚好。”

要求：
比第3张更有场景感和故事感。不是奶茶店，也不是高冷甜品咖啡馆，而是年轻化新中式糖水铺。整体温润、清爽、舒服、传播感强，但不能杂乱。

【执行方式】
请严格按照以下流程执行：
1. 先内部理解并统一品牌视觉DNA。
2. 然后开始生成第1张图：夏夜清润主视觉。
3. 在保持同一品牌系统的前提下，继续生成第2张图：清润视觉系统档案。
4. 在保持同一品牌系统的前提下，继续生成第3张图：产品与包装应用图。
5. 在保持同一品牌系统的前提下，继续生成第4张图：传播与场景应用图。
6. 整个过程中，不要把4张图合并成一张，不要做四宫格，不要让4张图内容重复。
7. 请始终记住：这是同一个品牌的连续4张品牌视觉提案图，不是4个不同项目。

【最终目标】
输出一套4张独立但高度统一的《清甜小馆》品牌视觉提案图：
- 第1张负责定调
- 第2张负责解释系统
- 第3张负责产品落地
- 第4张负责传播与场景落地

整套结果应具备：
统一的品牌视觉DNA、清晰的页面分工、高完成度的审美、商业提案感、展示感、作品集质量，以及可直接用于品牌概念展示的效果。

cases.title: Pastel Paper Collage City Landscape Illustration
cases.imageAlt: Pastel Paper Collage City Landscape Illustration
cases.prompt:
Create a refined wide landscape illustration of [City Subject], naturally featuring [Iconic Landmark] as the main recognizable visual anchor.

CORE STYLE:
Depict [Subject] as a calm, elegant, highly stylized scene in a toned-down pastel paper-collage poster style. The scene should feel minimal, clean, poetic, modern, cultured, leisurely, and softly cheerful rather than realistic.

COMPOSITION:
Use a spacious horizontal composition. Place [Main Subject] as the central focus, clearly recognizable through its iconic [Distinctive Features] rising above the layered scene. Surround it with simplified [Contextual Elements]. Reinterpret in highly stylized illustrated forms using clean geometric shapes, layered color planes, soft curves, crisp silhouettes, and paper-like cutout forms. Avoid photorealism.

VISUAL ELEMENTS:
Include minimal charming details: simplified forms, tiny expressive people for scale, small architectural/environmental accents, organic elements (trees, plants), calm open sky with generous breathing space, clean horizontal layered divisions suggesting depth and atmosphere.

COLOR PALETTE (Toned-Down Pastels):
Soft sky blue, hazy blue-gray, pale cobalt, muted sage green, powder mint, warm cream, light beige, pale stone gray, dusty coral, soft peach, muted yellow, off-white, very small accents of navy or charcoal. [Add subject-specific accent colors as needed]

TACTILE QUALITY:
The image should feel tactile and handmade, like carefully arranged colored paper and gouache-painted poster board. Add subtle paper grain, matte printed texture, soft raised edges, delicate embossing, slight cut-paper shadows, gentle surface roughness. Keep surface refined and minimal, not messy.

VISUAL LANGUAGE:
Minimal paper collage, pastel travel poster, flat graphic shapes, subtle 3D paper relief, clean silhouettes, simplified architecture, soft matte texture, crisp color fields, gentle shadows, minimal linework, refined editorial illustration, modern [Cultural Context] poster mood. Wide landscape format, balanced negative space, strong graphic layering, clear focal area, simplified zones arranged harmoniously, airy composed and visually restful.

LIGHTING & MOOD:
Bright soft daylight, clean atmosphere, gentle shadows, warm relaxed tone, cultured and optimistic mood, quiet and sophisticated travel-poster feeling.

TYPOGRAPHY (Upper-left corner):
Main title '[City Subject Name]' in geometric uppercase sans-serif font with wide letter-spacing, solid white color. Below: smaller native text '[Local Language Translation]' and English subtext '[Landmark Subtitle]', all in matching white, left-aligned, thin stroke weights with airy spacious tracking.

AVOID:
Photorealism, realistic photography, over-detailed buildings, heavy outlines, messy brushwork, neon cyberpunk style, dark gloomy lighting, excessive gradients, crowded scenes, readable signage, logos, watermarks.

FINAL RESULT:
A polished minimal pastel paper-collage landscape illustration of [Subject], with [Iconic Element] as the main recognizable visual anchor, featuring tactile paper texture, soft shadows, clean geometric color blocking, generous negative space, and a refined modern travel-illustration mood.

=====================================
VARIABLE REPLACEMENT GUIDE:
[City Subject] = Target city or subject
[Iconic Landmark] = Main recognizable landmark
[Distinctive Features] = Key identifying characteristics
[Contextual Elements] = Supporting environmental details
[Cultural Context] = Cultural/regional context 

[Subject Specific Colors] = Custom accent colors (cherry blossoms: blush pink, lavender fields: soft lavender, etc.)

cases.title: Gatsby Art Deco Bridal Editorial Photos
cases.imageAlt: Gatsby Art Deco Bridal Editorial Photos
cases.prompt:
请基于用户上传的两位成年人清晰生活照，生成一张「Gatsby 风格 / 1920s Art Deco 风格」的超高预算婚纱写真。

请严格保留两个人的真实身份特征，包括脸型、五官比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄感、发际线、发型基础和整体气质。生成结果必须清楚看起来是同一对真实情侣 / 新人，不能变成陌生人，不能欧美化过度，不能网红化，不能出现明显 AI 假脸。

请只把上传照片作为人物身份参考，不要保留原始生活照里的背景、服装、姿势、光线和场景。请重新生成一张全新的婚纱大片。

整体风格不是普通豪华婚纱照，而是：
1920s Gatsby bridal editorial，Art Deco 奢华复古婚纱大片，电影级布景，杂志级成片，带哥特拱窗室内场景、old Hollywood glamour、神秘、贵气、戏剧化、精致、超高预算感。整体像顶级婚纱工作室的高概念企划，而不是普通影楼风。

场景风格请围绕参考图重建：
高挑的欧式 / 哥特式拱门与拱窗，强烈窗光，古典木桌椅，复古烛台，书本，轻纱，局部烟雾，水晶吊灯，少量 antique 装饰，深色木地板。空间要有纵深感和舞台感，但不要变成过度复杂的宫殿或现代豪宅。场景精致、克制、统一。

新娘造型是关键：
请明确做成 1920s Gatsby bride 造型。婚纱为香槟金、银金色或珍珠香槟色的高定亮片修身礼服，细密珠饰、beaded texture、修长鱼尾或直线条廓形，搭配戏剧性纱幔、轻纱拖尾、夸张欧根纱袖或层叠袖。珠宝包括珍珠项链、垂坠耳环、额饰 / 复古头饰 / feather headpiece / jeweled headband 等，整体精致昂贵。

如果用户原本是长发，请不要直接保留现代长发披散效果。请在保留本人辨识度的前提下，做成更接近 1920s 的复古造型：
- faux bob 假波波头
- pinned bob / tucked long hair
- finger waves 指推波纹
- sculpted side-parted waves
- 低位收发或卷发盘发，长度视觉上压缩成 20 年代短发轮廓
- 用复古额饰、羽毛、珠宝发饰强化 Gatsby 感
如果用户本身是短发，也要做成更明确的 1920s 指推波纹 / 波波头质感。不要出现现代日常长卷发或普通披肩长发。

新郎造型：
黑色、极深炭黑色或深夜蓝色高定礼服 / tuxedo，白衬衫，black bow tie 或正式领结，胸针细节克制高级。整体挺拔、沉稳、贵气，有 old money 与 old Hollywood 男主角气质。

光影是整组画面的核心，请严格参考示例图：
主要光源必须是拱窗射入的强逆光或侧逆光，形成可见光束、轮廓光和戏剧性明暗反差；辅光来自烛光与环境暖光，只做局部补充；可以有少量 haze / smoke 让光线更有层次。整体应是电影级高反差布光，不要均匀大平光，不要普通豪宅柔光，不要奇怪的泛白高光。某些镜头允许有轻微可控 lens flare，但必须合理、克制、来自真实强光，不要随机炫光。

请强化真实摄影质感：
真实皮肤纹理，适度柔化但不塑料磨皮；真实礼服重量感、纱幔质感、珠宝反光和烛光细节；不要 3D 渲染感，不要过度锐化，不要假 CG 感，不要游戏建模感。整体要像真实摄影棚与实体场景拍出来的婚纱照。

请特别注意人物脸部与身体比例自然真实。两个人都必须保持真实成年人比例，头部大小、肩宽、脖颈长度、手臂长度、手掌大小、身体接触和透视关系都要自然协调。不要出现脸过大、头过小、脖子过长、身体扭曲、手指错误、肢体融合、拼接感或穿模问题。

请特别强化两个人之间的互动和关系感，不要只是站在一起。两个人之间要有明确的情绪流动：
- 吸引
- 依恋
- 守护
- 默契
- 戏剧性的浪漫
- 带一点誓约感与命运感
可以通过背后环抱、对望停顿、桌边互动、纱下靠近、错位守望、轻扶腰背、手覆手等方式来表现。不要每张都并排站着看镜头。

请避免整组镜头重复：
- 有全身、半身、近景、特写
- 有单人也有双人
- 有正面、半侧、侧面、错位
- 有安静凝视、近距离停顿、互动、故事场景
- 不要每张都像一个模板变体

负面约束：
不要普通豪宅婚纱风，不要现代网红婚纱照，不要均匀平光，不要现代披肩长卷发，不要普通公主裙，不要廉价影楼感，不要塑料皮肤，不要人物像 AI 合成拼接，不要奇怪炫光，不要背景杂乱。

8 个镜头 Prompt
01｜纱幕开场，全身主视觉
拍摄一张新娘全身主视觉婚纱大片。新娘站在高挑拱门与拱窗之间，身后是强烈窗光，形成神圣而戏剧化的逆光。大量透明轻纱从前景和侧方掠过，像被风轻轻掀起，把新娘包裹在半透明的光影层次里。新娘身穿香槟金细密亮片高定修身婚纱，裙身修长，拖尾和纱幔自然垂落，一只手抬起轻触纱幔，另一只手自然放下。

重点：
新娘必须是明确的 1920s Gatsby bride 造型。即使用户原本是长发，也要通过 faux bob / finger waves / pinned bob 做成复古短发轮廓，并搭配珠宝额饰、垂坠耳饰、珍珠项链。

情绪：
贵气、冷静、自信，像从旧时代舞会中走出来的女主角。眼神轻看镜头或微微越过镜头，不要普通甜笑。

光影：
强逆光、轻烟雾、纱幔透光、深浅层次分明，整体电影感很强。

02｜新郎从背后拥抱，新娘在前，关系主图
拍摄一张双人半身到 3/4 身婚纱大片。新娘站在前方，新郎从身后环抱住她，双手自然落在她腰间或手臂附近，新娘双手轻放胸前或覆在新郎手上。新娘看向镜头，眼神平静、昂贵、笃定，像这场故事的中心；新郎低头看向新娘，神情温柔、专注、守护感强。

重点：
两个人必须有互动张力，不是简单站在一起。新郎的存在要像在保护和环绕她，新娘的状态则是被珍视、被凝视。身体接触要自然，比例要真实。

造型与光线：
新娘仍然是明确的 Gatsby 头饰与复古发型，礼服亮片细节清晰；新郎是黑色高定 tuxedo。拱窗暖逆光从后方照入，右侧可有一小束合理 lens flare，烛光 and 环境暖光做局部补充。整体更像电影剧照，而不是普通影楼合照。

03｜侧面对望，停在最有张力的一秒
拍摄一张双人侧面对望婚纱照。新娘与新郎面对面站立，距离很近，停留在即将更靠近的一瞬间，但不真正亲吻。新娘侧脸精致、肩背线条清楚，新郎低头看她，眼神沉静而专注。两个人之间有强烈但克制的吸引力，像誓言前停住的一秒。

重点：
不要笑，不要并排站着。重点是安静对望中的张力。两个人的眼神必须有交流，不空、不僵。

光影：
背景更暗，拱门后方有偏冷的轮廓逆光或蓝灰色烟雾感，人物边缘被勾出轮廓，前景桌椅或烛台可以轻微入镜。整体更偏电影感、低饱和、高反差。

04｜新娘坐在桌边，单人主图
拍摄一张新娘单人坐姿大片。新娘坐在复古深色长桌边，身后是高大的拱窗，桌上有烛台、厚书、玻璃器皿、少量珠宝配饰和轻纱。新娘身穿香槟金亮片修身婚纱，夸张欧根纱袖堆叠在两臂周围，裙身线条修长。她身体微微侧坐，一只手自然支撑桌面，另一只手轻放膝侧或握住复古饰件，头部略抬，眼神冷静、贵气、略带压迫感。

重点：
新娘仍需做 1920s 复古发型，不要现代长发。整张图要像高预算婚纱杂志内页 hero shot。

光影：
拱窗逆光 + 烛光暖补光 + 局部烟雾。画面要有暗部，不要大平光。桌景和礼服质感都要很精致。

05｜前景新娘，后景新郎守望，错位叙事
拍摄一张双人错位构图婚纱大片。新娘坐在桌边或靠在桌边，是画面的主要焦点。她微微低头或看向远处，情绪安静、若有所思，像在进入婚礼前的某种情绪停顿。新郎站在后方拱窗附近，稍微虚化或弱化一些，但仍清晰可辨，像在安静守望她。两个人不直接对视，却有明显的空间关系和情绪连接。

重点：
不要做成普通双人照。这张图要有剧情感，新娘是视觉中心，新郎像沉默而深情的存在。前后景层次必须清楚。

光影：
主光落在新娘身上，后方窗光勾亮新郎轮廓。烛台、书本、纱幔、桌面细节要丰富但不杂。整体偏安静、内敛、电影感。

06｜新娘近景珠宝特写
拍摄一张新娘近景电影特写。镜头聚焦新娘的半侧脸、肩颈、复古额饰、耳饰和手中精致复古配饰，例如金属装饰、珠宝面饰、古典小饰件。新娘微微转头，半侧脸或回眸角度，眼神安静而深，唇妆完整，妆容成熟贵气。背景中的烛火虚化成柔和暖色光斑。

重点：
这张必须非常强调 Gatsby 风格细节。头饰、指推波纹 / 假波波头、珍珠项链、耳饰都要清晰可信。脸不能 AI 感过重，皮肤不能塑料。要像真实拍摄出来的高预算近景，而不是 CG 细节图。

光影：
暖烛光从侧后方形成局部高光，脸部有柔和但有方向性的光，浅景深，整体很电影。

07｜桌边互动，婚礼前夜的仪式感
拍摄一张双人场景互动婚纱照。新娘站在或靠在复古长桌一侧，低头整理桌上的纸张、羽毛笔、珠宝或婚礼小物件；新郎站在桌对面或桌侧，轻轻参与这段互动，例如递给她一件小物、帮她点亮烛火，或安静注视她。两个人处在同一场景里，有很自然的互动，不是标准站位合影。

重点：
这张图要有“婚礼仪式前夜”的气氛。两个人的互动必须自然，像电影里的一个被抓拍到的片段。新娘依然是视觉焦点，新郎作为陪伴与守护存在。

光影：
窗光是主导，烛光是局部氛围光，桌面与道具细节清晰。整体有古典仪式感与叙事感。

08｜头纱之下的亲密收束图
拍摄一张双人收束婚纱大片。新娘与新郎站在桌边或拱窗前，长头纱或轻纱从两人头顶垂下，把他们包裹在同一个半透明空间中。新郎一只手轻扶新娘腰间或背部，新娘一只手落在新郎胸前。两个人额头相近，或新郎轻轻贴近新娘额头，停留在最有情绪张力的一刻，不真正亲吻。新娘看向新郎或低垂眼神，新郎轻看她或轻闭眼，整体极其亲密但克制。

重点：
这张不是“亲吻照”，而是“誓言前的停顿”。两个人之间必须有强烈互动 and 关系感。纱的前景、烛光、桌面细节都要服务于这段情绪。

光影：
整体偏暗，窗外逆光与烛光共同塑形，纱在光里半透明发亮，画面神圣、贵气、戏剧化，像整组的结尾镜头。

cases.title: Dark Fantasy Anime RPG Key Visual
cases.imageAlt: Dark Fantasy Anime RPG Key Visual
cases.prompt:
Dark fantasy anime key visual illustration.
High-end RPG game promotional art quality.
Fate/Grand Order, Granblue Fantasy illustration register.
Confident thick-and-thin linework, rich painted shadows,
hard dramatic lighting, glowing energy effects and gold sparks.

ATMOSPHERE FIRST:
The entire frame is saturated with deep crimson light.
The sky behind the figure is a storm of scarlet and black,
red lightning cracking through rolling dark clouds.
An obsidian-black dragon looms in the upper background,
red glowing eyes burning through the dark smoke.
The crimson sky bleeds forward light that rakes across
everything from behind. Gold energy sparks scatter the frame.
Warm front light falls on the figure, creating hard-edged
rim lighting: red from behind, gold from the front.

CHARACTER:
East Asian anime female, adult. Fitzpatrick I-II, pale porcelain skin.
Face: large dark brown eyes, high cheekbones, soft rounded features.
Anime-rendered with clean linework, rich painted shadows at jaw and neck.
Hair: extremely long, straight, dark dark brown near-black.
Falls far past the waist. In this wind it billows and streams behind her.
Curtain bangs: wispy fringe parted at center, strands framing both sides
of the forehead and falling past the eyes. This fringe is the defining
character landmark. It does not change.
Upper left arm: glowing rune markings in the shape of asterisks and
fine radiating lines, tracing along the skin, lit in gold-white.

POSE:
Seated on ancient cracked stone steps, body turned three-quarters
toward the viewer. Both knees drawn up, feet resting on the step below.
Right hand raised to chest height, holding a small glass vial filled
with luminous deep red liquid glowing from within, fingers curled
loosely around it. Left arm resting across the knees.
She is unhurried while the world burns behind her.
She has seen this before. The dragon does not concern her.
Eyes directed toward viewer, jaw level, lips at natural resting line.
The calm at the center of the storm.

COSTUME:
Black lacquered chest armor, form-fitted, crimson underlayer visible
at every joint and edge seam. Gold filigree at every border.
Dark red pauldron at the right shoulder. Left shoulder has a
white armored cap with a small white bow accent at the center front.
Multiple gold chains draping from the neckline at different lengths,
swaying with the wind. Gold-pearl beaded necklace visible above.
Pearl bracelet on the left wrist.
White gauntlet on the left forearm, black band at the upper edge.
Below the armor: white fitted greaves with double black band at the top.

BACKGROUND:
Ancient stone steps, cracked and overgrown. Red storm sky behind.
Dragon upper left, black scaled, red eyes glowing, vast.
Red lightning tears through upper portions of the frame.
Gold energy sparks and embers drift through the air.
The dragon's eye is the second focal point after the character's face.

NON-NEGOTIABLES:
Curtain bangs, center-parted, framing the forehead on both sides.
Extremely long straight dark hair streaming in the wind.
Deep crimson sky and dragon background.
Small white bow on the left shoulder armor.
Glowing red vial held in the right hand.
If hair is short or pulled back with bangs not visible: wrong.
If background is neutral or not crimson: wrong.

A wide horizontal landscape hand-painted illustration of [Landmark Name] in [City Country] with strong emphasis on negative space and quiet composition. 

The image features a warm off-white cream paper background that occupies 40-50% of the total canvas, creating generous blank margins and breathing room. 

The [Landmark Name] is positioned slightly off-center as a calm visual anchor, depicted through simplified [Key Architectural Features] with loose, expressive brush strokes. The landmark is suggested through minimal rhythmic marks and abstract color blocks in deep teal, cobalt blue, and forest green, rather than drawing every architectural detail precisely.

The composition is sparse and uncluttered: only a few carefully placed elements including 2-3 tiny human figures [Doing Typical Activity] rendered as simple silhouettes in coral red and mustard yellow, one small [Contextual Element] with minimal shapes, two or three [Natural Elements] in emerald green, and subtle [Cultural Architectural Hints].

Large areas of the warm paper background remain completely untouched, especially around the edges and between elements.

The style combines mid-century travel poster aesthetics with contemporary [Regional] editorial illustration: elegant, minimal, warm, cultured, and slightly nostalgic.

The texture shows loose hand-painted gouache and pastel marks with dry brush strokes, pastel smudges, wax-crayon edges, uneven color patches, imperfect handmade edges, and visible gaps between colored areas.

Colors are layered, dry, and tactile with a restrained palette of deep teal, sky blue, coral red, salmon pink, mustard yellow, ochre, terracotta, and small near-black accents, but used sparingly so each color can breathe against the paper.

The overall mood is quiet, spacious, relaxed, refined, like a sophisticated [City] cultural postcard or handmade art print suitable for premium lifestyle merchandise.

The landmark remains recognizable through its essential identity—[Defining Characteristics]—but the drawing stays airy, calm, poetic, and softly abstract.

Strong sense of pause, breath, and refined emptiness with confident use of blank space.

No crowded composition, no full-bleed busy background, no photorealism, no glossy digital rendering, no clean vector art, no 3D rendering, no text, no signage, no logos, no readable text.

cases.title: Luxury Headphones Street Fashion Commercial
cases.prompt:
Aspect Ratio: 9:16 Vertical
Duration: 15 Seconds
Style: Premium street-fashion commercial, cinematic lifestyle advertising, realistic camera physics, luxury tech campaign, viral social-media edit.

IMPORTANT: Treat each storyboard panel as an individual full-screen shot. Read left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Do NOT animate the collage. Every frame becomes a separate cinematic scene.

Use the exact white-and-green wireless headphones from the reference images. Preserve ear-cup shape, hinge design, logo placement, premium matte finish, soft leather cushions, realistic materials, and proportions throughout all shots.

### Shot 01 (0.0–1.2s)

Wide cinematic establishing shot. Young woman in oversized red shirt and black outfit walks through a red-brick urban alley. Headphones hang casually from her hand. Slow handheld push forward. Warm late-afternoon light. Fashion-commercial atmosphere.

### Shot 02 (1.2–2.2s)

Macro product detail. Hand raises the white-and-green headphones. Shallow depth of field. Premium texture visible. Soft city bokeh. Gentle camera drift.

### Shot 03 (2.2–3.3s)

Medium shot. She places headphones over her ears. Hair moves slightly in the wind. Match cut synchronized to soundtrack beat. Smooth handheld realism.

### Shot 04 (3.3–4.4s)

Wide tracking shot. She walks deeper into the alley. Camera follows beside her. Natural parallax from buildings. Urban confidence.

### Shot 05 (4.4–5.5s)

Extreme close-up of ear cup. Green accents catch reflected light. Premium material detail. Cinematic rack focus.

### Shot 06 (5.5–6.7s)

Medium close-up profile. Eyes closed. Calm expression. Noise-canceling serenity. Slow push-in. Background softly blurred.

### Shot 07 (6.7–7.9s)

Low-angle wide shot crossing a city intersection. Golden-hour reflections. Confident stride. Headphones centered naturally within frame.

### Shot 08 (7.9–9.1s)

Tight side profile. Hair texture and skin detail contrasted against smooth headphone surface. Passing cars create subtle motion streaks.

### Shot 09 (9.1–10.3s)

Medium portrait. She lifts one ear cup slightly. Small smile. Connecting with the city atmosphere. Gentle camera sway.

### Shot 10 (10.3–11.5s)

Wide follow shot from behind. Walking toward a graffiti-covered wall. Red-and-black environment complements the green-and-white product.

### Shot 11 (11.5–12.8s)

Macro hero product shot. Headphones rotate slowly in her hand. Dynamic reflections reveal premium craftsmanship. Sharp logo visibility.

### Shot 12 (12.8–15.0s)

Hero ending. Woman seated on urban staircase. Headphones worn confidently. Soft backlight creates halo around hair. Slight breeze. Slow cinematic push-in. Peaceful yet powerful expression. Product remains crisp, dominant, and aspirational.

* Hard cuts on beat
* Match cuts using hand movement
* Match cuts using head turns
* Momentum-driven edits
* No wipes

Matte gouache poster finish

No excessive detail

Wide horizontal format.

Large open sky occupying approximately 40--50% of the image.

cases.title: Monochrome Fashion Portrait Collage Template
cases.prompt:
Edit the photo while preserving the subject’s exact facial features and identity. Create a high-resolution vertical portrait composition (9:16), ultra-detailed, sharp focus throughout, no background blur, rendered with a premium 8K editorial finish.

Design the image as a sophisticated black-and-white fashion portrait collage arranged in a 2×3 grid, featuring six unique frames of the same young woman in a clean, minimalist indoor studio environment. The overall aesthetic should feel elegant, cinematic, intimate, and effortlessly stylish, inspired by timeless monochrome fashion editorials and luxury magazine photography.

Hair is long, reaching the waist, colored a cool ash-brown with subtle gray undertones. Styled in a Korean-inspired hush cut with soft face-framing layers, airy see-through bangs, and sleek straight lengths that gently curve outward at the ends. The texture appears silky, healthy, and glossy, with a few natural flyaway strands for realism.

Beauty styling remains refined and understated: luminous hydrated skin, naturally feathered brows, subtle brown eyeliner, soft mascara, muted nude lips with a velvety finish, and barely-there blush for a fresh editorial appearance.

Wardrobe consists of a fitted white rib-knit tank top paired with relaxed high-waisted vintage-wash denim jeans, visible in selected frames. Accessories include matte black nail art, delicate silver hoop earrings, multiple silver rings, and a slim silver wristwatch, contributing to a contemporary fashion-editorial mood.

Collage Frame Concepts:

• Frame 1 — Tight portrait crop, fingertips resting softly against the cheek, direct eye contact, confident yet gentle expression.

• Frame 2 — Casual seated pose on a sofa, body turned slightly to one side, gaze directed away from the camera in a contemplative moment.

• Frame 3 — Relaxed reclining position with one knee bent, leaning comfortably into an arm, creating a graceful editorial silhouette.

• Frame 4 — Arms lifted behind the head, posture open and self-assured, subtle lean backward conveying effortless confidence.

• Frame 5 — Emotional close portrait with a slight head tilt and closed eyes, emphasizing calmness and quiet introspection.

• Frame 6 — Front-facing seated composition with composed expression and subtle movement through the hair for a natural, candid feel.

Environment remains intentionally simple: a light-toned studio wall with a neutral sofa appearing selectively across certain frames. The background should support the subject without drawing attention away from her.

Lighting is soft and diffused, resembling natural window light in a professional studio. Gentle directional shadows create depth and dimensionality, while a faint rim light subtly separates the hair from the background. Avoid harsh flash or strong contrast.

Captured with the quality and detail associated with professional mirrorless cameras such as a Canon EOS R5 or Sony A7R IV. Use a combination of intimate close-ups and medium-length portraits, primarily at eye level with occasional slightly elevated angles. Emphasize balanced magazine-style compositions and natural visual flow across the collage.

Final processing should feature a rich monochrome conversion with smooth tonal transitions, lifted shadows, restrained contrast, delicate 35mm film grain, a soft matte finish, and exceptional detail retention in both skin texture and hair, echoing the look of classic high-fashion editorial photography.

cases.prompt: 1:1 square anime infographic poster, premium official fanbook spread style — like the Demon Slayer Kimetsu Fanbook, Jujutsu Kaisen Official Character Guide, or a Chainsaw Man artbook info page. Subject: [Subject]. OVERALL ENERGY: High-impact, vibrant, alive. This is a collector’s guidebook page — it should make an anime fan instantly want to screenshot it. Dense with designed elements, but clean and readable. Modern, NOT vintage, NOT parchment, NOT grey. BACKGROUND: Crisp light background — soft cool white with a faint tech-grid or subtle halftone texture. Behind the hero subject, a dynamic COLOR burst: radiating speedlines in gold/amber + a large halftone dot explosion in electric blue and crimson. One oversized SFX kanji relevant to the subject sits behind everything at ~10% opacity as a bold graphic splash. An ink-splatter accent in deep navy frames one corner. TITLE LOCKUP (top-left): Massive bold kanji of the subject’s name beside the large bold English name, equal visual weight, locked together. A thin colored accent rule under it with a short tagline in small caps. HERO SUBJECT: [Subject] rendered large on a dramatic diagonal, taking ~55% of the canvas, in bold anime cel-shaded linework — thick black ink outlines, vibrant color fills, dynamic lighting. A glowing energy aura (electric blue-to-purple gradient) traces its most iconic feature. Motion: faint speed streaks coming off it like it’s mid-action. CALLOUT CARDS (the key element — 7 to 8 of them, alternating left and right): Each is a small DESIGNED sticker-card with a drop shadow, connected to its part on the subject by a sharp colored leader line (red or electric blue) ending in a small filled arrowhead. Each card has: a colored header bar (navy/red/blue) containing a small minimalist line-ICON matching that part’s function (e.g. a flame for a blade/edge, a shield for a guard, a spiral-wrap for a grip, a gear for a mechanism), the part name in bold white EN + smaller Japanese beneath, and ONE short stat line below on white. Cards feel placed on top of the poster like premium stickers. DIMENSION LINES: 2–3 thin technical measurement lines running along the subject’s edges with double-arrow endpoints and bold measurement numbers floating beside them (real units, e.g. “102 cm / 40 in”). ZOOM DETAILS: 2 circular magnifier panels overlaid near the subject, each ringed in a bold colored border, connected by a thin line to the exact spot it zooms into, showing a crisp anime close-up of that part. DECORATIVE GRAPHICS: One circular wax-seal / stamp badge in a corner (red or gold, looks official). One small dynamic chibi-or-action anime character cameo in a lower corner reacting to the subject, for life and scale. SPECS BAR (full-width bottom): Dark navy panel, clean monospaced white text in tidy columns — Type, Dimensions, Weight, Material, Origin, Era. Looks like a character stats card. COLOR PALETTE: Bold and limited — deep navy, crimson red, electric blue, gold/amber accents, on crisp light background. High saturation on accents, glow effects allowed. Absolutely no muted grey wash, no sepia, no vintage tone. FEEL: Every callout is a designed icon-card, every edge is measured, the background pulses with color and SFX energy. A real infographic that breathes anime. Clean, dense, premium, electric. COLOR PALETTE: Derived from the subject itself. For [Subject], the dominant colors are [Subjects Colors]. Card headers, accent lines, glow effects, and burst colors should all pull from these — not default blue/navy. The infographic should feel color-coded to its subject, instantly recognizable before you even read a word.

- Premium editorial illustration
- Whimsical garden atmosphere

Optimistic [Season Mood] garden mood

cases.title: Luxury Brand Product Poster Template
cases.prompt:
[BRAND NAME] | [COLOR = brand color or AUTO] | [OBJECT = physical object or AUTO] | [HEADLINE = text or AUTO] | [SUBHEADLINE = text or AUTO]

Act as a Luxury Brand Campaign Art Director creating a single vertical hero product poster — a studio CGI composition where [BRAND NAME]'s hero product sits on top of a physical object. The entire image is driven by [BRAND NAME]'s real brand identity, real products, and real cultural associations. References: Diesel 1DR bag campaign, Supreme product drops, high-end fashion product CGI posters.

---

PHASE 0: BRAND INTELLIGENCE — AUTONOMOUS EXTRACTION

COLOR SYSTEM: if [COLOR] is provided by the user — use that exact color as the primary driver for the entire background gradient and ambient lighting system. Do not override it with brand colors. If [COLOR] is AUTO — identify [BRAND NAME]'s most iconic primary brand color and use that. In both cases: this single color becomes the entire background — a rich saturated radial gradient from a brighter more luminous version of this color at the center to a deeper darker version at the edges. The background is monochromatic — one color family only. All objects in the scene reflect and pick up this color — their surfaces are tinted by the ambient color of the environment.

HERO PRODUCT: identify [BRAND NAME]'s single most iconic current hero product — the one product most associated with the brand right now. This product sits on top of the object and is the star of the composition. Rendered in photorealistic CGI — all materials accurate to the real product, all hardware and branding details correct. The product's own colors are visible but influenced by the strong ambient background color — every reflective surface picks up the background hue.

CULTURAL OBJECT: if [OBJECT] is provided by the user — use that exact physical object as the base pedestal. Render it with maximum physical realism — correct materials, correct construction details, correct scale relative to the hero product. If [OBJECT] is AUTO — autonomously identify the single most culturally resonant physical object associated with [BRAND NAME]'s world — not the product itself but the environment or culture the brand lives in. In both cases: the object must be large enough to physically support the hero product on its top surface. The object fills the lower 40 to 50% of the frame. Its surfaces pick up the background color as strong colored ambient reflections.

BRAND TAGLINE: identify [BRAND NAME]'s official tagline — appears below the main wordmark in small tracked caps. Always AUTO — taken from real brand documentation.

HEADLINE TEXT: if [HEADLINE] is provided by the user — use that exact text as the large campaign headline in the lower zone. If [HEADLINE] is AUTO — identify or derive the most powerful real campaign statement authentic to [BRAND NAME]'s documented tone of voice and current campaign language.

SUBHEADLINE TEXT: if [SUBHEADLINE] is provided by the user — use that exact text as the body copy below the headline. If [SUBHEADLINE] is AUTO — derive a real brand descriptor sentence authentic to [BRAND NAME]'s product and mission.

PRODUCT IDENTIFIER: identify the specific product name or model code for the hero product — appears as a small badge element in the lower left alongside the logo.

---

PHASE 1: BACKGROUND

Pure studio background — a single seamless color field derived from [COLOR]. Radial gradient: the center zone behind the stacked objects is the most luminous saturated version of [COLOR]. The gradient falls off toward the edges and corners becoming progressively deeper and darker — the same hue but 40 to 60% darker at the frame edges. No texture, no surface, no environment — pure atmospheric color. The gradient is soft and organic — a natural light falloff. The overall effect: the objects appear to be lit from within the color itself.

---

PHASE 2: BASE OBJECT — PEDESTAL

The object from PHASE 0 rendered as a large physical object filling the lower 40 to 50% of the vertical frame. Centered horizontally. Shot from a slightly low angle — top surface and front face simultaneously visible, giving the object presence and weight. Material rendering: all surfaces pick up [COLOR] strongly — the ambient color bounces into every reflective, glossy, or metallic surface. The object feels like it belongs in this color world — saturated by the environment, not neutrally colored. Every specific material detail authentic to the real object is fully rendered — texture, construction, hardware, wear patterns, any branding or markings on the object itself. The object must look physically real and three-dimensional — not a prop, not a simplified CGI object. A real physical thing.

---

PHASE 3: HERO PRODUCT — TOP ELEMENT

The hero product from PHASE 0 sits directly on top of the object — physically resting on its top surface, centered horizontally, occupying approximately 35 to 45% of the frame height. The product is the highest point of the composition — its top edge reaches into the upper third of the frame. Rendered with maximum material fidelity — every texture, every hardware detail, every stitch or construction element accurate to the real product. Reflective surfaces catch [COLOR] as strong colored reflections. The product's own logo or branding mark is clearly visible and correctly positioned. The product casts a soft shadow on the object surface below it. A slight gap of ambient shadow between the product base and the object surface confirms the product is resting on top, not merged into it.

---

PHASE 4: TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM

Upper zone — centered: [BRAND NAME]'s wordmark in large white bold type — official typeface, correct proportions. Below the wordmark: brand tagline in small white tracked caps — generous letter-spacing. Both elements pure white against the saturated background.

Lower zone — campaign headline: [HEADLINE] text in large italic bold white type — left-aligned or centered, large and commanding, occupying 2 to 3 lines maximum. The headline is the most dominant typographic element in the lower zone — approximately 8 to 10% of poster height per line.

Below the headline — subheadline: [SUBHEADLINE] text in small regular weight white type — NOT italic, NOT bold, strictly upright roman style. 2 to 3 lines, left-aligned. Font size approximately 1.2 to 1.5% of poster height — noticeably smaller than the headline, readable at normal viewing distance but clearly secondary. The subheadline is the quietest typographic element in the lower zone — it does not compete with the headline for attention.

Lower left corner: two badge elements side by side — [BRAND NAME]'s wordmark in a small rounded rectangular badge with [COLOR] background and white text, and the product name/model identifier in a second small badge. Small and precise — like product labels or hang tags.

---

PHASE 5: LIGHTING

Single dramatic overhead studio light — positioned directly above the composition, slightly in front. Creates: bright specular highlights on the highest surfaces of both the object and the hero product — topmost surfaces are the brightest zones. Strong colored shadows falling downward — deep and rich with [COLOR]. The ambient color bounce is intense — every surface in the scene is bathed in [COLOR]'s reflected light. Metal surfaces catch the strongest colored reflections. Leather, suede, rubber — all pick up the color cast. No natural light, no environmental context — pure studio color world.

---

PHASE 6: COMPOSITION

Aspect ratio: 4:5 portrait. The two stacked elements centered horizontally, occupying the central 60 to 70% of frame width. Base object: lower 40 to 50% of vertical frame. Hero product: middle 35 to 45% of vertical frame. Typography upper zone: top 20 to 25% of frame. Typography lower zone: bottom 15 to 20% of frame. The stacking creates a clear visual hierarchy — grounded object supporting the elevated premium product. Reading order: bottom to top — object context → hero product → brand identity.

---

PHASE 7: TECH SPECS

Render: Octane Render or Redshift — photorealistic studio CGI. Background: pure radial gradient shader in [COLOR]. All object materials: physically accurate PBR — correct roughness, correct IOR, correct reflectivity for each material type. Ambient color bounce: global illumination on — [COLOR] must bounce into all object surfaces. Ray tracing: on. Anti-aliasing: maximum. Sampling: minimum 2048. Typography: crisp, anti-aliased, flat white — zero shadows, zero effects. No film grain. Output feel: [BRAND NAME]'s official product launch campaign — hero image on their website, full-page magazine ad, Instagram campaign post.

cases.prompt:
围绕任意主题对象生成一张明亮清透、带强烈留白呼吸感的图片：主题对象作为近距离主形体从画面下方进入，尺度偏大，边缘可被轻微裁切，让视线先落到主体的抬升姿态、伸展轮廓或朝向光源的动作，再被上方大面积空旷底色接住。背景不是装饰，而是一整片高明度、低杂质、轻微渐变的发光色场，占据主要面积，保持通风、洁净、夏日般轻快的情绪；色彩从主题自身的材质、季节、情绪和叙事中提取，映射为大面积明亮底色、少量主体结构色、清晰的深浅层次和极少量强调色，保留高明度、干净色阶、受控饱和与柔和反差，不照搬固定色号，也不做灰黄、陈旧、烟雾或泥感处理。主体表面使用自然强光 and 柔软反射，亮部近乎透明，暗部只用于建立形体，不压低整体空气感。上方留白中放置一组像被光写出来的细线手写标题或符号，白色或主题派生的浅亮信息色，笔触松弛、带弧线和停顿，像漂浮在空气中；旁侧用极小字号的说明文字形成轻微倾斜或竖向阅读节奏，信息层要轻、稀疏、克制，服务于空间尺度而不是抢占主体。整体完成感应像一次清爽的编辑写真：低视角带来开阔感，主体与空旷色场形成鲜明的上下重量关系，文字像阳光中的手势留下记忆，画面清亮、干净、柔和但不空泛。

——————
头像用途: 竖版 3:4，成年女性半身人像从画面下方靠近镜头，肩颈和下巴略被裁切，视线抬向上方窗光。
写在留白里: 手写小标题“今天的我很亮”，右侧极小字放“个人主页头像 / 轻妆 / 白衬衫”。
人物气质: 干净、自信、松弛，不要浓重棚拍感。

cases.prompt:
围绕任意主题对象生成一张强设计感视觉：画面由深色安静的信息外场托住中央巨大的圆形鱼眼视窗，视窗像被镜面或广角镜头撑开，主题核心内容在圆内被近距离拉伸，前景元素向观者伸出并贴近圆形边界，边缘带轻微畸变与真实光影压迫感，形成“马上冲出画面”的第一眼冲击。圆形外沿用细白线、不完整弧线 and 少量圆点节点标出结构，外场分布粗重主标题、年份或编号式大数字、短句信息块和极小字号技术注释，字体以高对比白色为主，主标题紧密有力，辅助文字小而冷静，中文与英文可混排但只作为节奏和信息层级，不复制任何既有文案。主题识别符号可以落在前景触点或贴片上，像被按在玻璃上的小型标记，形成清晰记忆点。色彩从主题自身的材质、情绪和语义中提取，保留大面积干净深色结构底、圆内明亮通透的光照主体、少量高饱和清晰强调色、白色信息文字与干净阴影层次的角色关系；整体保持明亮有冲劲、冷静又发疯的视觉情绪，暗部要清澈，亮部要有日光般的高明度和洁净边界，避免脏灰、陈旧、烟雾化或复古泛黄。画面质感结合真实摄影的空间透视、鱼眼畸变、强烈近景尺度和数字平面排版，信息密度高但阅读路径明确：先看圆形冲击和前景触点，再读大标题与数字，最后发现散落的微型注释。

——————

需要出现: 桌面上有小队旗贴片和预约二维码占位，不要做成真实二维码，只像贴在玻璃上的小标记。

cases.prompt:
【菜品信息】
菜品名称：[菜品名称]
菜品类型：[菜品类型]
核心食材：[核心食材]
口感卖点：[口感卖点]
