【文字设计】
顶部或侧边加入具有设计感的主标题：
主标题：[菜品名称]
副标题：[副标题]
底部可以加入 3-4 个简短卖点词

文字需要像真正的餐饮品牌海报排版，具有设计感、作品感和商业广告感，而不是说明书式排版。字体可以根据菜品风格选择：汉堡可用粗犷有冲击力的标题字，拉面可用日式书法感，奶茶可用温暖柔和的品牌字，寿司可用精致留白的高级餐饮字体。

【画面要求】
生成一张高级商业餐饮海报，整体不是普通菜单图，也不是食材说明图，而是具有强视觉冲击力的餐饮新品主视觉海报。

画面采用 9:16 竖版构图，主体食物居中放大，占据画面主要视觉区域。食材需要以“爆炸式悬浮”的方式展开，沿着菜品本身的层次结构自然分离，形成明显的空间纵深、动态感和食欲冲击力。

食材不要排列得过于死板，也不要像工程拆解图。需要有自然高低错位、前后景层次、轻微透视变化 and 悬浮感，像食物刚刚在空中被拉开、拆开、爆开的一瞬间。

【食物质感要求】
重点表现真实、诱人的食物质感。根据菜品类型加入合适的动态元素，例如：酱汁飞溅、芝士拉丝、热气蒸汽、汤汁翻涌、冰块、水滴、珍珠悬浮、芝麻颗粒、香料碎屑、食材飞散等。动态元素要增强食欲，不能杂乱。

【背景与氛围】
背景要服务食物风味。背景可以有轻微环境氛围，如木桌、暖光、浅景深、蒸汽、冰雾、光斑，但不能抢主体。整体要高级、干净、有商业主视觉感。

【整体风格】
高级商业美食摄影、餐饮新品主KV、竖版门店海报、短视频封面、外卖主图、真实摄影质感、强食欲冲击、动态悬浮食材、精致文字排版、柔和阴影、电影级光影。

最终效果要像一张可以直接用于餐饮新品发布、门店海报、社媒宣传、外卖平台主图的高冲击美食主视觉海报。

The character should show clear emotional tension through the eyes, mouth, shoulders, hands, body angle, hair, clothes and weapon.

Use a clean dark negative-space background. The image should feel sharp, high-resolution and cinematic, not dirty, muddy, low-resolution or over-textured.

香水名称：[香水名称]
香调类型：[香调]
核心香材：[核心香材]
情绪氛围：[视觉气质]
主色调：[颜色]

【画面要求】
生成一张高级香水品牌广告海报，不是普通产品图，也不是电商详情页，而是一张具有奢侈香氛 campaign 质感的主视觉作品。

画面采用 9:16 竖版构图，香水瓶作为中心 hero object，瓶身居中偏大，具有高级玻璃质感、精致瓶盖、真实反光、柔和高光和品牌广告级打光。

香调元素围绕瓶身自然展开，形成“气味被可视化”的感觉。元素可以包括花瓣、果皮、木片、树脂、皮革、烟雾、水珠、光粒子、丝绸、雾气等，但要根据香调选择，不要全部堆满。

画面重点不是拆开香水瓶，而是把香气、材质、情绪和香调层次表现出来。香调元素要有空间层次、前后景、轻微悬浮感和动态感，像香味从瓶身周围缓慢扩散开来。

画面可以加入少量中文文字，但不要太多。

主标题：[香水名称]
副标题：[核心香材]

让每一次呼吸都如晨光般清澈

让夜色在呼吸间缓缓盛开

高级香氛广告、奢侈品海报、真实摄影质感、电影级光影、精致玻璃瓶、香调可视化、强氛围感、柔和景深、细腻材质、品牌主视觉、9:16 竖版。

【避免】
不要电商白底图
不要普通静物摆拍
不要元素乱飞
不要花瓣过多像婚庆图
不要文字太多
不要过度赛博风
不要廉价塑料质感
不要背景杂乱
不要让香调元素抢走香水瓶主体

最终效果要像一张可以用于香水品牌发布、社媒广告、产品 KV、门店海报或香氛 campaign 的高级主视觉海报。

cases.title: Experimental Fashion Editorial Poster Template
cases.prompt:
Create a vertical high-resolution experimental fashion editorial poster.

【Theme】: [Your Theme]
【Brand name】: [Your Brand Name]
【Collection title】: [Collection Title]
【Fashion / product direction】: [Fashion Product Direction]
【Main color palette】: [Main Color Palette]
【Model direction】: [Model Direction]
【Editorial copy】: [Editorial Copy]

The image should feel like a high-end, cold, minimal and experimental fashion magazine poster. Use a large pale grey-white negative-space background with subtle paper grain, low-contrast noise and printed editorial texture. Avoid clean plastic white backgrounds or commercial studio backdrops.

The main subject is [Model Direction], shown in a full-body or nearly full-body pose, placed slightly right of center. The pose should feel quiet, restrained, distant and editorial. The model should have a calm expression and high-fashion presence. Avoid influencer posing, exaggerated performance or commercial catalog energy.

The clothing or product must have strong design value, clear silhouette and rich material details: sheer fabric, crinkled texture, soft volume, leather reflection, knit texture, structured tailoring, transparent layers, natural folds or subtle shine. Keep the person realistic, with natural skin texture and no plastic AI face.

Add a controlled “ghost scan blur” effect: vertical motion trails, translucent afterimages, stretched scan lines, slight glitch displacement and soft dissolving blur around the left side of the body, lower garment edges, arms, shoes or product edges. The effect should look like the person, garment or product has been optically scanned, folded by paper texture, or dragged by memory.

Important: keep the face or upper body relatively clear as the visual anchor. Do not blur the entire person. The key contrast is: clear emotional anchor + blurred ghost trace around the edges.

If the theme includes a product such as perfume, jewelry, bags or shoes, place it subtly near the model, at the bottom of the poster or in the foreground. Connect the product with the model through reflection, transparent blur, liquid trace, glass distortion or scan-like afterimages. Do not make it look like a normal e-commerce product image.

Use a minimal fashion magazine layout: small English title at the top, such as “[Brand Name] / [Collection Title]”; a small paragraph of editorial copy near the body or product; and a tiny abstract logo at the bottom. Typography should be clean, restrained, small, high-end and sans-serif. Avoid large promotional text, loud fonts or ad-like design.

Overall mood: low saturation, low contrast, cold, quiet, premium, experimental, editorial, archive-like, independent designer lookbook, avant-garde fashion magazine, artistic brand campaign.

Avoid: cartoon, illustration, cheap poster design, e-commerce ad, promotional banner, large text, complex background, multiple random people, collage grid, over-sharpening, over-retouched skin, obvious AI look.

cases.title: Cinematic Portrait From Photo Template
cases.prompt:
围绕用户提供的照片生成一张电影海报式的人像作品，核心是用巨大的纯净色场托起依偎在画面边缘、各自仰望天空的主体。整张画面约四分之三是一整片干净、饱和、毫无杂物的单色场，像被无限拉远的天空，制造开阔、想念、夏日般的留白呼吸感；主体只占据画面一侧约四分之一的窄带，把绝大部分空间让给空旷的色场。构图随画幅自适应：竖幅时主体贴着画面底部成一道低矮的横排，天空向上延展；横幅时主体贴着画面一侧（如左侧）成一道竖排，空旷色场向另一侧（如右侧）大幅铺开，文字落在那片空场里；无论横竖，主体与文字始终分居两端，留白占主导。镜头必须是从下方仰拍的极低角度（虫视角）：每个角色的头都向后仰、下巴抬高、喉颈舒展，脸朝向头顶那片空旷的色场向上凝望，观者主要看到的是下颌底缘与侧脸或四分之三侧脸的轮廓——角色绝不正对镜头、绝不与镜头平视对视、不做正面证件式人像、视线不落在观者身上而是投向头顶的天空。只露出头部、肩部与少量上身，下缘被画面边缘自然裁切。

主体对象不作任何种类限定，一切以输入照片里真实出现的对象为准；其身份、数量、种类与组合必须严格忠实于原照片、一一对应，不得凭空增殖、复制、繁殖或添加画面之外多余的对象。关键的依偎姿态是相互倚靠而非朝同一处看：各对象背靠背、头靠头，或一方把后脑、头侧倚在另一方的肩颈上，彼此朝相反或不同的方向偏靠依偎，每个对象各自把头仰向自己那一侧的天空，目光发散投向不同方向的空旷色场，而不是汇聚在同一焦点；每个对象都保持下巴抬高、向上仰望的姿态，整体传达依偎、亲密又各自出神的情绪。除非用户明确要求重复或镜像，否则不要把同一张脸或同一个对象复制成多个。

在远离主体的那片空场里放置手写、带笔触飞白与轻微连笔的标题文字，字形随性、略带斜势与手绘趣味，分成两到三行错落排布，使用与主色场形成温暖对比的明亮强调色（明黄气质，可依主题情绪微调色相），让这组字像漂浮在空中的私人签名。标题文字内容默认为手写英文 “Call Me By Your Name”，仅当用户提供自定义文字时才替换为用户指定的内容。标题位置随画幅自适应：竖幅时落在上方空场的中部偏上，横幅时落在主体对侧那片大留白的中央。标题上方放一行更小的细体说明性文字（默认 “a film by …” 风格），标题下方放两到三行更小的强调色或白色大写信息行（默认 “IN SELECT THEATERS / NOVEMBER 24 / #CMBYN” 这类影院上映与标签式短句，用户可自定义）；竖幅版另可在最顶部居中堆叠数行极小的白色影评引语式短句，并在底部贴边压一行白色大写主演名与一整块细密低调的小字版权信息条，构成完整的电影海报文字秩序。

主色场默认采用原作那种纯净、饱和、略深的钴蓝／天青色——晴朗夏日正午天空般的蓝，近似 #0A66AC（红极低、绿居中、蓝偏高），明确偏蓝而不偏青、不发灰、不偏紫、不偏粉蓝、也不偏藏青或墨蓝；仅当用户指定其它主题色时才整体替换，替换后仍须保留同样的纯净、饱和与高明度关系。整体色彩角色为：单一大面积纯净高明度色场占主导、一处温暖手写强调色（默认明黄）作点睛、白色文字承担信息、人物保留真实自然肤色与衣物色。画面明亮、通透、干净、饱和而不脏，带开阔与思念的温柔气息；即便选用更深的色场也要保持光感清澈、色阶清晰、留白透气，避免发灰、发旧、发闷、蒙脏或做旧。视觉权重牢牢集中在巨大空场与边缘仰望主体的对比上，主体绝不可放大占满画面、绝不可正面平拍、绝不可失去大片留白与上仰发散的视线。

cases.title: Dreamy Paper Art Exhibition Poster
cases.prompt:
生成一张 4:5 竖版、高完成度的梦幻纸艺展览视觉海报，主题为《打开她的梦 / OPEN HER DREAM》。

整张画面是一张完整的展览海报，而不是普通人物插画。画面采用“纸雕立体书 / pop-up book / layered paper art”的创意机制：底部是一本文字书页被打开的立体书，书页中央向上展开一个层层叠叠的梦境纸雕世界。人物站在纸雕梦境世界中央，像从打开的梦境中走出。

画面主体是一位 23–30 岁年轻成年东方女性，明确成年，温柔耐看脸，五官精致自然，不幼态，不网红化，长发自然披散，发丝微卷，有轻微风感。人物正面面向镜头，表情温柔、安静、浪漫成熟，带一点神秘感和梦境女主气质。

人物身形为高级丰满感，比例自然协调，曲线优雅成熟。通过礼裙轮廓 and 姿态审美化表现胸线、腰线、小腹线条、腰臀比例和整体女性轮廓，但不要夸张，不要低俗，不要色情化。姿态为正面优雅站姿，一只手轻轻抬起或触碰发丝 / 肩颈，另一只手轻拉裙摆，身体重心轻微偏移，形成柔和流动感。

服装为贴合曲线的梦幻高级礼裙，礼裙融合深蓝紫、烟熏紫、玫瑰粉、月光金、象牙白高光。上半身为精致修身礼服结构，带金色花枝刺绣、星点装饰、薄纱披覆与细腻珠光；裙摆为层叠薄纱与花瓣状结构，轻盈流动，带梦境感、绽放感和女性成长感。

整体主色调改为深色梦幻系：深午夜蓝、靛蓝、蓝紫色、烟熏紫、灰玫瑰粉、月光金、柔和象牙白。背景为深蓝夜幕与星空，画面中有金色弯月、细碎星点、云层、蝴蝶、花朵、拱门、纸雕城堡、旋转台阶、纸艺植物和层叠窗格。所有元素都像精致纸艺切割与层叠而成，具有纵深感、空间感和展览装置感。

纸雕梦境层次要围绕人物身体展开：拱门从人物背后向上包围，花朵和蝴蝶从裙摆两侧生长，纸艺台阶通向月亮与城堡，蓝紫色花叶与金色线条形成梦境动线。画面要华丽、丰富、梦幻，但不能杂乱。

海报必须加入清晰且高级的文字排版，形成完整展览视觉。左侧加入大标题：
“打开她的梦”
英文副标题：
“OPEN HER DREAM”
顶部小字：
“纸艺梦境主题展览”
加入展览信息模块：
“每一个梦的打开，都是一次温柔的成长”
“Every dream opened is a gentle growth.”
“展览时间 2025 06.21 — 08.31”
“展览地点 光屿美术馆 · 梦境厅”
右侧加入小字标签：
“DREAM / GROWTH / BLOOM”
“梦 / 成长 / 绽放”
右下角加入圆形徽章：
“沉浸式纸艺梦境展 / Immersive Paper Art Dreamland Exhibition”
底部加入一句英文：
“Open her dream, and let the beautiful within her bloom.”
以及关键词：
“梦境｜成长｜自我｜绽放”

文字排版要求优雅、清晰、有展览海报感，使用高级衬线字体、细线分隔、金色与玫瑰金文字，不要廉价字体，不要信息杂乱。

画面光线为梦境柔焦光 + 月光金色高光 + 深蓝夜幕环境光。人物面部清晰，皮肤细腻自然，礼裙材质有薄纱、珠光、刺绣和金属细节。整体效果要像高级纸艺梦境展览主视觉，华丽但不杂乱，人物主体明确，梦境层次丰富，文字完整，具有女性成长、绽放、自我发现和浪漫成熟的艺术海报气质。

cases.title: Product Launch Campaign Poster Template
cases.prompt:
【主题】：[产品类型]新品推广海报
【品牌名】：[品牌名]
【产品名】：[产品名]
【主标题大字】：[例如 SCENT / TIME / SOUND / EXPLORE]
【副标题】：[一句简短 Slogan]
【主色调】：[主色 + 辅助色 + 点缀色]
【人物类型】：[是否需要人物 / 男模特 / 女模特 / 户外人物 / 潮流人物]
【场景氛围】：[例如 香气空间 / 时间隧道 / 声波轨道 / 山路地形]
【功能卖点】：[卖点1]、[卖点2]、[卖点3]、[卖点4]
【画幅比例】：竖版 3:4

请生成一张竖版 3:4 的高清商业广告海报，单张图片，不要拼图，不要多宫格。

这是一个原创虚构品牌的产品推广海报，不要出现真实 brand Logo。整体风格是“产品推广型巨型文字透视海报”，画面要像正式发布的品牌 Campaign 主视觉，有商业广告感、强版式设计感、产品发布感、视觉冲击力和完整信息系统。

画面核心主体是[产品名]。产品必须清晰、精致、像广告里的 hero product，位于画面中前景或中央偏下位置。产品材质真实，结构完整，细节明确，不能太小，不能模糊。根据产品类型加入合适的人物或使用场景，例如女模特、男模特、潮流人物、户外人物、使用者动作或情绪氛围。人物要真实自然，姿态高级，能强化品牌气质，但不能抢走产品主体。

主标题[主标题大字]必须成为画面的核心视觉骨架，使用超大号粗体无衬线字体，占据画面主要空间。文字不能只是普通平面标题，而要成为画面的空间结构，可以变成背景墙、地面跑道、公路、坡道、时间隧道、声波轨道、香气空间、山路地形、透视装置或品牌主符号。产品、人物和巨型标题必须处在同一个空间逻辑中，形成真实的前后关系、遮挡关系、接触阴影 and 透视纵深。

cases.title: Brand Visual Proposal 4-Board Set
cases.prompt:
请根据用户输入的品牌信息，创作一套高完成度、具有统一视觉系统的「4张品牌视觉提案 / 4-Board Brand Visual Proposal」。

注意：这不是一张四宫格拼图，也不是把4张内容合并在同一个画面里的总图，而是一套需要“依次分别生成”的4张独立图片。你需要在同一个品牌视觉系统下，连续完成这4张图的生成。4张图必须明显属于同一个品牌，但每一张图承担不同职责，不能只是4张重复变体。

【用户输入】
品牌名：【品牌名】
品牌类型 / 行业：【品牌类型 / 行业】
一句话品牌定位：【一句话品牌定位】
核心关键词（3–6个）：【核心关键词】
目标人群：【目标人群】
整体风格方向：【整体风格方向】
Slogan：【Slogan】
主打产品 / 核心服务：【主打产品 / 核心服务】
品牌故事 / 地域特色：【品牌故事 / 地域特色】
主色调倾向：【主色调倾向】
辅助色倾向：【辅助色倾向】
是否需要IP角色：【是否需要IP角色：是 / 否】
IP角色方向：【IP角色方向】
希望偏重的应用方向：【包装 / 门店 / 海报 / 社媒 / 官网 / APP / 周边 / 其他】
希望避免的风格：【希望避免的风格】
画幅比例：【画幅比例】
其他补充说明：【其他补充说明】

【总任务】
请先基于以上信息，在内部提炼并统一这个品牌的视觉DNA，再基于同一个品牌DNA，依次分别生成4张独立图片。

在正式生成4张图之前，请先统一以下内容，并在后续4张图中始终保持一致：
1. 品牌核心气质
2. 品牌视觉关键词
3. 主色 / 辅色 / 点缀色
4. 字体倾向与字形气质
5. 图形语言 / 辅助图案语言
6. 产品或服务的视觉呈现方式
7. 是否使用IP角色，以及角色的设定方向
8. 适合该品牌的应用物料与传播场景
9. 整体画面气质：品牌感、提案感、商业感、展示感、系列感
10. 让4张图风格统一，但信息分工明确，不做成4张内容重复的变体

【整体统一要求】
1. 四张图必须明显属于同一个品牌系统，品牌名、色彩系统、字体气质、图形语言、品牌符号、IP角色（如有）、产品逻辑必须统一。
2. 四张图不是4张重复海报，而是4张不同职责的品牌视觉提案图。
3. 四张图都要具有高完成度、品牌提案感、商业感、展示感和作品集质量。
4. 版式可以有差异，但整体审美、设计语言和视觉系统必须高度统一。
5. 根据不同品牌类型自动匹配最合适的视觉应用内容：
   - 餐饮 / 饮品：包装、杯子、纸袋、瓶身、标签、门店、广告海报等
   - 美妆 / 快消：瓶器、盒装、礼盒、系列包装、陈列、广告KV等
   - 科技 / 数字品牌：官网首屏、APP界面、品牌卡片、数字场景、UI展示等
   - 文创 / IP / 零售：周边、贴纸、徽章、礼盒、手提袋、海报、门店等
6. 如果画面中出现文字，请保证品牌名、标题、模块名简洁清晰，具有品牌感，不要堆砌过多冗长文案。
7. 每张图都应适合独立展示，同时4张图放在一起时要明显看出是一整套提案。
8. 不要把四张图拼在一张图里，不要做四宫格，不要做一页总览拼贴。
9. 请按顺序依次生成：第1张 → 第2张 → 第3张 → 第4张。
10. 每次只生成当前这一张独立图片，并自动延续前面已经建立好的品牌系统，直到4张全部完成。

【四张图的固定结构与职责】

第1张：品牌主视觉封面图 / Brand Hero Board
这张图负责“定调”，是整套提案的封面图和第一视觉记忆点。
需要重点展示：
- 品牌名
- Slogan（如有）
- 品牌核心气质
- 品牌关键词的视觉转译
- 核心主视觉元素
- 主色系统
- 能代表该品牌的核心符号：产品、材质、图形、角色、视觉装置、氛围元素等
要求：
- 更偏封面图 / Hero Image，而不是说明书
- 画面有视觉冲击力和高级感
- 品牌感要强
- 信息不要太满，突出“第一眼记忆点”
- 如果品牌适合IP角色，可以出现，但它应服务整体品牌主视觉
目标：
让人一眼看出这个品牌是谁、气质是什么、第一印象是什么。

第2张：品牌识别系统图 / Identity System Board
这张图负责解释这个品牌的“视觉系统如何构成”。
需要重点展示：
- 品牌名 / 字标 / Logo感呈现
- 主色、辅色、点缀色
- 字体气质与字形风格
- 辅助图形 / 图案 / icon / sticker / label 语言
- 包装图案逻辑或品牌识别元素
- 如果适合，也可加入IP角色的系统化展示，如表情、动作、延展方式
要求：
- 比第1张更有结构感和提案感
- 更像品牌系统提案板，但不要僵硬得像传统VI手册
- 模块清晰，逻辑明确
- 审美要保持高级，不要做成信息堆砌
目标：
让人清楚理解这个品牌的视觉识别语言是如何建立起来的。

第3张：产品与包装应用图 / Product & Packaging Board
这张图负责展示品牌如何真正落到“产品 / 包装 / 服务载体”上，体现商业落地能力。
需要根据品牌类型自动匹配最合适的应用形式，例如：
- 餐饮 / 饮品：杯子、瓶身、杯套、纸袋、吸管套、包装盒、外卖袋、贴纸、标签等
- 美妆 / 快消：瓶器、罐装、盒装、礼盒、系列包装、货架陈列等
- 科技 / 数字品牌：官网首页、APP界面、品牌卡片、数字产品界面、服务展示等
- 文创 / IP / 零售：周边、徽章、贴纸、文具、礼盒、标签、包装延展等
要求：
- 重点体现“产品化 / 包装化 / 可售卖 / 可使用 / 可落地”
- 至少有一种主力应用载体，也可以有若干延展应用，但必须有主次
- 画面应具有真实商业摄影感、产品展示感或提案板陈列感
- 不要只是摆一堆东西，要看得出统一的品牌系统已经落地
目标：
让人看到这个品牌不仅有概念，也能真正变成可售卖、可使用、可执行的产品系统。

第4张：传播与场景应用图 / Campaign & Space Board
这张图负责展示品牌进入真实传播场景后的视觉效果，体现品牌辨识度、传播力与场景延展能力。
需要根据品牌类型自动匹配最合适的场景，例如：
- 门店外立面 / 店招 / 柜台 / 导视系统
- 海报KV / 社交媒体广告 / 立牌 / 灯箱 / 户外广告
- 快闪店 / 展台 / 品牌活动空间 / 陈列空间
- 官网首屏 / 社媒 feed / 数字传播界面
要求：
- 场景感要比第3张更强，要体现品牌进入真实世界后的传播效果
- 可以偏广告感、空间感、展示感，但仍要保留提案气质
- 不要与第3张重复成单纯包装展示图
- 品牌系统仍需保持统一：品牌名、色彩、字体、图形、IP角色（如有）、调性都要一致
目标：
让人看到这个品牌在真实传播和应用场景中具有鲜明辨识度和强烈品牌表现力。

【执行方式】
请严格按照以下流程执行：
1. 先内部理解并统一品牌视觉DNA。
2. 然后开始生成第1张图：品牌主视觉封面图。
3. 在保持同一品牌系统的前提下，继续生成第2张图：品牌识别系统图。
4. 在保持同一品牌系统的前提下，继续生成第3张图：产品与包装应用图。
5. 在保持同一品牌系统的前提下，继续生成第4张图：传播与场景应用图。
6. 整个过程中，不要把4张图合并成一张，不要变成四宫格，不要让4张图内容重复。
7. 请始终记住：这是同一个品牌的连续4张品牌视觉提案图，不是4个不同项目。

【最终目标】
输出一套4张独立但高度统一的品牌视觉提案图：
- 第1张负责定调
- 第2张负责解释系统
- 第3张负责产品落地
- 第4张负责传播与场景落地

整套结果应具备：
统一的品牌视觉DNA、清晰的页面分工、高完成度的审美、商业提案感、展示感、作品集质量，以及可直接用于品牌概念展示的效果。

可见文字: 主标题“SPRING BOUQUET”，中文小字“今日花材到店 / 19:00 前可自取”，角落放“从一束明亮开始”。

cases.title: Premium UGC Ad Poster Template
cases.prompt:
Create a premium UGC-style advertising poster for [Product] by [Brand]. Use the product as the clear hero of the image and preserve the product shape, packaging, logo, label, colors, proportions, and readable text with strong visual accuracy.

Design the image as a powerful commercial poster with a bold editorial feel and a high-impact visual hook. The scene should feel like a real viral UGC moment elevated into a luxury campaign. Show a human hand naturally interacting with the product in a dynamic action moment such as grabbing it, tossing it, spraying it, opening it, pouring it, unboxing it, or pushing it toward the camera. Capture the exact split second of action with strong cinematic tension and scroll-stopping energy.

Add product-related action effects that enhance the visual hook, such as frozen splashes, flying particles, dust bursts, liquid trails, mist, shattered texture bursts, energetic motion blur, glow accents, or floating ingredients depending on the product category. The action should feel bold, intentional, premium, and visually irresistible.

Make the product the sharpest and most dominant subject in the frame. The composition should feel like a polished advertising poster, not just a casual photo. Use dramatic editorial lighting, clean rim light, realistic reflections, crisp focus, shallow depth of field, premium contrast, cinematic color grading, and a refined luxury commercial finish.

Include the brand logo clearly and tastefully as part of the poster design, either on the product packaging and/or as a clean design element in the composition. Also include one strong advertising slogan made of exactly 3 words:
"[Slogan]"

The slogan must feel bold, memorable, premium, and campaign-worthy. Place it in a visually powerful way, using clean high-end typography and a layout that supports the product without overpowering it.

Composition: vertical poster, 4:5 or 9:16, dynamic close-up or medium-close framing, product large in the foreground, partial human presence, strong negative space, premium ad layout, viral commercial energy.

Mood: bold, premium, modern, playful, energetic, stylish, addictive, visually striking.

No fake branding, no distorted logo, no unreadable packaging, no messy anatomy, no cheap CGI, no cluttered layout, no weak composition, no duplicated product, no watermark.

cases.title: Cozy Japanese Lifestyle Illustration Template
cases.prompt:
Create a delicate contemporary Japanese lifestyle illustration with a cozy slice-of-life atmosphere.

ART STYLE
Hand-drawn pen-and-ink sketch illustration, thin expressive linework, loose imperfect contours, minimalist editorial artwork, soft watercolor washes, subtle paper texture, elegant negative space, sketchbook aesthetic, modern Japanese indie illustration, light and airy composition, contemporary café-art style, emotionally warm and intimate.

CHARACTERS
Two young adults with soft, simplified facial features and natural expressions. Casual oversized clothing, relaxed body language, authentic interaction, candid everyday moment. Faces are minimally rendered with delicate linework rather than detailed realism.

ENVIRONMENT
A cozy indoor setting such as a café, coffee shop, apartment, studio, bookstore, kitchen corner, or creative workspace. Include wooden furniture, coffee mugs, indoor plants, shelves, books, windows, soft decorative details, and small everyday objects. The environment should feel lived-in yet uncluttered.

COMPOSITION
Full-body or three-quarter-body view. Characters seated naturally and facing one another. Balanced asymmetrical layout. Large areas of clean negative space. Storytelling through posture and atmosphere rather than action. Editorial illustration framing. Eye-level perspective.

COLOR PALETTE
Muted and desaturated colors only:
• Dusty blue
• Warm cream
• Soft beige
• Light gray
• Sage green
• Warm brown
• Off-white

Add only one small accent color element such as red socks, red shoes, a red mug, or a small red object.

Soft natural daylight entering through windows. Gentle ambient illumination. No dramatic shadows. Warm, peaceful, calming mood.

RENDERING
Minimal shading. Sparse details. Watercolor-style color fills inside delicate ink outlines. Slightly unfinished sketch quality. High-quality illustration with visible hand-drawn imperfections. Soft edges and subtle texture.

MOOD
Comfortable, quiet, nostalgic, peaceful, intimate, cozy, everyday happiness, slow living, café culture, thoughtful conversation, gentle human connection.

AVOID
Anime screenshots, manga panels, cel shading, digital painting, hyperrealism, photorealism, 3D rendering, glossy surfaces, vibrant saturated colors, cinematic effects, dramatic lighting, excessive details, sharp outlines, heavy shadows, complex backgrounds.

[Scene Description]

The final image should feel like a premium Japanese lifestyle illustration found in an art book, café magazine, design journal, or independent sketchbook collection.

cases.title: Premium Product Poster Prompt Template
cases.prompt:
You are an elite advertising creative director, brand strategist, and prompt engineer specialized in generating premium product-poster prompts.

Your task is to create one final, polished, high-end image-generation prompt based on the brand and product I provide.

Inputs:
- Brand: [Brand Name]
- Product: [Product Name]

Decision logic:
1. First, evaluate whether the brand and product are well-known, visually recognizable, and clear enough to proceed confidently.
2. If the brand and product are clearly known, do not ask for a product image. Use your internal knowledge and, if available, online research to understand the product, its form, brand identity, category cues, and visual language.
3. If the brand is known but the exact product is unclear, niche, highly specific, newly launched, or visually uncertain, do not guess. Ask only for the missing essentials needed to proceed accurately, such as:
   - product image
   - logo
   - packaging reference
   - any key brand asset if necessary
4. If the brand itself is unclear or not recognizable enough, ask briefly for the relevant references before continuing.
5. Never ask for unnecessary materials when the product is already well-known.

Core objective:
Create a world-class advertising poster prompt for [Brand Name] featuring [Product Name].

The final poster concept must automatically adapt to the brand’s DNA. Infer and translate the brand’s:
- visual language
- emotional positioning
- market category
- product nature
- design sensibility
- cultural perception
- premium cues
into an original, premium, poster-worthy campaign concept.

The brand and product must naturally determine:
- mood
- color logic
- lighting direction
- material treatment
- environment
- composition
- typography feel
- styling
- framing
- emotional tone
- visual hook

Creative standards:
- Make the product the clear hero.
- Create a visually striking, premium, ad-level poster with a strong and memorable hook.
- The result must feel bold, polished, iconic, scroll-stopping, and art-directed at a world-class campaign level.
- Avoid generic compositions, safe layouts, or flat catalog-style results.
- Avoid creating something that feels like a reusable template pasted onto different brands.
- The poster must feel specifically invented for that exact brand and product.
- Capture the spirit of the brand without copying any existing real campaign.
- Reinterpret the essence of the brand through a fresh, original, modern, and commercially powerful concept.
- Aim for luxury editorial precision, cinematic control, and strong visual hierarchy.
- Prioritize a poster-worthy visual idea that immediately stands out in a fast-scrolling social feed.

Diversity rule:
If this framework is used across multiple brands or products, every output must feel like a completely different creative universe.
Do not repeat or recycle the same:
- camera angle
- environment
- lighting treatment
- product pose
- layout structure
- typography arrangement
- color treatment
- material language
- visual hook
- storytelling logic

Every result must feel freshly art-directed from scratch and uniquely derived from that brand’s DNA.

Output behavior:
- If enough information is available, output only one final, polished, image-generation prompt in English.
- Do not output analysis, explanations, or multiple options.
- Do not describe your reasoning.
- Do not ask follow-up questions unless essential information is genuinely missing.
- If essential information is missing, ask for it briefly and efficiently in the shortest useful way.

Final goal:
Deliver a crazy-good, premium, brand-specific advertising poster prompt that feels visually distinct, strategically sharp, commercially strong, and creatively elevated depending on the brand and product entered.

cases.title: Swiss Style Moscow Poster Template
cases.prompt:
Design a contemporary Swiss Style editorial poster for Moscow, Russia. Use a large bold sans-serif capital letter “M” as the main typographic structure. The “M” must be very clear, clean, geometric, solid, and dominant, with no stroke outline, no border, no shadow outline, and no decorative treatment. The silhouette of the letter “M” must remain easy to read at first glance. Do not let the illustration obscure or distort the shape of the letter. The poster should follow a precise left-aligned Swiss grid system with generous negative space.

Inside the “M”, create a simple, logical, and restrained flat illustration of Moscow’s city landscape character. Use only a few essential visual elements: simplified modern skyscrapers inspired by Moscow City business district, the calm curve of the Moscow River, a subtle silhouette of the Kremlin walls and towers, onion domes of Saint Basil’s Cathedral in a simplified geometric form, a soft green park landscape inspired by Gorky Park or Zaryadye Park, and two pedestrians on a clean riverside walkway. Keep the composition minimal, spacious, and easy to understand. Do not add too many landmarks, people, signs, vehicles, monuments, statues, fountains, trains, buses, or small decorative objects.

The illustration should suggest Moscow’s identity as a capital city where imperial history, Soviet monumental scale, modern glass skyscrapers, riverfront public spaces, and vast urban rhythm coexist in a clean contemporary way. Use flat vector shapes, clean silhouettes, minimal linework, simplified architecture, and believable scale relationships. Keep the scene lightly lively but not busy. The illustration should support the letter “M”, not compete with it.

Allow only extremely subtle overlap outside the “M” frame using simple organic or atmospheric elements only: a few leaves from riverside trees or soft atmospheric mist over the river may slightly extend beyond the letter edge. Keep 97% of the illustration inside the “M”. Do not let people, buildings, domes, towers, vehicles, faces, paths, signage, or complex objects overlap outside the letter. The “M” must remain clearly readable and visually dominant.

Place the headline “Moscow” below the letter in bold sans-serif type, title case, not all caps, left aligned to the same grid. Under the headline, add this short body paragraph in small regular sans-serif text, also left aligned, with clean spacing and refined editorial hierarchy:

“Moscow moves through grand historic layers, monumental architecture, river bends, and a dense modern skyline. Between imperial heritage, Soviet scale, and contemporary urban energy, the city holds a character that is powerful, structured, and constantly evolving.”

No icons, no badges, no decorative symbols. The overall design should feel Swiss minimalist: strong grid, precise alignment, asymmetrical balance, clean typography, generous negative space, restrained composition, and modern cultural city poster aesthetics.

Color palette: warm ivory background, deep navy or charcoal typography, concrete gray, glass blue, pine green, Kremlin red accents, river blue-gray, pale beige, and soft black accents. Matte paper finish, subtle paper grain, crisp edges, flat contemporary illustration, modern Moscow metropolitan mood, calm but strong, sophisticated, balanced, and print-ready.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, glossy, maximalist, overcrowded city, complex illustration, too many details, too many landmarks

cases.title: Post-Impressionist Lotus Poster Design Template
cases.prompt:
A flat illustration poster in post-impressionist style. White background with generous white space. All text is left-aligned.

[LAYOUT — TOP BAR]
At the very top of the poster, a single line with three items in the same small serif font: "2025" flush left, "POSTER DESIGN" centered, "2025" flush right. Use the smallest readable font size.

[LAYOUT — LEFT COLUMN, TOP TO BOTTOM]
1. Series name in large display serif font, two lines, left-aligned, black:
   Flora
   & Reverie 

2. Chinese title in small-weight Song typeface (宋体), slightly smaller than the series name:
   荷风素影
   (render correctly as Han characters)

3. English subtitle in the same fine serif, one size smaller:
   Lotus, Pure Shadows on Still Water

[LAYOUT — BOTTOM]
4. At the very bottom left, a Chinese tagline in tiny Song typeface:
   出淤泥而不染，亭亭净植于夏
5. Below it, the smallest font size in the composition, a multi-line English paragraph, left-aligned:
   There is a particular silence that belongs only to midsummer ponds. The lotus rises through it — unhurried, unsoiled — and opens not to be admired, but simply because it is time. That quiet insistence is a kind of philosophy. Not defiance. Just clarity.

[ILLUSTRATION STYLE]
The main illustration fills the right half and center of the poster, bleeding slightly off the right and top edges. Subject: lotus flowers in full bloom with large circular leaves, one seed pod visible.

Painting style: post-impressionist, plein-air watercolor-oil hybrid. Loose, gestural brushstrokes with visible paint texture. Impressionist color mixing — petals show overlapping washes of blush pink, celadon green, ivory white. Background is pure white paper, seamlessly blending into the composition. Soft-focus bokeh effect on background elements. The overall mood is midsummer noon stillness, water-heavy air: dreamlike, cooling, luminous.

Composition: extreme close-up crop, one large fully open lotus dominant in the foreground, stem rising from below the frame. A second bloom slightly behind and to the right, partially open. One large round leaf curving at the top edge. A green seed pod in the mid-ground.

Color: bright palette dominated by blush pink, celadon green, ivory white. Blue-gray shadows in petal undersides. Deep jade green on leaf surfaces with lighter veining. No saturated backgrounds — keep everything luminous against white.

[OVERALL]
The text portion (left side) has a clean white background — no illustration overlaps the text. The illustration occupies the right 60% and top area. The poster feels like a page from a botanical sketchbook elevated to editorial design. Aspect ratio: 3:4 (portrait). No borders or frames.

cases.prompt:
Create a photorealistic live football television broadcast spectator cutaway using the uploaded image only as the facial identity reference.

The subject is attending a FIFA World Cup 2026 match between Argentina and Algeria at New York New Jersey Stadium, New Jersey, and is supporting Argentina.

Preserve the subject's exact facial identity, skin tone, age, facial proportions, hairstyle, ethnicity and overall appearance. Use the reference image only for identity. Do not copy the original pose, head angle or expression.

Scene:
The subject is inside a premium VIP hospitality suite behind a clear glass railing overlooking the pitch. This is a candid television broadcast moment. The subject is completely unaware of the camera and fully focused on the match.

Outfit:

- Official Argentina home jersey (light blue and white stripes)
- Elegant dark navy blazer or cardigan
- Black trousers
- FIFA-style event lanyard
- Slim watch
- Small Argentina scarf draped naturally

Pose:

- Body turned approximately 45 degrees toward the pitch
- Head follows the same direction
- Head upright, neck straight, shoulders relaxed
- Both hands resting naturally on the glass railing
- Fingers relaxed and realistic
- No waving, thumbs-up or camera-facing gestures

Expression:
Tense and hopeful, as if watching an important Argentina attack late in the match. Eyebrows slightly tightened and lips slightly parted.

Camera:
Authentic live sports broadcast angle using a 200–400mm telephoto lens. Waist-up framing with natural asymmetrical composition. Face and eyes perfectly sharp while surrounding spectators are slightly softer.

Environment:
Include five supporting spectators around the subject, partially cropped at the edges, wearing Argentina and Algeria jerseys or refined matchday clothing. Everyone is looking toward the pitch.

Add softly blurred heads, scarves and raised hands in the foreground for realistic stadium depth. Include subtle glass reflections, premium suite details and a softly blurred crowd background.

Lighting:
Realistic stadium lighting mixed with soft VIP-suite ambient light and reflected pitch lighting. Natural skin texture, realistic fabric folds and mild live-broadcast compression.

Scoreboard:
Top-left professional football broadcast scoreboard.

Time: 73:18
Score: 🇦🇷 ARG 2 🏆 🇫🇷 FRA 2

Design:
Small white rounded timer box, dark charcoal team boxes, accurate flags, bright cyan score boxes, central white box with a black-and-gold trophy icon. Sharp, compact and readable. No "LIVE" text.

The final image must look like a genuine spontaneous television broadcast still from the FIFA World Cup 2026, not a studio portrait, advertisement, CGI or illustration.

Photorealistic, authentic candid spectator cutaway, realistic anatomy, natural hands and fingers, broadcast-quality 4K, aspect ratio 4:5.

cases.title: Cinematic Product Advertising Poster Template
cases.prompt:
Create a premium advertising poster for [Brand] featuring [Product].

Use the product’s core material, texture, surface, ingredient, or sensory quality as the main creative idea.

Transform that material into a cinematic world around the product while keeping the product accurate, recognizable, and visually dominant.

The environment should feel like it was born from the product itself:
- metal becomes architecture, reflections, precision, and strength
- glass becomes light, transparency, glow, and elegance
- fabric becomes movement, folds, wind, and lifestyle energy
- foam becomes softness, comfort, sound, or freshness
- liquid becomes splashes, waves, droplets, taste, or motion
- leather becomes luxury, warmth, shadows, and tactile richness
- powder becomes particles, clouds, softness, and atmosphere
- food texture becomes crumbs, sauce, steam, melting, or flavor impact

Build a bold visual hook where the product appears to control or reshape the world around it.

Use premium commercial photography, cinematic studio lighting, realistic materials, strong shadows, sharp product detail, shallow depth of field, polished reflections, strong visual hierarchy, and campaign-level finishing.

Add tasteful poster typography inspired by the brand’s visual language, with a short 3-word slogan.

The final image should feel premium, iconic, scroll-stopping, and specifically art-directed for this exact brand and product.

Avoid copying any existing campaign. Create a fresh original visual universe.

Aspect ratio: [Ratio]

cases.title: Painterly Animation Style Prompt Template
cases.prompt:
You are a prompt writer for a stylized visual development engine.

Your task is to take the user’s text prompt, uploaded image, or both, then rewrite the idea as one finished image prompt in a specific painterly editorial animation style.

The subject can be anything: a person, animal, creature, object, machine, building, landscape, vehicle, costume, symbol, or abstract scene. Do not lock the style to the reference subject. Lock the style to the visual grammar.

If the user provides text only, preserve the subject, action, setting, mood, and stated constraints. Translate those ideas into the target style without adding unrelated story, props, genre elements, or decorative noise.

If the user provides an image only, study its silhouette, palette, lighting, texture, edge treatment, composition, surface behavior, and emotional tone. If the user asks for style, extract only the style and do not copy the subject. If the user asks for a prompt based on the image, describe both the subject and the style.

If the user provides both text and image, the text controls the subject and explicit instructions. The image controls only the requested visual reference, such as style, palette, shape language, pose, mood, lighting, surface, edge quality, or composition.

Write the final output as one polished image prompt. Do not explain your reasoning. Do not include headings unless the user asks for them. Do not include model names, parameter syntax, negative prompt sections, or technical camera metadata unless the user explicitly requests them.

Target style:

The image should feel like a hand painted animation development plate pulled from an old studio archive: graphic, sharp, expressive, weathered, and shaped by visible judgment.

Build the picture around one dominant silhouette. The subject must read instantly as a black and white shape before color or detail matters. Use exaggerated proportion as design logic: long narrow supports, swollen primary masses, sharp peaks, sagging curves, compressed joints, pinched transitions, awkward imbalance, and weight that feels slightly wrong but deliberately chosen. Every distortion must reveal character, function, mood, motion, or age.

Favor vertical shape rhythm. Let the subject rise, slump, bend, lean, stretch, perch, or collapse through the frame. Preserve strong negative space around it. Avoid crowded staging. The image should feel like a poster, a character plate, a printed theatre card, or a page torn from a production sketchbook.

Use a limited, weathered palette. Build the image from desaturated blue gray, green gray, smoke teal, bone white, ink black, dirty cream, and cold shadow. Keep color quiet and controlled. Let black carry the structure. Let white carry the strike of light. Let the blue gray ground hold the silence around the subject. Use a single accent only when it has a clear visual purpose.

Organize the image into three hard value families: pale light, muted atmospheric midtone, and heavy ink shadow. Do not model every form smoothly. Use bold shadow shapes under forms, inside openings, beneath overlaps, behind joints, and at weight bearing points. Place highlights sparingly. Make them small, sharp, and decisive.

Render with ink, dry brush, digital gouache, and worn print texture. The surface must show drag, pressure, scrape, grain, rubbed edges, broken coverage, scuffed corners, faded corners, and uneven pigment. Keep brush marks visible. Make the background feel stained, rolled, scratched, and aged rather than clean.

Use line as character. Outer contours should change weight constantly: thick at weight, thin at tension, broken at lost edges, sharp at points of attitude. Internal lines should be sparse and nervous, like quick construction marks left inside the final painting. Avoid clean comic outlines and uniform vector lines.

Let edges carry emotion. Use knife sharp protrusions, corners, folds, branches, spires, claws, tools, panels, or torn shapes when the subject needs bite. Use drooping curves, soft bags, bent limbs, warped panels, sagging fabric, hunched forms, or collapsed geometry when the subject needs fatigue, age, comedy, or defeat. Balance elegance with ugliness. Balance charm with unease.

Keep backgrounds restrained. Use a flat painted field with distressed borders, scratched ink residue, dry brush noise, paper grain, darkened upper corners, worn margins, and subtle tonal stains. The background should frame the subject like an old printed plate, not describe a full environment unless the user requests one.

Detail belongs only at the focal point. Eyes, hands, mouth, joints, hinges, openings, tools, symbols, labels, fractures, or key material breaks may receive sharper treatment. Everything else should simplify into shape, value, and texture. Leave some forms unfinished. Let absence hold space.

The final prompt should produce an image that reads clearly from far away, rewards close inspection with tactile surface marks, and feels shaped by deliberate visual decisions rather than automatic description.

cases.title: Japanese Woman Street Portrait Film Style
cases.imageAlt: Japanese Woman Street Portrait Film Style
cases.prompt:
主題：白線と影

人物・表情：
20代女性。明るいアイボリーベージュ寄りの白肌に、ほんのりピンクの血色を含んだ自然な肌質。頬、鼻先、鎖骨に柔らかなハイライト。精密で上品なドールライク日系メイク、淡いローズピンクのチーク、シャンパンベージュとピンクブラウンの目元、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、明るめブラウンの柔らかい眉、透け感のあるピンクベージュのグロスリップ。瞳に小さなキャッチライト。静かに見上げる、少し余韻のある表情。

服装・ポーズ：
深い黒に近いネイビーの和モダンなラップワンピース。長袖、重なりのあるVライン、腰で布を結んだようなドレープ、落ち感のある柔らかな生地。身体は画面下側に立ち、上半身を少し後ろへ預ける。顔はカメラへ向けて上げ、右手はスカートの布を軽く持ち、左腕は自然に体側へ落とす。姿勢は大人っぽく、静かな緊張感を残す。

背景・光：
日本の都市のアスファルト道路。白い道路標示が斜めに入り、画面左上に歩道の縁石が少し見える。強い午後の太陽が画面左上から差し、顔と髪、胸元を明るく照らす。人物の影は画面左下へ長く伸び、画面右上には建物の濃い影が大きく落ちる。白線、影、アスファルトの粒感をはっきり描写する。

構図・カメラ：
1:1の正方形。高い位置から見下ろす俯瞰ポートレート。人物は画面下中央寄りに配置し、道路の余白を広く残す。カメラは真上より少し斜め、人物の視線はレンズへ向かう。中距離のストリートポートレート、背景まで質感が残る自然な被写界深度。

質感・スタイル：
富士カメラのフィルムシミュレーションを思わせる写真感。クラシッククローム風の落ち着いた色調、やや抑えた彩度、暖かい肌色、少し冷たい深い影、柔らかなハイライトの粘り、繊細なフィルム粒子。過度なHDRや強いシャープネスは避け、リアルな日系ストリート写真として仕上げる。

ネガティブ：
不自然な顔や視線、幼い顔、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌、髪の塊感、余分な指、欠けた指、手足の融合、服の破綻、道路標示の文字化け、不要な人物や車、ロゴ、透かし、過度なHDR。

cases.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic editorial studio photograph set against a smooth off-white seamless backdrop with a bright, airy minimalist aesthetic.

A fun-loving young woman with a pastel blue pixie cut is captured in a spontaneous moment of playful escape. She bursts into laughter while jogging forward, her smile wide and genuine, eyes nearly closed from amusement. Her posture shows energetic movement as she tries to continue running despite being gently held back, creating a humorous tug-of-war effect.

Natural mid-stride running motion.

One leg lifted slightly off the floor.

Arms moving freely with realistic running dynamics.

One hand confidently holding a vibrant rainbow spiral lollipop.

Subtle motion in the hair and clothing.

Strong sense of forward momentum with believable body mechanics.

Loose oversized powder-blue sweatshirt.

Round eyeglasses casually resting atop her head rather than covering her eyes.

The tension creates realistic folds and pull lines in the sweatshirt while subtly drawing her shoulders backward even as her body continues moving forward.

Small sketch-style motion marks around the doodle's arm suggest effort and resistance. Additional playful doodle accents around the woman's head emphasize her laughter, excitement, and movement.

Details

Anatomically accurate hands and fingers.

Clear visibility of both hands despite oversized sleeves.

Realistic grip and proportions on the lollipop.

Convincing fabric tension and clothing physics.

Bright high-key lighting with soft natural shadows.

Clean editorial lifestyle photography aesthetic.

Humorous visual storytelling.

Wholesome and playful mood.

cases.imageAlt: Woman Jumping Morning Lake Fashion Photo
cases.prompt:
主題：
朝へ跳ぶ

人物・表情：
20代女性。少女のような軽やかさと、大人っぽい清潔感をあわせ持つ顔立ち。長い黒髪は朝の風でふわりと後方へ流れ、前髪と顔まわりの毛束が自然に揺れている。明るいアイボリーベージュ寄りの白肌で、ほんのりピンクの血色を含んだなめらかな質感。頬、鼻先、肩、鎖骨に柔らかなハイライト。淡いローズピンクのチーク、シャンパンベージュとピンクブラウンの目元、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、明るめブラウンの柔らかなアーチ眉。唇は透け感のあるピンクベージュのグロス。表情は朝空を見上げるような、開放感のある自然な笑顔。

服装・ポーズ：
白いシンプルなトップスに、淡いピンクとアイボリーが混ざる薄手のシアーシャツを羽織る。シャツは朝光を透かし、袖と裾が風で軽く広がる。黒のハイウエストミニスカート、細めの黒ベルト、黒のレースアップショートブーツ。水面のすぐ上で跳ね上がった瞬間。身体は少し画面右へ開き、人物自身の右腕を高く伸ばして指先を空へ向ける。人物自身の左腕は画面左下へ自然に広げ、指先は力を抜く。片脚は軽く曲げ、もう片脚は下へ伸び、足元に小さな水しぶきが立つ。

背景・光：
早朝の湖畔または浅い水辺。澄んだ青空に白い雲が広がり、大小のシャボン玉が上空へ浮かんでいる。遠景に低い山並みと緑の岸辺。主光源は画面下奥の朝日で、人物の脚、髪、肩、シアーシャツの縁を逆光気味に照らす。顔には水面と空からの柔らかな反射光が入り、影は薄く自然。水面には空、雲、人物の脚とブーツが淡く映り込む。

構図・カメラ：
縦長 2:3。ローアングルの全身ポートレート。人物は画面中央やや上に配置し、全身が入る。足元の水面と反射を下部に残し、上部には青空とシャボン玉の余白を大きく取る。カメラは水面近くの低い位置から見上げる。広角寄りだが歪みは控えめ。人物の顔と上半身にピントを合わせ、背景の山並みは少し柔らかくする。

質感・スタイル：
リアルな朝のファッション写真。自然な肌理、髪の細い毛束、シアー素材の透け感、スカートの布の重なり、ブーツの革の質感、水しぶきと反射を丁寧に描写。明るく透明感のある色調、白飛びしすぎない朝日、軽いレンズフレア。AIイラストではなく、実際に屋外で撮影したようなフォトリアル表現。

ネガティブ：
過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌、白飛びした顔、不自然な笑顔、余分または欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、不自然な浮遊感、足元と水面の接触不良、反射のずれ、光源と矛盾する影、スカートやシャツの物理破綻、不要な人物、文字、ロゴ、透かし。

cases.prompt: Create a charming editorial travel illustration of [Destination] in a simple hand-drawn doodled style, as if sketched by hand with a black felt-tip marker in a travel notebook. The illustration should feel personal, spontaneous, and imperfect rather than digitally designed. Think of the kind of drawing someone might casually create while sitting at a café after exploring the destination. ## COLOR PALETTE Keep the illustration almost entirely black and white. Use only one accent color: [One Point Color] ## STYLE Draw entirely with black felt-tip pen lines. Use slightly wobbly hand-drawn contours, natural line variation, loose marker strokes, sketch-like confidence, subtle imperfections, slightly open line endings, uneven hand pressure, and occasional overlapping strokes. Every line should clearly look handmade. Avoid perfectly smooth curves, mechanically precise outlines, polished vector graphics, or overly crisp digital rendering. ## SUBJECT Illustrate the unique atmosphere and instantly recognizable identity of [Destination] rather than producing a realistic cityscape. Select the destination's most iconic landmarks, characteristic architecture, local transportation, famous scenery, native plants, local animals, regional food, and cultural objects. Focus on the spirit of the destination instead of literal accuracy. ## COMPOSITION Arrange the selected elements into a balanced editorial composition with generous white space. The layout should feel open, light, and effortless, similar to a designer's travel sketchbook. Allow objects to overlap naturally without becoming crowded. Every element should have room to breathe. Keep the composition visually relaxed and uncluttered. Apply the blue sparingly to selected details such as water, sky, windows, signs, clothing accents, decorative highlights, or small architectural features. Never introduce any additional colors. ## DRAWING STYLE Keep every object simple and intentionally simplified. Use flat shapes with minimal interior detail. Avoid realistic textures, gradients, shadows, painterly brushwork, glossy surfaces, or complex rendering. The illustration should remain clean, airy, understated, and highly graphic. ## LINE QUALITY The black marker lines are the main visual feature. Lines should feel confident, casual, lively, expressive, and naturally imperfect. Slightly uneven contours, open edges, variable line thickness, and small drawing inaccuracies are encouraged because they enhance the authentic hand-drawn feeling. ## MOOD Warm. Friendly. Relaxed. Playful. Minimal. Editorial. Contemporary. Elegant through simplicity. The finished artwork should resemble a beautifully designed travel notebook, boutique travel guide, editorial magazine illustration, or lifestyle sketchbook rather than a polished digital illustration. ## IMPORTANT No photorealism. No 3D rendering. No painterly effects. No gradients. No heavy shadows. No glossy lighting. No vector-clean artwork. No excessive detail. No busy composition. Preserve generous white space. Maintain a flat editorial doodle aesthetic with a distinctly handmade character. The final image should instantly evoke [Destination] through simple, expressive black felt-tip sketches with subtle sky-blue accents.

cases.title: Negative Space Product Advertising Poster
cases.prompt:
Create a premium advertising poster for [BRAND] featuring [PRODUCT].

Use the brand’s logo, icon, letterform, label shape, packaging frame, or signature silhouette as a true negative-space frame.

Build a cinematic visual world inside that negative-space shape that expresses the product’s story, emotion, origin, texture, function, craft, flavor, scent, sound, or brand promise.

The outside canvas must stay clean, minimal, elegant, and controlled.

The inside of the shape must feel rich, atmospheric, detailed, and visually immersive.

The hero product must not be trapped inside the frame.

Make the product break out of the negative-space boundary in a premium, intentional way:
part of the product stays inside the visual world, while part of it extends beyond the frame into the clean outer space.

This frame-breaking moment should create depth, tension, hierarchy, and a strong campaign-level visual hook.

The negative space must feel literal and professional — not just a simple image mask. The silhouette should clearly shape the composition, while the product interacts with it naturally and powerfully.

Adapt the execution to the brand DNA:
- tech should feel clean, precise, futuristic, and intelligent
- fragrance and beauty should feel elegant, sensual, refined, and atmospheric
- food should feel rich, appetizing, textured, and indulgent
- fashion should feel editorial, stylish, cultural, and dynamic
- audio should feel immersive, energetic, tactile, and cinematic
- luxury should feel restrained, polished, timeless, and expensive

Use premium commercial photography, cinematic lighting, refined typography, strong contrast, polished shadows, realistic materials, sharp product detail, high-end composition, and world-class ad finishing.

Add tasteful poster typography inspired by the brand’s visual language with a short 3-word slogan.

Do not use miniature people, tiny worlds, micro cities, product monuments, or exploded-view composition.

Avoid copying any existing real campaign. Create a fresh original negative-space advertisement.

Brand: [BRAND]
Product: [PRODUCT]
Aspect ratio: [RATIO]

cases.prompt:
あなたは、トップクラスの広告クリエイティブディレクター、アートディレクター、トラベルフォトグラファー、エディトリアルデザイナー、そして日本語タイポグラフィの専門家です。

添付された NEWTのロゴを必ず使用し、NEWTの旅行アプリ広告として成立する、縦長4:5の高品質な実写エディトリアルポスターを制作してください。

このポスターで狙うべきなのは、単に美しい旅行広告をつくることではありません。
スマホ上で一瞬見ただけで視線を止め、見る人に

* 旅に出たくなる
* この世界観が好きだと感じる
* NEWTで続きを見たくなる

という感情を起こさせてください。

⸻

1. 画面全体のトーン

全体の印象は、明るい / 透明感がある / 高彩度 / 都会的 / 洗練されていること。
ベースは NEWT Green としつつ、そこに スカイブルー、ターコイズ、サンセットオレンジ、蛍光イエロー などの鮮やかな色を 1〜2色だけ効果的に加える こと。

以下の方向は避けてください。

* 暗い室内中心の画面
* 灰色ベースで沈んだ印象
* 安価なパッケージツアー広告のような見え方
* 古い旅行チラシのようなレイアウト

⸻

2. 写真表現と人物設計

広告の核は、高品質な実写の旅行ビジュアルです。
以下の要素を、1枚のポスターの中で強く統合してください。

* 旅行者
* 空港
* ホテル
* 都市風景
* 海
* 食
* スマホ上のアプリ体験

人物は、日本人または東アジア系の架空モデルで構成してください。
有名人に似せる必要はありません。自然な表情、自然な肌、自然な手元表現を重視してください。

服装は、普通の仕事着や無難な服ではなく、旅行広告として映えるスタイリングにしてください。
旅行に出る高揚感や、都市的で感度の高いライフスタイルが伝わる見え方が理想です。

⸻

3. 構図は「大胆に変形」すること

よくある「人物・文字・ロゴを素直に配置しただけ」の広告にはしないでください。
このポスターは、形そのものが記憶に残る構図である必要があります。

特に以下のような設計を歓迎します。

* NEWTの亀ロゴのシルエットを、巨大なフレームや抜き型として使い、その中に旅の風景を展開する
* 画面を、大きな円、波形、チケット型、アプリカード型、地図線などで大胆に分ける
* 写真を単純な長方形で整列させず、斜め・曲線・切り抜き・重なりで構成する
* 巨大な日本語タイポグラフィを写真にぶつけ、文字の一部が画面外に切れるような勢いをつくる
* スマホUI、航空券カード、ホテルカード、地図ピン、フライトラインをグラフィック要素として自然に重ねる
* 無難な左右分割は避け、ズレ、余白、裁ち落とし、重なりによって視線が止まる違和感を必ずつくる

⸻

4. 必ず入れるコピー

メインコピー

次の旅が、もう始まってる。

サブコピー

航空券も、ホテルも、アプリひとつで軽やかに。

CTA

NEWTで旅をみる

小さな英字

TRAVEL FEELS NEW.

⸻

5. 文字の扱い

このポスターでは、日本語タイポグラフィを最重要のビジュアル要素として設計してください。
ただ文字を読ませるだけではなく、文字そのものが画面の主役になる状態を目指してください。

避けるべきなのは、以下のような処理です。

* 白文字を置いただけの単純な見出し
* 既成フォントをそのまま流し込んだだけの処理
* Canvaテンプレートのような見え方
* LPのファーストビュー風の処理
* 値引きバナーのような安い見せ方

推奨する文字処理は以下です。

* 巨大なアウトライン文字
* 極太ゴシック
* 長体処理
* 縦組みと横組みの併用
* 裁ち落とし
* 写真への食い込み
* タイポと人物・風景・UIの一体化

⸻

6. ロゴの使い方

NEWTロゴは必ず使用してください。
ただし、単に隅に貼るのではなく、ポスター全体の構造に溶け込むかたちで自然に機能させること。
ブランドとして認識できる必要はありますが、ロゴだけが浮いて見える状態は避けてください。

⸻

7. 最終的に目指す完成度

仕上がりは、以下の要素を横断したようなクオリティにしてください。

* 都市型のトラベルキャンペーン広告
* 感度の高いカルチャー誌の旅特集扉
* 航空会社のシーズンビジュアル
* ホテルブランドの上質な広告表現

つまり、明るく、洗練され、高予算感があり、エディトリアル性の高い旅行広告にしてください。

⸻

8. NG事項

以下の方向には絶対にしないでください。

* 格安旅行チラシのような見え方
* 情報商材バナーっぽい空気
* AI美女感が強い不自然な人物
* 普通すぎるビジネス服
* 暗い室内中心のビジュアル
* 価格訴求ばかりが目立つ構成
* 読みにくい、崩れた日本語
* 写真と文字がバラバラな素人っぽいレイアウト
* 無難すぎる左右分割構図

cases.title: Split Reality Advertising Poster Template
cases.prompt:
Create a premium advertising poster for [Brand] featuring [Product].

Build the composition around a clear SPLIT REALITY concept.

The poster should be divided into two visually contrasting worlds that show the transformation, contrast, or duality created by the product.

The product must sit at the center of the split as the visual bridge between both realities.

One side should represent the “before” state, problem, raw material, ordinary world, chaos, friction, noise, dullness, or limitation.

The other side should represent the “after” state, solution, refined experience, elevated world, clarity, control, beauty, energy, taste, performance, or desire.

The split should feel intentional and cinematic, not like a simple before/after collage.

Make the product accurate, recognizable, sharp, premium, and visually dominant.

Adapt the split logic to the brand DNA:
- tech products show chaos vs control, analog vs intelligent, limitation vs possibility
- food products show raw ingredient vs irresistible final experience
- beauty products show dullness vs glow, routine vs ritual, raw nature vs refined care
- fashion products show ordinary presence vs elevated identity
- luxury products show raw craft vs timeless refinement
- home products show everyday mess vs designed atmosphere

Use premium commercial photography, cinematic lighting, strong contrast between both worlds, refined typography, sharp product detail, realistic materials, elegant composition, polished shadows, and world-class campaign finishing.

Add tasteful poster typography inspired by the brand with a short 3-word slogan.

Create an ultra-realistic nostalgic café portrait captured on a premium early-2000s compact digital camera, blending direct flash with soft afternoon daylight. The image has a dreamy, imperfect snapshot quality with gentle motion softness caused by natural handheld camera movement, subtle subject motion, and shifting strands of hair. The atmosphere feels candid, intimate, and effortlessly authentic.
A young woman sits alone at a cozy café table beside a large sunlit window. Instead of facing outward, she is turned slightly toward the camera while lowering her gaze with a quiet, thoughtful expression. One hand loosely holds a ceramic coffee cup near her lips while the other rests against the edge of the table. Her posture is relaxed and natural, conveying a calm afternoon moment rather than a posed portrait.
She wears an oversized cream-colored knit cardigan layered over a soft sage-green top, loose charcoal trousers, a slim vintage wristwatch, and understated jewelry. On the table are a cappuccino with delicate foam art, a small notebook, and a bundle of pale peach roses wrapped in kraft paper. Warm wooden furniture, softly blurred indoor plants, scattered reflections, and muted café décor create a peaceful everyday setting.
Shot through thick vintage optics with pronounced spherical aberration, reduced edge sharpness, soft focus drift, blooming highlights, subtle lens haze, gentle veiling flare, lifted blacks, low micro-contrast, and characteristic CCD digital-camera color rendering. The highlights remain bright and elegant while preserving believable skin texture.
Colors remain rich and distinct despite the soft contrast: cream knitwear, sage-green fabric, warm wood tones, peach roses, coffee browns, indoor greenery, and natural skin tones maintain depth, vibrancy, and separation without oversaturation.
Lighting combines soft window daylight with gentle flash fill. Daylight creates a subtle rim light around the hair and shoulders, while flash softly illuminates facial features. Hair carries elongated reflections, lips show natural moisture, ceramic surfaces catch diffuse highlights, flowers reveal delicate satin reflections, and knit fabrics retain tactile detail.
Natural handheld vertical framing, slight tilt, imperfect composition, candid crop, and a premium vintage digicam feel. The overall mood is quiet, warm, reflective, and reminiscent of a treasured café snapshot discovered years later.

The overall style is a "product-focused poster featuring large-scale, perspective-driven typography." The core subject of the image is the [Product Name]. The product must be rendered clearly and exquisitely—like a "hero product" in an advertisement—positioned in the foreground or the lower-center area. It should feature realistic materials, structural integrity, and sharp details; it must not appear too small or blurry. Incorporate appropriate figures or usage scenarios based on the product type (e.g., male/female models, trendy individuals, outdoor enthusiasts, or actions/moods associated with the user). The image must be high-resolution and sharp, with accurate perspective, realistic textures, and consistent lighting, resembling an authentic brand campaign poster. It is suitable for categories such as perfumes, watches, headphones, digital products, outdoor apparel, sports brands, and consumer goods.

Avoid: collages or multi-image composites, actual brand logos, generic stock photos, cheap e-commerce aesthetics, cartoonish styles, cluttered backgrounds, undersized products, artificial-looking faces on figures, flat/generic headline styling, or insufficient information areas.

cases.prompt:

The product must be the clear hero, placed in a premium commercial composition with sharp detail, realistic materials, cinematic lighting, and strong visual hierarchy.

Around the product, create visible aura fields that express what the product makes people feel, taste, hear, smell, wear, or experience.

The aura should not look like random magic. It must be designed as a refined visual language based on the product category and brand DNA.

- food products create flavor waves, crumbs, cream, chocolate, steam, crunch particles, or appetite energy

- home products create calm atmosphere, warmth, texture, comfort waves, soft shadows, or ritual energy

The aura must wrap around the product, interact with its shape, and make the product feel powerful, desirable, and iconic.

Keep the composition premium, minimal where needed, and highly polished. Use refined typography inspired by the brand’s visual language with a short 3-word slogan.

Do not use miniature people, micro worlds, shadow storytelling, negative-space frames, exploded-view composition, product monuments, or split reality.

cases.title: Minimalist Anime Illustration Style Template
cases.prompt:
You are a visual style director for a quiet minimalist anime inspired illustration style. Apply this style to any subject the user provides, including characters, animals, objects, interiors, landscapes, architecture, fantasy scenes, symbolic compositions, and still life subjects.

The style is defined by restraint, silence, soft shape design, and clear emotional atmosphere. Do not chase realism. Do not add excessive detail. Do not decorate the image beyond what the subject requires. The final image should feel calm, suspended, pale, and dreamlike, as if built from simple color planes and gentle light.

Use a soft pastel color palette with low saturation. Favor misty blue, grey green, warm ivory, pale rose, soft lavender, muted beige, off white, charcoal black, and washed sky tones. Keep contrast gentle. Dark values may appear in hair, silhouettes, trees, shadows, or small anchors, but they should not overpower the image.

Use clean simplified forms. Build the subject from broad readable shapes. Edges should be smooth and controlled. Details should be reduced to their most essential visual function. Clothing, fur, feathers, leaves, water, stone, glass, and clouds should be suggested through shape, tone, and rhythm rather than through dense texture.

Use no line art or very low line art. Avoid heavy outlines. Separate forms through color boundaries, soft shadow shapes, and subtle value shifts. The image should look designed rather than rendered.

Use soft cel shading. Shadows should be flat, simple, and quiet, with two or three main value steps. Avoid glossy highlights, hard rim lighting, intense bloom, dramatic contrast, and heavy painterly brushwork. Lighting should feel diffused, like an overcast sky, pale morning, late afternoon haze, or reflected light near water.

For character subjects, use anime inspired proportions and a delicate silhouette. Faces may be simplified, faceless, or minimally indicated depending on the subject request. Hair should be treated as a strong graphic shape with a few flowing strands. Poses should feel still, inward, modest, and composed. Avoid exaggerated expression, theatrical gesture, and busy costume detail.

For animal subjects, simplify the anatomy into soft masses and clear silhouettes. Eyes, ears, tails, wings, paws, horns, scales, or feathers should be reduced to elegant readable shapes. Preserve the animal’s identity without turning it into a realistic wildlife study.

For object subjects, treat the object like a quiet emblem. Use clean shape, soft contact shadow, limited detail, and gentle color separation. The object should feel placed in air and light rather than photographed.

For landscapes and environments, use layered flat shapes. Distant trees, hills, buildings, water, sky, clouds, paths, windows, and reflections should be simplified into calm bands and planes. Atmosphere is more important than precision. Use negative space generously.

Composition should be calm and uncluttered. Center the subject or place it slightly off center with careful balance. Leave breathing room around the main form. Use background elements to frame the subject softly, not to compete with it.

The mood should be quiet, ethereal, wistful, and clear. Avoid melodrama. Avoid horror unless the user explicitly asks for it, and even then keep the style restrained and poetic rather than graphic.

Do not use generic quality tags or empty promotional language. Avoid phrases such as masterpiece, best quality, ultra detailed, hyper realistic, cinematic, award winning, stunning, breathtaking, insanely detailed, trending, perfect anatomy, professional render, 8k, or beautiful lighting. Describe only the actual visual decisions that shape the image.

Do not add text, logos, watermarks, signatures, captions, interface elements, or decorative borders unless the user explicitly requests them.

Do not sexualize subjects. Do not add fetishized posing, revealing emphasis, explicit anatomy, or voyeuristic framing. Keep the image suitable for a refined illustration portfolio.

When adapting the style to a new subject, preserve these constants: pastel restraint, simplified forms, soft cel shading, low or absent outlines, quiet composition, gentle atmosphere, reduced detail, and an inward dreamlike mood.

cases.title: Biomorphic Editorial Realism AI Image Template
cases.imageAlt: Biomorphic Editorial Realism AI Image Template
cases.prompt:
You are a visual director for clinical biomorphic editorial realism.

Apply this style to any subject the user provides. The subject may be a person, animal, object, plant, building, room, landscape, garment, sculpture, machine, or abstract form. Do not copy surface motifs mechanically. Translate the deeper visual logic of the style into the subject.

The central idea is the conversion of a familiar subject into a cold, fragile, pale surface under close observation. The subject should feel quiet, exposed, and materially uncertain, as if it exists between body, sculpture, ash, porcelain, smoke, paper, bone, and mineral.

The image should not feel decorative. It should feel discovered. Avoid ornament for its own sake. Every mark, shadow, blur, stain, and texture must feel physically motivated by light, surface, atmosphere, pressure, residue, diffusion, or erosion.

Use a restrained desaturated palette. Favor cold white, bone white, chalk, ash grey, blue grey, diluted black, graphite, smoke, faint flesh pink, dry beige, and muted shadow tones. Color should feel drained from the image. Warmth may exist only as a faint biological trace, such as the edge of an eyelid, a lip, a thin membrane, a worn surface, or a small exposed undertone.

Treat the subject as a substrate. Its surface is the main field of meaning. Skin, fur, fabric, stone, glass, petals, walls, metal, paper, or water should appear tactile, pale, and vulnerable. Preserve pores, grain, fibers, cracks, dust, moisture, wrinkles, scratches, powder, or subtle irregularities when appropriate.

Introduce organic disturbance with restraint. This disturbance may appear as smoke diffusion, ink suspended under a surface, mineral branching, soft fungal bloom, shadow residue, burnt botanical trace, water stain, graphite bloom, frost vein, or ash carried by air. It must feel irregular, natural, and unstable. It must not look like a tattoo, logo, face paint, tribal pattern, fantasy marking, decorative filigree, random dirt, or horror wound.

Lighting is essential. Use cold directional daylight, pale reflected light, filtered window light, branch shadow, mesh shadow, lace shadow, glass distortion, or soft overcast exposure. Light should behave like an examiner. It should reveal texture, flatten color, cut through the subject, and create areas of blank whiteness. Shadows should feel organic and accidental, not theatrical.

Use close, intimate framing. Prefer fragments over complete explanation. A face may be reduced to eyes, lashes, cheek, ear, mouth, or skin. A flower may be reduced to petal surface and dark branching stain. A building may be reduced to white wall, window shadow, damp mineral marks, and cold air. A landscape may be reduced to fog, pale ground, black trees, and surface erosion. The frame should withhold context.

Emotion should be quiet, severe, and inward. The subject should not perform. Avoid dramatic expression, glamour posing, seductive framing, action, spectacle, and narrative clutter. The mood should feel suspended, clinical, intimate, fragile, and slightly inhuman without becoming monstrous.

Depth of field should be shallow when the subject allows it. Let edges fall away. Keep backgrounds minimal, blurred, grey, white, or cold toned. The image should feel close enough to touch but emotionally distant.

For portraits, suppress identity. Do not emphasize personality, charm, glamour, or conventional beauty. The face should become a surface of light, texture, and disturbance. Expressions should be neutral, lowered, absent, exhausted, sleeping, or quietly fixed. Eyes may be pale, wet, reflective, partially hidden, or shadowed. Lashes and fine hair may be sharply visible against overexposed skin.

For non human subjects, preserve the same grammar. Do not force human features onto them. Translate the style through material condition: pale surface, organic intrusion, cold light, close crop, tactile detail, quiet atmosphere, and withheld context.

Composition should feel controlled but not polished. Use asymmetry, partial obstruction, cropped forms, negative space, and surface rhythm. The strongest visual event should be the meeting point between pale material and dark organic disturbance.

Do not use generic quality language. Do not use phrases such as masterpiece, ultra detailed, best quality, cinematic, stunning, beautiful, trending, perfect, flawless, 8k, hyper realistic, or award winning. Describe concrete visual decisions only.

Do not add text, logos, captions, watermarks, decorative borders, interface elements, neon effects, colorful makeup, fantasy glow, glossy commercial lighting, symmetrical tattoos, skull makeup, gore, wounds, disease, monsters, or explicit sexual framing.

Always preserve the essence: a pale familiar subject made strange through cold observation, organic surface disturbance, invasive light, close framing, desaturated color, tactile texture, and emotional silence.

cases.prompt:
主題：
赤い壁と夏の横顔

人物・表情：
20代女性。明るいアイボリーベージュ寄りの白肌で、ほんのりピンクの血色を含んだ自然な肌質。頬、鼻先、肩、鎖骨に柔らかなハイライトが入り、過度な美肌補正ではなく繊細な肌理を残す。精密で上品なドールライク日系メイク、淡いローズピンクのチーク、シャンパンベージュとピンクブラウンのアイシャドウ、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、明るめブラウンの眉、透け感のあるピンクベージュのグロスリップ。瞳に小さく澄んだキャッチライト。表情は落ち着いていて、少しクールに遠くを見る。黒茶色の髪をゆるい低めポニーテールにまとめ、顔まわりに細い後れ毛が風で流れる。

服装・ポーズ：
夏らしい軽さのあるアイボリーの細ストラップリブニットキャミソール。鎖骨と肩のラインが自然に見えるが、露出は上品に抑える。ボトムスは生成りベージュのハイウエストワイドパンツ、リネン混の薄手素材で、ウエストに同色の長い布ベルトを結ぶ。足元はブラウンベージュの細ストラップサンダル。人物はテラコッタ色の低い壁の上に斜めに座り、人物自身の右手を壁の上に置いて体を支え、左膝を軽く立て、右脚は下へ自然に伸ばす。上半身は少し画面左へひねり、顔は青空側へ向ける。

背景・光：
日本の現代美術館や海沿いのモダンな屋上テラスのような、ミニマルな建築空間。赤茶のテラコッタ壁、低いパラペット、左側の大きな垂直壁、上部の薄い庇、奥に広がる澄んだ夏の青空。壁と床は細かなスタッコとコンクリートの質感を持つ。午後の強い太陽光が画面左上から差し込み、左壁に大きな斜めの影、人物の影を壁面に落とす。肩、頬、髪の縁に暖かい光が入り、影側は深く落ちるが、空からの青い反射光でわずかに持ち上げる。

構図・カメラ：
縦長3:4。中距離のファッションポートレート。人物は画面右寄りに配置し、上半分に広い青空の余白を残す。左側の赤い壁と斜めの影で強い幾何学構図を作る。人物の全身が入るが、画面下端はサンダル付近で少し余裕を残す。カメラはやや低めの目線、わずかな仰角。焦点は人物の顔と上半身、背景は浅すぎない自然な被写界深度。

質感・スタイル：
リアルな写真風AI画像。日本の夏のファッションエディトリアル、強い日差し、乾いた空気、テラコッタと青空の色面対比。肌は自然な質感、衣服はリネンとリブニットの織り目が見える。高コントラストだが硬すぎず、フィルム写真のような微細な粒子と落ち着いた色調。過度なHDR、過剰な美肌補正、アニメ調を避ける。

ネガティブ：
幼く見える顔、不自然な目線、過度な網紅メイク、プラスチックのような肌、露出過多、透ける服、余分または欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、座り姿勢の不自然さ、壁との接触不良、浮遊、光源と矛盾する影、誤った遠近法、不要な人物や小物、文字、ロゴ、透かし、参考画像の構図や服装をそのまま複製すること。

- carrying them like an object
- squeezing them into a silly pose
- covering their mouth playfully
- making them sit or lie awkwardly

The interaction should feel mischievous, annoying, absurd, cute, and meme-like — never violent, scary, sexual, or harmful.

annoyed, confused, tired, embarrassed, surprised, unamused, helpless, or mildly frustrated. Keep it funny and relatable, not exaggerated.

casual clothing, sweatshirt, knitwear, T-shirt, loungewear, minimal fashion, or neat everyday style.

cases.title: Luxury Product Photography AI Template
cases.prompt:
[BRAND NAME] + [PRODUCT]

Act as a senior luxury fashion art director and studio product photographer creating a premium key visual for a flagship campaign, an e-commerce editorial, and mobile-first brand content.

PHASE 1: FORMAT AND CANVAS

Create a vertical 9:16 composition. Use a single, completely flat warm off-white background, never pure white and never gray. Aim for a soft ivory cream similar to #F4EFE6, with no visible shadowing across the background plane.

Automatically infer the signature neutral background tone associated with [BRAND NAME]. If the brand is known for a house color used in packaging, tissue paper, lookbooks, or campaign materials, subtly shift the canvas toward that recognized off-white or neutral. The final image should feel like an official brand asset, not a generic studio render.

PHASE 2: BACKGROUND PATTERN WATERMARK

Identify [BRAND NAME]'s iconic surface language, such as its monogram, toile, geometric logo repeat, heritage emblem, archival motif, or signature textile pattern.

Apply that pattern across the full background as a ghosted watermark. Keep it tone-on-tone, using the same base color family with a slight value difference of roughly 8 to 12 percent lighter or darker than the canvas. Make the pattern large in scale, with individual motifs taking up about 15 to 25 percent of the canvas width. Keep opacity between 10 and 18 percent. Avoid hard outlines. The pattern should feel embossed, woven, or softly pressed into the surface rather than printed. It must sit behind every foreground element.

PHASE 3: LOGO PLACEMENT

Recreate [BRAND NAME]'s official logo with high fidelity, including accurate letterforms, proportions, secondary marks, emblems, crowns, stars, monogram icons, or other brand-specific details.

Place the logo horizontally centered in the upper third of the frame, within the top 30 percent of the canvas. Scale it so it spans about 40 to 50 percent of the canvas width. It should be prominent, clean, and balanced.

Render the logo as flat 2D artwork with no extrusion, chrome, beveling, or dimensional effects. Use the official logo colorway for [BRAND NAME], matching the brand-standard color or colors seen on official packaging and websites. If the logo uses separate tones for an icon and wordmark, preserve that hierarchy precisely.

Directly beneath the main logo mark, add the full [BRAND NAME] wordmark in widely tracked capital letters. Use a clean geometric sans-serif style, tracking around +200 to +300, in the same brand color. The wordmark height should be about 60 percent of the main logo height. Do not place decorative dividers or extra symbols between the logo and wordmark.

PHASE 4: PRODUCT PLACEMENT

Render [PRODUCT] as a photorealistic studio object with maximum material accuracy.

Leather should show grain, pores, stitching texture, edge paint, and natural surface variation. Metal hardware should be gold or silver as appropriate, with believable micro-reflections and no flat coloring. Canvas, textile, and fabric should show woven fiber detail rather than smooth synthetic surfaces. Any brand-specific patterns on the product itself must be accurate, sharp, and legible.

Place the product so it enters from the bottom-right corner at a natural 25 to 35 degree angle, as if casually placed into frame or captured mid-motion. Crop the object intentionally so only about 60 to 75 percent of it is visible. The product should occupy the lower 55 to 65 percent of the image. The crop must feel editorial and intentional, not accidental.

Make the product feel physically present on the surface. Add an extremely soft contact shadow under the nearest edge, around 8 to 12 percent opacity. Do not use hard drop shadows.

PHASE 5: LIGHTING

Use the feeling of a large north-facing studio window. The light should be soft, directional, and almost shadowless on the background. Use neutral daylight between 5500K and 6000K, slightly cool but still natural.

Set the key light as a large softbox from the upper-left, evenly revealing the entire product surface. Keep contrast very low, roughly 1.2:1 to 1.5:1 maximum. Add a broad fill from the right to remove harsh shadows. Do not use rim light. Do not create dramatic contrast. The lighting should only reveal the product, never compete with it.

Enable subtle global illumination so product surfaces reflect onto one another naturally. Avoid specular hotspots on leather. Reserve crisp highlights mainly for metal hardware.

PHASE 6: TYPOGRAPHY AND FINISHING

At the bottom of the frame, place a thin horizontal rule, 1 px thick, centered, spanning about 80 percent of the canvas width, using the brand color. Beneath it, add one line of micro-copy in the same clean sans-serif family. It may be a social handle, collection name, campaign label, or small-caps editorial caption. Generate a contextually appropriate label for [BRAND NAME]. Keep it minimal, refined, and brand-correct.

TECH SPECS

Render as photorealistic CGI with the polish of Keyshot or Octane product visualization. Use ultra-high detail in a 9:16 vertical frame. Simulate f/16 depth of field so everything remains tack sharp. No bokeh. Product edges, stitches, patterns, hardware, and surface details must be crisp.

Use clean true-to-life tone mapping with no crushed shadows, no vignette, no grain, and no cinematic haze. Keep colors faithful to the real product, with only slight warmth in the ivory background. Avoid AI-plastic leather, fake normals, smooth fabric, reflective backgrounds, and environmental reflections. Use only controlled studio lighting. The mood should match the standard of official Louis Vuitton, Bottega Veneta, and Celine e-commerce or campaign photography: clean, premium, precise, and ready for press use.

cases.title: Experimental Portrait Poster Template
cases.prompt:
Create a 9:16 high-end experimental portrait poster with a clean editorial layout.
The image should feel original, modern, visually striking, and design-driven.
Use a single adult model as the main subject. Keep the face recognizable, while reshaping the portrait through controlled visual effects such as blur, scan distortion, subtle grid overlays, spotlight shadow, or chromatic glitch.
Typography should feel custom, refined, and minimal, with an original title and a few short supporting phrases. Keep the layout clean, elevated, and poster-like.

4 directions:

1. STATIC VEIL
   A monochrome black-and-gray portrait poster.
   A young male model with a shaved head and bold geometric black sunglasses.
   The head and glasses stay sharp, while the lower half of the portrait dissolves into horizontal scan distortion and stretched blur, as if the figure is being pulled into static.
   Fine grain texture in the background.
   Use a custom text system such as: “STATIC VEIL”, “visual noise”, “shadow signal”, “blurred matter”, “a portrait reduced to rhythm”.
   Cold, minimal, futuristic, powerful.

2. SPECTRAL DRIFT
   A white-background experimental beauty portrait poster.
   A young female model in side or three-quarter profile, with one eye and facial structure remaining clear.
   Controlled chromatic glitch trails in cyan, magenta, blue, and violet sweep horizontally across the face and body.
   The effect should feel luminous and elegant.
   Use a custom text system such as: “SPECTRAL DRIFT”, “motion layer”, “color echo”, “synthetic portrait”, “light offset”, “frame memory”.
   Clean, futuristic, vivid, dreamlike.

3. SIGNAL FACE
   A white or light-gray portrait poster with a digital identity feeling.
   A young East Asian male model wearing slim black sunglasses, centered in frame.
   The middle of the face remains sharp, while the edges of the hair, shoulders, and outline have soft motion blur and slight RGB drift.
   Overlay a subtle transparent grid across the composition.
   Use small blue accent text sparingly.
   Use a custom text system such as: “SIGNAL FACE”, “portrait sample”, “digital identity”, “soft focus study”, “visual layer”, “north field”.
   Minimal, precise, polished.

4. NARROW BEAM
   A dark blue to black portrait poster with a moody experimental lighting setup.
   A young male model facing forward, with a narrow beam of light cutting across the eyes and upper face, while the lower face and body fade into darkness.
   Add faint grid texture or very thin technical lines in the background.
   Use a custom text system such as: “NARROW BEAM”, “where shadow holds”, “vision remains”, “silence defines the frame”, “a study of presence held in blue”.
   Quiet, restrained, cinematic, intense.

You can swap the model, title, color logic, and effect treatment, while keeping the same overall quality: a clear focal point, original text, controlled distortion, and strong poster composition.

cases.title: Monochromatic Red Fingerprint Portrait Art
cases.prompt:
Create an ultra-detailed monochromatic red fingerprint portrait of the subject from the reference photo. The artwork should be meticulously constructed from thousands of overlapping human fingerprint impressions, varying in pressure, opacity, scale, and rotation to create realistic shading, depth, and facial definition. Every facial feature must remain highly recognizable while seamlessly blending into the fingerprint texture.
The portrait should depict a young male football player with a calm, serious, and determined expression, looking slightly upward. Preserve his short black fade haircut, thick eyebrows, almond-shaped dark eyes, straight nose, defined jawline, medium-full lips, and athletic facial proportions. Facial skin should feature extremely fine fingerprint textures, while deeper shadows use denser overlapping fingerprint impressions for dramatic contrast.

The background must be clean warm ivory or light beige paper, completely free from texture, patterns, gradients, borders, frames, decorative elements, calligraphy, signatures, watermarks, logos, or any typography. Leave generous negative space surrounding the portrait for a refined gallery presentation.
Lighting should be soft and frontal with balanced illumination, emphasizing facial contours through fingerprint density rather than harsh shadows. The composition should be centered and symmetrical, creating a museum-quality fine art print aesthetic.

matte black, graphite gray, deep navy, brushed silver, warm champagne highlights, subtle electric blue accents, clean white light, soft amber reflections. Keep the palette sophisticated, quiet, premium, and unmistakably high-end audio.

“POWER THAT LASTS”

“DESIGNED FOR YOUR WORLD”
Keep the product clearly visible and premium.

A macro industrial-detail panel showing earbud texture, acoustic mesh, charging contacts, touch surface, matte finish, precise seam lines, and subtle branding with extreme close-up realism. English headline:
“ENGINEERED TO PERFORM”

cases.prompt:

The composition should look like a handmade magazine mood board assembled from cut-out photographs, printed paper textures, doodles, stickers, and retro graphic elements.

The overall color palette consists of beige, cream, olive green, muted brown, warm gray, and soft sepia tones with low saturation for a nostalgic early 2000s feel.

The main subject appears twice in different poses:

• Upper composition: The young woman stands confidently with both hands raised near her face in a playful fashion pose. She wears white cat-eye sunglasses with black lenses, a loose oversized olive green graphic T-shirt tied into a knot at the waist, white athletic shorts with black piping, white socks, and white sneakers. Small doodle-style heart stickers decorate both cheeks. Her expression is confident, stylish, and carefree.

cases.title: Mixed Media Fashion Editorial Portrait
cases.prompt:
A high fashion mixed media editorial portrait that blends realistic fashion photography with expressive hand drawn sketch art. The composition features a confident young woman standing in a three quarter pose, leaning slightly backward with one hand resting naturally by her side and her head turned over her shoulder. She looks away from the camera with a calm, confident, slightly mysterious expression. Long wavy dark brown hair flows naturally across her shoulders, with large silver hoop earrings adding a modern street fashion touch.

She wears an oversized white sweatshirt with loose sleeves tucked slightly into high waisted faded charcoal gray straight leg jeans. The jeans feature a wide black leather belt with oversized silver eyelets and a large silver buckle, creating a bold urban aesthetic.

The background is a clean white studio backdrop with a subtle light gray rectangular panel centered behind the subject to create depth and a gallery style presentation.

The artistic concept combines photography with sketch illustration. Only the left half of the woman's body is fully photorealistic, while the right half transitions seamlessly into a vibrant red line art illustration. The sketch perfectly continues the woman's pose and clothing before expanding into an illustrated companion character standing back to back with her.

The illustrated character wears a loose hoodie, wide leg pants, gloves, and a tilted bucket hat. The character has exaggerated spiral eyes, a sharp toothy grin, graffiti inspired styling, and holds two fingers raised near the face in a playful gesture. The entire illustration is created using energetic hand drawn red pencil style outlines with visible sketch strokes and construction lines.

Additional red doodle elements surround the composition, including:

Large handwritten graffiti lettering across the top reading "VIBIN'" in bold expressive brush style.

A vertical decorative panel on the left containing abstract symbols, a large question mark, an "X", spiral icon, and minimalist graphic marks.

Floating cloud doodles behind the subjects.

Small stars, crosses, motion marks, and playful graphic accents scattered throughout the artwork.

Light sketch overlaps extending over the realistic photograph, creating the illusion that the drawing is being created directly on top of the image.

The color palette is intentionally minimal:

Pure white background.

Neutral grayscale clothing.

Natural skin tones.

The illustration uses only vivid saturated red line work, making it the strongest visual element.
