cases.title: Cinematic Analog Film Portrait Series Template
cases.imageAlt: Cinematic Analog Film Portrait Series Template
cases.prompt:
Create a cinematic 35mm analog film photo series featuring the same young adult woman with exact facial identity consistency across every frame. She has short tousled dark-brown bob hair, natural textured skin, subtle freckles, minimal makeup, soft tired eyes, and a quiet, introspective expression. She wears an oversized dark charcoal blazer over a simple dark outfit.

Scene: a busy European city street during late golden hour, old urban buildings, parked dark cars, distant pedestrians and traffic, warm sunlight cutting through the streets. The world around her feels fast and restless while she remains emotionally still and detached.

IMAGE 1 — SIDE PROFILE:
Medium side-profile portrait of the woman standing near the street, facing left. A gentle wind blows loose strands of her short hair across her cheek. Warm sunset rim light outlines her hair and nose. She stares into the distance with a calm, melancholic expression. City architecture becomes heavily blurred behind her.

IMAGE 2 — CAR WINDOW CLOSE-UP:
Intimate close-up portrait photographed through a slightly dirty car window. Her face appears behind the glass in three-quarter profile, staring outside with distant, thoughtful eyes. Tiny dust particles and subtle marks are visible on the glass. Abstract red and white traffic-light bokeh glows behind her. Reflections softly overlap parts of her face.

IMAGE 3 — STREET MOMENT:
Candid medium-full street photograph of the same woman beside a parked black car. She turns unexpectedly toward the camera as if someone has just called her name. Wind pushes messy strands across her face. Slight motion blur in the surrounding traffic and pedestrians, spontaneous documentary composition, imperfect framing, emotionally raw.

IMAGE 4 — INSIDE CAR:
Extreme intimate profile close-up of the same woman sitting inside a car and looking through the side window. Her face is very close to the glass, eyes lowered slightly, lips relaxed. Small droplets, dust and imperfections on the window remain sharply visible while city lights dissolve into red, amber and teal bokeh outside. Quiet loneliness and cinematic stillness.

VISUAL STYLE:
1970s–1990s European arthouse cinema, Kodak Portra 800 mixed with Cinestill 800T character, pushed 35mm film, strong organic grain, visible film noise, slightly underexposed shadows, warm amber highlights, muted teal-green shadows, faded colors, subtle halation, gentle highlight bloom, imperfect analog exposure, soft focus falloff, natural skin texture, no beauty retouching, shallow depth of field, vintage spherical lens, slight chromatic aberration, handheld documentary photography, candid editorial fashion photography, poetic urban melancholy, Wong Kar-wai-inspired emotional color atmosphere, raw photochemical texture.

CAMERA:
35mm film camera, 50mm f/1.4 and 85mm f/1.8 lenses, wide aperture, available natural light only, shallow depth of field, handheld framing, subtle motion blur, authentic film scan, high ISO grain.

MOOD:
lonely in a crowded city, quiet longing, nostalgia, emotional distance, fleeting memory, contemplative, intimate, imperfect, cinematic.

Aspect ratio 4:5 vertical. Generate as a cohesive four-image editorial photo sequence. Preserve the exact same woman, face, hairstyle, outfit and cinematic color grade in all four shots.

cases.title: Lindemans Cherry Lambic 9 Panel Campaign
cases.prompt:
Create an ultra-premium 9-panel editorial campaign board for Lindemans Fruit Lambic Beer, designed as a cherry-flavor-dominant luxury beverage marketing matrix. The final result must feel like a world-class brand launch system for a cherry-led Belgian fruit lambic: visually rich, commercially intelligent, highly polished, and unmistakably premium. Use a refined 3x3 grid where every tile belongs to the same cherry universe, while each panel serves a different campaign function and product scenario.

Use a clean 3x3 square grid layout.
Each panel must feature a real Lindemans Fruit Lambic Beer product rendered with absolute fidelity:
authentic bottle or glass silhouette,
correct Lindemans label design,
legible branding,
realistic bottle glass,
premium reflections,
true beer color,
subtle condensation if appropriate,
and unmistakable product identity.
The product must remain the hero in every tile.

The key visual concept is one unified cherry campaign world.
Across all nine panels, build a refined brand universe centered on:
dark cherries,
split cherries with rich juicy interiors,
cherry stems,
deep ruby-red beer tones,
Belgian orchard romance,
premium serving ritual,
and elegant fruit-lambic atmosphere.
Every panel should feel linked by the same cherry-led art direction, but still offer a distinct creative marketing role.

Panel direction suggestions:
1. Hero bottle tile:
single Lindemans bottle on an elegant pedestal, surrounded by a few deep red cherries, with strong brand headline.

2. Bottle + glass ritual tile:
bottle beside a poured tulip or beer glass glowing in ruby cherry tones, with restrained cherry garnish.

3. Close-up flavor tile:
tight crop on the glass and beer body, foam detail, bottle secondary, cherries in foreground blur.

4. Orchard still-life tile:
bottle nested among refined cherries, leaves, wood textures, and soft Belgian orchard cues.

5. Centered product authority tile:
clean, minimal, centered bottle with strongest logo hierarchy and premium negative space.

6. Promotional copy tile:
bottle and glass with elegant campaign typography, subtle offer-style layout, still premium and not cheap.

7. Heritage serving tile:
Belgian-inspired serving scene with wood, deep fruit tones, and a curated cherry presentation.

8. Atmospheric campaign tile:
bottle with suspended cherries or delicate falling cherry droplets, showing motion and freshness in a highly controlled way.

9. Signature end-frame tile:
strongest brand-signature composition with bottle, glass, cherries, and final campaign tagline.

The whole 9-grid must balance:
product-first clarity,
flavor storytelling,
marketing variation,
and cherry-led brand cohesion.
Each panel should feel like it belongs to the same campaign family but performs a slightly different role:
hero shot,
flavor emphasis,
serving ritual,
offer tile,
brand signature,
or atmosphere tile.

The cherries must be rendered with exceptional realism:
deep burgundy-red skin,
wet reflective gloss,
subtle bloom,
natural stem texture,
split flesh with juicy translucency,
and believable organic variation.
They must feel luxurious and appetizing, never decorative clutter.

Beer rendering:
the liquid must feel rich, ruby-toned, fruit-lambic specific, luminous, and premium.
Foam should be subtle and elegant where present.
Glass reflections, liquid depth, and bottle surfaces must be physically believable and highly polished.

Background and set styling:
build a premium cherry campaign world through recurring elements such as:
deep cherry red,
black-cherry crimson,
burgundy gradients,
dark wood,
soft cream highlights,
aged orchard green accents,
and elegant Belgian rustic textures.
Allow each tile to vary slightly in composition, but keep all of them within the same tonal and material family.

Lighting:
use soft premium studio lighting with commercial beverage polish across all nine panels.
Each tile should include:
clean highlights on glass,
luminous ruby beer glow,
subtle sheen on cherry skins,
controlled foam detail,
and elegant shadow shaping.
All shadows must remain breathable and clean, with no muddy blacks, dirty blotches, or noisy dark contamination.

Color palette:
deep cherry red,
burgundy,
black-cherry gloss,
ruby beer tones,
soft cream,
aged orchard green,
dark wood brown,
and restrained charcoal shadows.
The entire grid must feel rich, seductive, fruit-led, and premium.

Typography:
use refined English branding and promotional copy only.
Main recurring text:
“LINDEMANS”
“FRUIT LAMBIC BEER”
Cherry-led supporting lines may include:
“CHERRY IN FULL BLOOM”
“BELGIAN CHERRY LAMBIC”
“TASTE THE DARK FRUIT”
“SERVED IN RUBY”
“CRAFTED FROM CHERRIES”
Typography must feel elegant, integrated, commercially intelligent, and brand-consistent, never loud or cheap.

Mood:
Belgian orchard luxury, cherry-rich sophistication, premium beverage storytelling, ruby-toned elegance, campaign consistency, refined appetite appeal.

Rendering style:
hyper-real beverage photography, luxury 9-panel campaign grid, authentic product rendering, cherry-dominant fruit styling, refined promotional layout, premium commercial typography, 8k, world-class campaign quality.

Negative prompt:
generic beer ad, fake Lindemans label, inconsistent product design, low-detail glass, random fruit mix dominating over cherries, cluttered panels, chaotic typography, muddy shadows, black blotches, noisy dark areas, cheap supermarket flyer look, weak branding, repetitive tiles with no compositional variation

cases.prompt:
9:16 竖版，高精度 3D CG 东方幻想甜酷魔法少女角色海报，3D CG oriental fantasy magical girl character poster，anime-style 3D CG character art，semi-realistic 3D character render，full body portrait，低角度仰视透视构图，画面主体是一位明确成年的年轻东方幻想系女性角色，视觉年龄约 20–24 岁，整体气质灵动、可爱、俏皮、梦幻、甜酷，带有糖果童话与东方幻想魔法使的高级感。整体不是平面插画，而是高完成度 3D CG 角色渲染，具有精致角色建模、真实材质表现、明亮糖果色光影与高级虚拟角色海报质感。

人物拥有精致可爱的东方美型脸，小巧柔和的鹅蛋脸，皮肤白皙细腻，带轻微通透感与柔和皮肤着色。眼睛大而圆润，瞳色为粉紫、浅蓝、糖果橙渐变，瞳孔有星光般的玻璃质感与高亮反射，眼神天真灵动又带一点小恶作剧感。睫毛纤长卷翘，眼妆轻透，嘴唇小巧柔软，唇色为淡粉糖果色，表情可爱、惊讶、好奇，正看向镜头。

发型为短款卷翘波波头或中短发，主色为淡紫色、薰衣草紫与浅粉橘渐变，发尾向外轻轻卷起，发丝柔顺蓬松，具有高精度发丝建模与糖果般柔光高光。头戴带熊耳的白色兜帽，兜帽耳朵内侧有粉色爱心图案，增强童话感与角色辨识度。

服装为东方幻想糖果魔法少女风格短裙套装，主体为白色、粉色、浅蓝色、薄荷绿色与少量亮黄色点缀。上身为宽松短斗篷式连帽上衣，胸前系一个夸张的浅绿色蝴蝶结，中央有爱心宝石装饰；袖子圆润可爱，带粉蓝拼色结构。下身为层叠式短裙，裙摆由浅蓝荷叶边、粉色外层、白色轻纱层共同构成，层次丰富，轻盈蓬松。腰间可挂小型糖果盒、小包袋或爱心配件，增强角色趣味性。腿部穿粉蓝白相间的过膝条纹袜，脚穿粉色厚底玛丽珍鞋，鞋头有金色爱心装饰。整体服装像“糖果系东方幻想魔法少女”的高级 3D CG 游戏角色设计。

人物手持一根精致魔法手杖，手杖为粉色与金色结构，顶部有金色星星核心、白色小翅膀与圆环装饰，带明显魔法少女感。人物姿态为低角度仰视下的漂浮或跃起姿势，一只手向镜头伸出，手指自然张开，另一只手握住魔法杖。双腿向前下方延伸，形成夸张透视感，一只脚更靠近镜头，增强画面冲击力。整体像从糖果梦境中向观者飞来的魔法少女，动作俏皮、轻盈、有活力。

cases.title: Product Ad Reverse Damage Visual
cases.prompt:
Upload a clear product image first.

Create a premium 16:9 commercial advertising visual using the uploaded product as the exact hero reference.

Visual system: “Reverse The Damage”

Keep the product perfectly still, large, sharply focused, and instantly recognizable, occupying 35–45% of the frame.

Preserve the exact product shape, proportions, materials, colors, logo, label, typography, packaging details, and brand identity. The logo must remain clearly visible, readable, unobstructed, and naturally integrated into the product.

Do not create a normal beauty shot or a simple before-and-after split.

Show one impossible frozen moment where the product reverses the exact problem it was designed to solve.

The damaged state should physically move backward into the restored state:

• stains pull themselves out of fabric  
• dust and debris return into a controlled clean stream  
• split hair fibers reconnect into smooth glossy strands  
• cracks close and broken pieces rebuild themselves  
• scratches retreat from painted surfaces  
• dryness transforms back into soft hydrated texture  
• wrinkles flatten and fabric restores itself  
• grease splatter reverses into a spotless surface  

The product stays calm, clean, and untouched while the damage visibly rewinds around it.

Use only one clear reverse-action mechanic.

The transformation must:
start near the product,
move in one readable direction,
show a strong damaged-to-perfect transition,
communicate the benefit in one second,
frame the product without covering the logo,
and feel physically believable despite being impossible.

Composition:
foreground shows the damaged material,
midground contains the hero product,
background resolves into the restored premium state.

Style:
premium agency campaign,
cinematic commercial photography,
high-speed frozen motion,
realistic material physics,
dramatic directional lighting,
tactile textures,
sharp product detail,
polished reflections,
strong contrast,
clean negative space,
scroll-stopping advertising composition.

Avoid:
random explosions,
generic particles,
multiple competing effects,
tiny product scale,
hidden branding,
unreadable labels,
miniature people,
micro worlds,
UI overlays,
floating logos,
extra text,
clutter,
or transformations unrelated to the product benefit.

Output:
one polished 16:9 hero advertisement where the product visibly reverses the problem it solves.

cases.title: Strawberry Ice Drink Summer Portrait
cases.prompt:
主題：
氷越しの夏

主体：
縦長2:3のリアル写真。透明な大型プラスチックカップの内側から見上げるような超広角フィッシュアイ構図。画面下半分いっぱいに赤いいちご果肉とクラッシュアイスが迫り、中央から太いグリーンのストローが奥へ一直線に伸びる。丸く歪んだカップの開口部の向こうに、女性の顔が中央に大きく収まる。

人物・表情：
自然で現実感のある若い女性。黒髪に近いダークブラウンの髪を高めのお団子にまとめ、薄い前髪と顔まわりの後れ毛が日差しで細く光っている。透明感のあるナチュラルメイク、淡いピンクの頬、つやのあるリップ。目を大きく開いてカメラをまっすぐ見つめ、唇を小さく丸めてストローをくわえている。少し驚いたような、可愛らしく無邪気な表情。

服装・ポーズ：
白いレース素材のブラウス。首元と肩まわりに細かなフリルがあり、夏らしく軽い質感。人物はカップの向こう側に顔を近づけ、両肩は下部に少しだけ見える。ストローは人物の口元に自然に接触し、奥から手前の赤い氷へ向かって強い奥行きを作る。

背景・光：
背景は晴れた夏の日の古い商店街。木造風の店先、かき氷屋の暖簾、苺柄の看板、白い小さな旗、街路樹が見える。文字はすべてぼかされた読めない装飾として扱う。左上から強い太陽光が入り、透明カップの水滴、カップ縁、氷、赤い果肉に細かな反射とハイライトが出る。影は右下へ落ち、白いクリームの残りがカップ内側にリング状についている。

構図・カメラ：
カメラはカップの底付近、赤い氷のすぐ上に置いたような極端なローアングル。フィッシュアイレンズでカップの円形リムが大きく湾曲し、周囲の商店街も軽く歪む。画面下45％は赤い氷と果肉の前ボケ、中央はストローと女性の顔、上部は青空とカップの透明な縁。ピントは女性の目と口元、手前の氷はきらめく浅いボケ。

質感・スタイル：
プロ用カメラで撮影した夏の広告写真風。透明プラスチックの屈折、水滴の粒、氷の冷たさ、いちご果肉の瑞々しさを高精細に表現。青空、赤い氷、グリーンのストロー、白いブラウスの色の対比を鮮やかにする。肌は自然な質感を残し、過度な美肌補正はしない。明るくポップで、少しユーモラスな日本の夏スイーツ写真。

ネガティブ：
実在ブランドロゴ、読める文字、商標の再現、不自然な顔、不自然な視線、歯や唇の崩れ、ストローとの接触不良、余分な指、欠けた指、手足の融合、氷の浮遊、不自然な重力、誤った遠近法、光源と矛盾する影、文字化け、透かし、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌。

夏らしいノースリーブの青いワンピース。背中は深めに開き、細いリボンが首元と背中で結ばれている。ウエストは軽く絞られ、細かなプリーツが腰から放射状に広がる。人物自身の左腕は画面左へゆるく伸ばし、右腕は画面右後方へ流す。指先は軽く開き、布の端に触れるか触れないかの自然な距離感。身体は背中を見せながら半回転し、重心は片足に乗っている。

背景・光：
明るい夏の草原。前景には風で揺れる緑と淡い金色の草、中景にゆるやかな丘、後景に低い山並みと小さな町の気配。空は澄んだ青で、白い入道雲が数個浮かぶ。太陽は左上からやや強く差し、肩、腕、頬、ドレスのプリーツの稜線に明るいハイライトを作る。影は右下へ落ち、青い布には草原からの柔らかな反射光が入る。

構図・カメラ：
ローアングルに近い目線で、人物を少し見上げる構図。広い青空を上部に大きく残し、ドレスの円形の動きが画面中央の主役になる。焦点は人物の顔と背中のリボン周辺に合わせ、前景の草と遠くの山は浅めの被写界深度でやわらかくぼかす。85mm相当、自然な圧縮感、夏の日差しを感じるクリアな写り。

プロ用カメラで撮影したようなリアルフォト。青い薄布は半透明で、プリーツの細い線、重なった部分の濃淡、風を含んだ軽さが見える。肌は過度に補正せず、自然な肌理を残す。色は青空、青いドレス、緑の草原、白い雲のコントラストを生かし、爽やかで清潔な夏の写真表現。

ネガティブ：
不自然な顔、不自然な視線、余分な指、欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、布と手の接触不良、浮遊、不自然な重力、誤った遠近法、光源と矛盾する影、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌。

cases.prompt:
Create the fourth poster in a unified campaign series for Lululemon Athletica, preserving the same high-impact fashion-sport street poster DNA while changing the main color palette to a fresh coral orange, mint teal, cream white, and soft warm peach combination. The image must feel hyper-real, visually explosive, youthful, avant-garde, and premium, with a strong low-angle female pose and large hand-drawn graffiti-style lettering interacting directly with the model.

Use a vertical poster composition with one healthy Western female fitness model as the hero figure, captured from a dramatic low-angle perspective looking upward. The pose should echo a bold street-dominant stance: legs wide or asymmetrically grounded, one hip shifted, torso tall, shoulders confident, head slightly tilted downward toward camera, creating a strong sense of presence and authority. The lower-body perspective should feel powerful and slightly exaggerated by the lens, with the shoes and legs visually enlarged in the foreground, while remaining anatomically correct and realistic. The model must feel athletic, stylish, and untouchably cool.

Her stance must feel physically believable and stylish, with correct leg proportions, proper foot placement, natural neck length, correct hands, and no distortion. She should project confidence, freedom, and modern street-athletic coolness.

and premium athletic sneakers.

cases.title: Lululemon Minimalist Graffiti Poster Template
cases.prompt:
Create the fifth poster in a unified campaign series for Lululemon Athletica, preserving the same bold fashion-sport poster DNA while shifting the visual system into a cleaner minimalist composition with strong hand-drawn typography interaction. The image must feel hyper-real, striking, modern, avant-garde, and premium, with one athletic female figure dominating the composition against an ultra-clean minimal background. The key visual energy must come from the interaction between the body pose and the large hand-drawn graffiti lettering wrapped around the figure.

Use a vertical poster layout with a mostly minimal clean background, like a premium studio cyclorama or soft matte paper backdrop. The background should feel spacious, controlled, and modern, with very little environmental clutter. Use a palette built around ivory white, soft warm off-white, matte black, deep emerald green, and subtle dark graphite accents. Optional tiny touches of muted coral or brushed silver may appear in very small controlled details, but emerald green must be the main new accent color.

Hero figure:
Show one healthy Western female fitness model with a sculpted athletic body, realistic anatomy, and a powerful editorial presence. Her pose should be inspired by a forward-pressing street-fashion athletic stance: one leg stepping or driving forward, one leg anchoring behind, torso leaning slightly toward camera, shoulders active, head engaged, and both hands near the hood, hair, collar, or upper head area as if she is locking into focus before movement. The pose must feel assertive, energetic, and stylish, with strong body tension and believable balance. No distorted anatomy, no awkward limbs, no exaggerated proportions.

Wardrobe and product:
Show authentic Lululemon Athletica activewear as the hero product, rendered with extreme realism and premium fabric fidelity. Use a sleek, fashion-forward training look such as:
a cropped performance top or sports bra,
a lightweight technical jacket or overshirt,
high-waisted leggings or sculpted performance bottoms,
and premium athletic sneakers.
The outfit should feature the new color system:
deep emerald green,
ivory white,
soft black,
and graphite gray.
The garments must feel unmistakably premium and technical, with clean seam construction, realistic stretch tension, elegant folds, premium matte texture, and strong product visibility.

Typography interaction:
Create oversized hand-drawn graffiti-style lettering and expressive brush-script forms that wrap around and behind the model, interacting closely with her silhouette. The letters should feel hand-painted, imperfect in an art-directed way, and integrated into the figure’s presence. Some letter strokes may frame the shoulders, curve around the torso, tuck behind the legs, or echo the line of the arms and step. The text should feel like a visual force field around the body, not a separate headline pasted on top.
Keep the lettering mostly black or dark charcoal, with selected emerald green emphasis in a few strokes, fills, underlines, or graphic hits.

Background behavior:
Keep the environment minimal and bright, with perhaps only subtle paper texture, soft studio shadow grounding, faint painterly smudges, or very restrained brush residue. Do not clutter the composition with full graffiti walls or heavy street textures. This poster should feel cleaner, more distilled, and more fashion-forward than the previous ones.

Motion and graphic accents:
Add only a few restrained visual accents such as brush flicks, ink tails, paint commas, or small abstract marks around the figure and typography. These accents should reinforce motion and editorial rhythm without overwhelming the minimalist composition.

Lighting:
Use refined premium studio lighting with clean sculptural highlights across the face, shoulders, jacket, waist, legs, and shoes. The body and clothing must feel dimensional and sharp, while the background remains soft and controlled. The lighting should emphasize realism, product quality, and the power of the pose.

Typography content:
Use English branding only.
Possible text directions:
“LULULEMON”
“ATHLETICA”
“MOVE WITH FORCE”
“FORM LEADS MOTION”
“STANCE BECOMES POWER”
Typography should feel artistic, hand-drawn, premium, and highly integrated into the composition. Include only a minimal official-style Lululemon logo if needed.

Mood:
clean, assertive, athletic, avant-garde, premium, minimalist, editorial, forward-moving, sharp, fashion-led, graphic, modern.

cases.title: Lululemon Four Panel Campaign Poster
cases.prompt:
Create the seventh poster in a unified campaign series for Lululemon Athletica, designed as a bold four-panel editorial sports poster with four different athlete characters, four distinct movement themes, minimalist backgrounds, large graphic typography, and refined hand-drawn illustrated motifs that interact narratively with each figure. The image must feel hyper-real, visually explosive, fashion-forward, and premium, while maintaining a clean structured 2x2 grid composition.

Overall layout:
Use a vertical 4-panel grid layout, divided into four equal quadrants. Each panel must feature a different athlete, a different movement posture, and a different emotional theme, but all four panels must clearly belong to the same Lululemon campaign family. The full poster should feel like a contemporary fashion-sport magazine cover system merged with avant-garde brand advertising.

Critical series rule:
All four panels must share the same visual DNA:
minimal background,
bold editorial typography,
realistic Lululemon apparel,
strong figure-to-text interaction,
fine hand-drawn motifs,
clean negative space,
and premium campaign polish.
Each panel should be unique, but the entire page must feel coherent and intentionally art-directed.

Color system:
Shift the main campaign palette to:
cobalt blue,
vivid orange,
ivory white,
graphite black,
and small accents of pale sky blue or muted warm gray.
The palette should feel fresh, youthful, energetic, and modern. Keep it cleaner and more graphic than previous versions, with the color system distributed strategically across the four panels. Avoid random extra colors.

Panel 1:
A powerful athletic female figure in a dynamic extended motion pose, such as a long stride, twist, or reach, with strong diagonals and clear body elongation. The background is minimal and bright, with oversized typography and refined hand-drawn motion streaks or directional marks interacting with the limbs and body line.

Panel 2:
A cool dominant low-angle figure, possibly standing wide or stepping toward the viewer, with exaggerated perspective and strong street-fashion athletic confidence. Large bold text should wrap around the figure and partially intersect with the body silhouette. Add subtle illustrated symbols or graphic marks that reinforce the mood of impact, strength, or balance.

Panel 3:
A jumping, landing, or mid-transition pose that captures energy, lift, and rhythm. Use airy composition, large modern text blocks, and delicate hand-drawn linework or graphic fragments that echo the athlete’s movement path. The mood should feel uplifting and highly visual.

Panel 4:
A sculptural heroic pose from a low or upward angle, with a strong arm, torso, or leg gesture, creating a final climax panel. Typography should become more immersive here, with large letters interacting with the athlete more aggressively, while fine illustrated accents add a narrative feeling of force, breath, or momentum.

Athletes:
Use a mix of healthy Western male and female athletic models with realistic anatomy, sculpted but believable physiques, and high-fashion sports presence. Every figure must feel real, modern, fit, and expressive. No influencer look. No awkward posing. No anatomy distortion. Hands, feet, neck, shoulders, knees, and proportions must all remain accurate and natural.

Wardrobe and product:
Show authentic Lululemon Athletica performance apparel in every panel, rendered with extreme realism and premium fabric fidelity. Use a mix of premium activewear pieces such as:
technical tanks,
sports bras,
lightweight performance jackets,
training tops,
tailored joggers,
leggings,
shorts,
and premium sneakers.
The garments must feel technical, luxurious, and movement-driven, with realistic folds, stretch tension, seam construction, matte performance surfaces, and strong product readability.
Distribute the new cobalt-blue and vivid-orange palette across the styling, balanced with black, ivory, and graphite.

Typography:
Typography is a major visual force across the entire poster.
Use oversized English editorial words and phrases integrated deeply into each panel, with letters partially behind, beside, or around the athletes.
Possible text directions:
“LULULEMON”
“ATHLETICA”
“MOVE LOUD”
“FORM IN MOTION”
“POWER TAKES SPACE”
“STRETCH THE FRAME”
Typography should be bold, modern, artistic, and premium, with strong hierarchy and dynamic placement.
No crude fonts.
No generic sports-ad copy.

Illustration and narrative interaction:
Add fine hand-drawn graphic elements in each panel, carefully matched to the movement theme. These can include:
motion arcs,
energy streaks,
wind lines,
symbolic wave forms,
abstract petals,
graphic sparks,
curved calligraphic swirls,
or subtle narrative motifs.
These drawn elements must interact with the figures and text, helping each panel tell a mini story of motion, power, breath, rhythm, or control.
Keep them refined and integrated, not cartoonish or decorative for decoration’s sake.

Background:
Each panel should have a minimal background with slight tonal variation, clean sky-like or studio-like openness, or lightly textured flat fields. Do not create cluttered environments. The emphasis must stay on the athlete, the apparel, the type, and the hand-drawn graphic storytelling.

Lighting:
Use bright premium editorial lighting with strong clarity on the athletes and garments. The light should sculpt muscles, posture, fabric detail, and footwear while preserving a clean graphic read. Each panel can have slightly different light mood, but all must remain within the same premium campaign system.

Mood:
explosive, athletic, youthful, avant-garde, editorial, premium, modern, graphic, high-energy, sharply designed, fashion-forward.

Create the eighth poster in a unified campaign series for Lululemon Athletica, designed as a bold six-panel editorial campaign board with six different athlete characters, six distinct movement themes, minimalist solid-color backgrounds, large expressive typography, and refined hand-drawn narrative graphics interacting with each figure. The composition must feel hyper-real, visually explosive, youthful, fashion-forward, and premium, with each panel functioning as its own mini poster while still belonging to one unified Lululemon campaign system.

Overall layout:
Use a 2x3 six-panel grid layout, with six equal vertical poster-like tiles arranged in a clean campaign board. Each panel must feature a different athlete, a different movement posture, and a distinct emotional or thematic direction. All six panels must clearly belong to the same visual family through shared typography style, graphic treatment, realism level, product styling, and campaign polish.

Critical series rule:
Every panel must maintain the same core DNA:
minimal solid-color background,
hyper-real Lululemon apparel,
strong athlete-to-text interaction,
fine hand-drawn graphic motifs,
clean visual hierarchy,
editorial fashion-sport energy,
and premium advertising finish.
Each panel should feel unique, but the set must read instantly as one coherent campaign board.

Color system:
Shift the main palette into a bold multi-color matrix built from:
acid teal,
coral orange,
cream yellow,
powder red,
electric sky blue,
and warm poppy orange.
Important rule:
each individual panel should use one dominant pure-color background, not a mixed environment.
The six panels should feel color-blocked, clean, modern, and visually punchy.
Avoid dirty gradients or cluttered environments.

Athletes:
Use a mix of healthy Western male and female athletic models with realistic anatomy, sculpted but believable physiques, and strong editorial presence. Each athlete should have a different movement identity and emotional tone, such as:
stretch,
jump,
twist,
lunge,
stance,
reach,
turn,
landing,
or balance-based athletic control.
All poses must feel dynamic, strong, and physically believable.
No distorted anatomy, no awkward joints, no weak stance, no influencer-style posing.

Panel content direction:

A strong female athlete in a sharp side-step or forward athletic stance, with bold type behind and subtle hand-drawn directional marks, suggesting intention and control.

Panel 2:

Panel 3:
A low, grounded, dominant power pose with a more confrontational stance, strong large lettering, and compact graphic accents that heighten intensity.

Panel 4:
A lifted, open, expansive movement such as a jump, leap, or wide extension, with airy type placement and graphic motifs that suggest breath, release, and upward energy.

Panel 5:
A composed central stance with a quieter but stronger portrait-energy feeling, where the figure interacts with dense layered typography and more refined symbolic linework.

Panel 6:
A final action-driven panel with forward rhythm and motion, using larger text overlap and more dramatic illustrated marks to complete the series with energy.

Show authentic Lululemon Athletica performance apparel in every panel, rendered with extreme realism and premium fabric fidelity. Use a range of elevated activewear pieces such as:

leggings,
bike shorts,
tailored joggers,
performance sneakers,
and lightweight layers.
The garments must feel premium, technical, and highly wearable, with refined seam construction, realistic stretch tension, elegant folds, and clear product visibility.
Distribute the multi-color palette across the clothing in a controlled way, balancing with black, white, cream, or graphite neutrals where needed.

Typography:
Typography must be a major visual force in each panel.
Use oversized English words, phrases, or cropped letterforms integrated into the figures and backgrounds.

Typography should feel bold, contemporary, editorial, and premium, with dynamic overlap and strong hierarchy.
No crude fonts. No generic gym-ad text.

Illustration and narrative graphics:
Add fine hand-drawn thematic graphics in each panel, matched to the athlete’s action and emotional tone. These may include:
motion arcs,
impact marks,
breath lines,
symbolic petals,
speed fragments,
graphic sparks,
wave forms,
calligraphic swirls,
or directional line systems.
These illustrated elements must interact with the athlete and text, helping each panel tell a mini story of movement, energy, discipline, release, or control.
Keep them refined and intentional, not cartoonish.

Background:
Each panel must use a clean pure-color background with only minimal texture or very subtle grain. No full environments, no cluttered scenes. The focus is on the athlete, apparel, typography, and hand-drawn narrative interaction.

Lighting:
Use bright premium editorial lighting with strong clarity on the athlete, posture, and apparel in every panel. The lighting should be clean, sculptural, and campaign-consistent, helping each figure feel hyper-real against the flat color background.

explosive, athletic, youthful, graphic, premium, avant-garde, editorial, energetic, modern, clean, high-impact, fashion-forward.

Overall layout:
Use a vertical poster composition divided into two major sections:
a large horizontal hero banner occupying the upper or central dominant area,
and six smaller rectangular panels arranged below or around it in a clean, rule-based grid system.
The composition must feel organized, rhythmic, and premium, like a complete seasonal campaign presentation rather than a random collage.

Critical layout rule:
The hero banner is the main visual anchor and must dominate the board.
The six smaller panels must feel like supporting campaign modules, each with its own motion theme, but all must clearly belong to the same Lululemon visual family.
The overall board must feel consistent, intentional, and highly art-directed.

Color system:
Shift the palette into a refined fashion-forward system built around:
cool pink-lilac,
powder lavender,
ivory white,
deep charcoal black,
and small controlled accents of soft berry or silver-gray.
The whole composition should feel cleaner, more elevated, and more contemporary than previous versions.
Each panel can vary slightly in tone, but the full board must maintain one unified color family.

Hero banner:
Create one large dominant hero panel featuring a healthy Western female athletic model as the main campaign face. She should have realistic anatomy, a strong fit physique, modern facial structure, and a poised editorial presence.

Show authentic Lululemon Athletica apparel with premium realism, strong fabric clarity, and commercial readability.

a female athlete in a stretch or seated active pose,
a crouched or low stance action pose,
a standing balance pose,
a detail-driven footwear or apparel emphasis panel,
a motion-focused dynamic panel,
and a more product-centric or slogan-focused panel.
Each tile should still include either a real athlete, a Lululemon product focus, or both.
Each one must feel clean, premium, and visually distinct while following the same system.

technical jackets,
cropped training tops,
leggings,
performance joggers,
shorts,
lightweight layers,
sneakers,

All products must feel premium, technical, and highly wearable, with realistic folds, stretch tension, seam precision, matte performance surfaces, and strong brand clarity.

Typography:
Typography is a major storytelling device in both the hero banner and the six small panels.
Use large modern English words and phrases, with refined hierarchy and strong editorial placement.
Possible text directions:
“LULULEMON”
“ATHLETICA”
“FORM LEADS FORCE”
“MOTION HOLDS SHAPE”
“MOVE WITH CLARITY”
“STRUCTURE IN FLOW”
“POWER, ARRANGED”

brush underlines,
motion curves,
small symbolic marks,
calligraphic linework,
graphic loops,
subtle drawn accents,
or thematic illustration fragments.
The drawn elements must feel purposeful and integrated into the layout, supporting the theme of movement, control, rhythm, and discipline.
Keep them elegant and story-driven, not decorative clutter.

Background:
Each panel should use a minimal pure-color or very soft gradient-flat background, keeping the board highly structured and contemporary. No realistic scenery, no busy environment, no rough walls. The energy must come from the figure, product, typography, and narrative drawing.

Lighting:
Use bright premium editorial lighting across the entire board. Each figure and product should feel hyper-real, crisp, and premium against the clean color fields. Maintain campaign consistency in lighting quality even if the panel compositions vary.

structured, premium, athletic, fashion-forward, contemporary, graphic, editorial, youthful, disciplined, high-impact, polished, intelligently designed.

cases.title: New Balance 2002R Desert Journal Poster
cases.prompt:
Create an ultra-premium editorial campaign poster for New Balance 2002R in a “Desert Trail Journal” direction, blending hyper-real outdoor travel photography with expressive hand-drawn exploration notes. The image must feel bold, adventurous, sun-washed, emotionally free, and intelligently designed, transforming a female backpacker journey across desert trails into a premium visual field journal centered on the New Balance 2002R. The final result should look like a world-class New Balance campaign poster, not a generic hiking ad or scrapbook collage.

Core concept:
The hero concept is a real female backpacker crossing a vast desert trail landscape, wearing authentic New Balance 2002R as the key product focus, while the image is layered with elegant hand-drawn journey records, route notes, symbols, and field-journal annotations. The scene should communicate freedom, endurance, discovery, and long-distance movement. The shoe must remain clearly visible, tactile, and important, while the illustrated note system expands the emotional narrative of the journey.

Composition:
Use a vertical poster layout with a strong central or slightly off-center composition. Place a healthy athletic Western female backpacker standing or walking on a desert trail, canyon edge, dry ridge path, or open sandy route, creating a strong feeling of distance and exploration. Her posture should feel natural, self-possessed, and quietly determined, as if she has paused during a long journey to scan the horizon.
The New Balance 2002R must be clearly visible on her feet, rendered with strong product realism and enough presence to remain the visual anchor. Surround the scene with clean white or sun-faded chalk-like hand-drawn journal graphics across the sky, side margins, and open ground areas: route arrows, mileage counts, elevation notes, mini map fragments, desert symbols, camp icons, weather marks, handwritten observations, coordinates, and trail marks. The composition should feel rich and immersive, but still premium and beautifully controlled.

Product realism:
Render the New Balance 2002R with absolute realism and exact brand fidelity:
premium suede overlays,
technical mesh underlays,
layered retro-running structure,
iconic oversized N logo,
precise heel support geometry,
refined stitching,
segmented cushioning language,
real outsole depth,
and authentic New Balance 2002R proportions.
The shoe must feel tactile, expensive, and physically real, with believable suede nap, breathable mesh texture, subtle desert dust traces, and natural tonal separation. It must remain unmistakably New Balance 2002R, never generic trail footwear.

Backpacker direction:
Use a healthy athletic Western female model with natural editorial beauty, strong posture, and a non-influencer face. She should feel capable, independent, and sun-weathered in a refined way. Style her in premium lightweight travel gear: a technical backpack, fitted performance layers, breathable trail pants or shorts, a minimal utility jacket or shirt, and clean functional accessories.
Her expression should feel thoughtful, calm, and driven by curiosity. She should look like a real long-distance traveler elevated into a premium campaign image.

Hand-drawn record language:
Integrate expressive, clean, spontaneous hand-drawn field-journal graphics as if documenting the journey across the desert in real time. Include:
mileage counts,
route lines,
mini maps,
elevation notes,
sun icons,
wind symbols,
tent sketches,
distance marks,
handwritten observations,
coordinate notations,
and directional arrows.
The linework should feel fast, intelligent, natural, and premium, like a travel notebook mixed with design sketches. Keep the marks clean and stylish, never childish or chaotic.

Environment:
Set the scene in a real desert-trail environment with open sky, weathered rock, dry ridges, sand-toned earth, canyon edges, dusty trails, and distant layered landforms. The environment should feel expansive, cinematic, and physically believable, with enough negative space to support the hand-drawn record system. Avoid clutter. The landscape should communicate openness, heat, resilience, and long-distance movement.

Typography:
Use only elegant English typography with a strong premium editorial hierarchy.
Possible title directions:
“NEW BALANCE 2002R”
“DESERT TRAIL JOURNAL”
“RECORDED IN MOTION”
“DISTANCE / DUST / DIRECTION”
“WORN ACROSS THE HORIZON”
Typography should be minimal, official, and intelligently placed, working together with the hand-drawn note system. The main title should feel clean and modern, while supporting lines remain restrained and editorial.

Brand coding:
Preserve New Balance identity through:
authentic movement heritage,
quiet performance,
material honesty,
all-day comfort,
outdoor adaptability,
and understated confidence.
The poster should communicate that New Balance 2002R is a trusted companion for meaningful travel and real-world exploration.

Lighting:
Use exquisitely soft natural desert light with refined cinematic polish. The light should feel warm but controlled, with delicate highlights on the shoe, skin, backpack, and dry landscape surfaces. Shadows should remain smooth, soft, and elegant. The overall image should feel breathable, tactile, and emotionally expansive, with the product remaining the sharpest and most desirable object.

Color direction:
Use a premium desert-travel palette built around:
sand beige,
sun-bleached ivory,
clay brown,
faded sky blue,
weathered stone grey,
and muted silver-grey.
Allow the hand-drawn notes to appear in crisp white or chalk-white so they float clearly over the warm environment. The final palette should feel sun-washed, exploratory, elevated, and globally premium.

Mood:
free, adventurous, documentary, premium, open, tactile, exploratory, emotionally grounded, sun-washed, intelligent, quietly bold, long-distance, travel-driven.

cases.title: Japanese Summer Girl Reaching For Sky
cases.imageAlt: Japanese Summer Girl Reaching For Sky
cases.prompt:
主題：
青空をつかむ指

主体：
真夏の日本の住宅街で、20代の成人女性が地面近くまで腰を落とし、両手をカメラへ大きく伸ばしている。人物は画面中央やや右に配置し、上半身が画面の約4割。画面左下には曲げた膝、左上には極端に大きく写る手を置き、澄んだ青空を広く見せる。

人物・表情：
自然な日系の顔立ち。黒髪を高めの小さなお団子にまとめ、薄いシースルーバングと頬に沿う後れ毛を残す。淡いピンクのチーク、繊細なブラウンのアイメイク、自然な涙袋、透け感のあるコーラルピンクのリップ。顔をわずかに下へ傾け、片目を閉じてウインクし、もう片方の目はレンズを見る。口元は力を抜いた静かな表情。

服装・ポーズ：
白い細リブ素材のショート丈キャミソールに、薄手の白いレースカーディガンを肩からゆるく落として重ねる。ボトムは淡いブルーのハイウエストデニムショートパンツ。人物自身の右腕を画面左上へ伸ばし、手のひらをレンズ直前まで近づけ、親指と人差し指を大きく開く。人物自身の左手は画面右下から差し出し、手のひらを上向きにして指を自然に広げる。両膝を曲げた低い姿勢で、身体の重心は後方。

背景・光：
夏の昼下がりの日本の静かな住宅街。低い戸建て、コンクリート塀、街路樹、電柱、細い電線が奥へ続く。看板文字は小さくぼかし、読めない状態にする。背景の約半分以上を鮮やかな青空と少量の白い雲が占める。強い太陽光が画面左上から差し、顔、肩、腕、膝の上面を明るく照らす。影は右下へ落ち、地面と白い服に青空の冷たい反射光が入る。

構図・カメラ：
縦4:5。地面すれすれの超ローアングルから見上げる超広角撮影。カメラに最も近い右手を画面左上で巨大に写し、遠近感を大胆に誇張する。もう一方の手は画面右下、顔は中央右、左膝は左下に配置。上部には広い青空の余白を残す。顔と手にピントを合わせ、住宅街の奥行きは軽くぼかす。

質感・スタイル：
夏の日差しを感じるリアルなスナップ写真。自然な肌理、細かな産毛、布の編み目、デニムの繊維を残す。明るく爽やかな発色、やや高めのコントラスト、青空は深いコバルトブルー。過度な美肌補正を避け、広角レンズ特有の大胆な遠近感と、偶然撮れたような躍動感を持たせる。

ネガティブ：
未成年に見える人物、不自然な顔、不自然な視線、余分な指、欠けた指、融合した手、左右の手の混同、関節の破綻、手のひらの変形、不自然な重力、誤った遠近法、衣服の崩れ、光源と矛盾する影、読める文字、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌。

cases.title: Woman Walking to Cloud Castle

主題：
雲城への一歩

主体：
縦長4:5。青い海を望む防波堤の上で、クリーム色のキャリーケースを引きながら片脚を前へ伸ばす女性を、画面下部中央やや左に配置する。人物とスーツケースを合わせて画面高の約35％。上部約65％は空と巨大な雲の城に使い、開放感を強く残す。

自然で現実感のある女性。やわらかなブラウンの髪を低めのポニーテールにまとめ、前髪と後れ毛が海風で右方向へなびく。顔はやや画面側へ向け、穏やかで控えめな微笑み。視線は遠くの空と海の間に向ける。

背景・光：
水平線の低い穏やかな青い海。遠景には小さな船影を数隻だけ置く。空には巨大な積乱雲が広がり、その上部が独創的な空中城の形へ自然につながる。城は細長い塔、丸い塔、雲の回廊、橋、半透明の尖塔が混ざる非対称構成。童話的だが特定作品を想起させないオリジナルデザイン。建築物そのものではなく、白い雲の密度と陰影で城の輪郭が浮かび上がる。昼の強い太陽光が画面左上から差し、人物の左肩、頬、スカート、ケース上面を明るく照らす。影は右下へ短く落ち、海面から淡い青い反射光が人物の下半身を補う。

構図・カメラ：
低めの目線からの全身写真。85mm相当の軽い圧縮感。人物は画面下1/3、雲城は中央上部に大きく配置。人物の頭上から城まで十分な空間を保ち、城の最上部は画面上端から少し余白を残す。防波堤は最下部を横切る水平線として描き、海面と空の境界は人物の腰より少し下。人物とスーツケースに明確に合焦し、遠景の船のみ軽くぼかす。

不自然な顔、不自然な視線、余分な指、欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、脚の長さの不一致、スーツケースとの接触不良、浮遊、不自然な重力、誤った遠近法、光源と矛盾する影、城の左右対称化、実在作品に酷似した城、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌。

cases.prompt:
主題：
湯気の向こう

主体：
縦長2:3。小さな日本のキッチンで、若い女性が窓際の丸い木製スツールに座り、カップ麺を食べている。人物は画面中央やや右を占め、頭から太ももまでを大きく写す。曲げた両膝が下半分の前景をつくり、カップ麺は胸元の中央、箸と垂れた麺が顔へ視線を導く。

人物・表情：
自然で若々しい雰囲気の女性。明るいアイボリーベージュの肌に、頬と鼻先へ淡い血色を残し、毛穴や細かな肌理が見える現実的な質感。ローズピンクのチーク、ピンクブラウンのアイメイク、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、柔らかなブラウン眉、透け感のあるピンクベージュの唇。麺を少し口に含んだ瞬間に動きを止め、大きな瞳で静かにカメラを見る。

服装・ポーズ：
明るいミルクティーアッシュブラウンのミディアムロング。薄いシースルーバングと顔まわりのレイヤー、毛先はゆるい内巻きと自然な波を混ぜ、耳の後ろへ一部だけ流す。細い髪の束、柔らかなツヤ、窓光を受けた金色のハイライトを描く。服はアイボリーの細い肩紐のリブキャミソールと、軽いコットン素材のショートパンツ。本人の右手で木の箸を持ち、左手でカップを包む。両膝を胸元へ寄せ、狭い椅子の上で身体を小さくまとめる。

背景・光：
昭和の面影を少し残した、生活感のある日本の小さなキッチン。画面左にステンレスのガスコンロと白いケトル、木製カウンター。右奥に大きな窓、鉢植え、花瓶、布巾。棚や瓶は適度にぼかし、文字は読めない程度にする。主光は画面右上の窓から入る夏の自然光。髪、頬、肩、膝の右側に柔らかなハイライトをつくり、左側には青緑を含む穏やかな影を落とす。

構図・カメラ：
35mm相当、人物との距離が近い日常スナップ。目線よりわずかに高い位置から軽く見下ろす。顔とカップ麺に焦点を合わせ、背景は浅く自然にぼかす。窓の白飛びは完全には消さず、フィルムらしい柔らかなハレーションを残す。上部は窓と髪のための小さな余白、左右はキッチンの狭さが伝わる程度に詰める。

質感・スタイル：
富士フイルムのカメラで撮影した35mmカラーネガ写真のような質感。クラシックネガに近い落ち着いた発色、少し褪せたクリーム色、青緑を含む影、温かい肌色。細かなフィルム粒子、わずかな色むら、ハイライトのにじみ、低めのデジタルシャープネス。作り込まれた広告写真ではなく、夏の日常を偶然切り取った自然な写真。

過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌、CG感、アニメ調、不自然な顔、不自然な視線、余分な指、欠けた指、箸の変形、麺と口の接触不良、浮いたカップ、関節の破綻、極端な脚の変形、光源と矛盾する影、強すぎるHDR、過剰なボケ、読める商品名、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし。

cases.prompt:
主題：
雲を数える手

主体：
縦長4:5の写真風ポートレート。明るい夏空の下、都会のマンション屋上で、自然な雰囲気の女性が白い手すりにもたれて立っている。人物は画面中央やや下寄り、上半身から膝上までが入り、画面上部の約半分以上は青空の広い余白にする。

人物・表情：
短めのダークブラウンのボブヘア。薄い前髪と顔まわりの髪が風で軽く横へ流れている。目を閉じ、口元は力を抜いた静かな表情。頬に自然な血色と小さなハイライトがあり、清潔感のある日系メイク。顔はわずかに下を向き、まぶしい夏の日差しを受け止めているような穏やかな印象。

服装・ポーズ：
白いノースリーブの夏ブラウス。胸元に細かなピンタック、袖口に控えめなレース、薄手コットンの軽い透け感。下は赤みのあるテラコッタカラーのハイウエストスカート。両肘を手すりの内側に近づけ、両手を前に垂らす。人物自身の左右の指先は自然にゆるく曲がり、手すりの上で重力に沿って落ちる。肩と首まわりは脱力して、風を受けて髪と服の端だけが少し揺れている。

背景・光：
背景は都市部の低層マンション群が遠くにぼけて見える屋上。空は明るい水色で、上空に小さな自然な白い雲が数個だけ浮かぶ。物干し竿、洗濯物、浮遊する服、人工的な雲の塊は入れない。主光は画面左上からの強めの夏の日差し。顔、肩、ブラウスの上面が明るく照らされ、手すりとスカートにくっきりした影が落ちる。反射光は白い壁と手すりから柔らかく返る。

構図・カメラ：
カメラは胸の高さより少し低めの正面寄り。中望遠レンズで背景を浅くぼかし、人物の顔、髪、手、服の質感に焦点を合わせる。人物の頭上には大きな空の余白を残し、下端はスカートの途中で自然に切る。手すりの水平線を画面下3分の1付近に置き、静かな安定感を出す。

質感・スタイル：
リアルな写真表現。透明感のある夏の空気、自然な肌理、薄手コットンの繊維、白い手すりの微細なざらつき、スカートの柔らかなシワを丁寧に描写。色は白、青、テラコッタを中心に、明るく清潔な日系フィルム写真のような淡いコントラスト。過度に加工せず、自然光のポートレートとして仕上げる。

ネガティブ：
不自然な顔、不自然な視線、余分な指、欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、手すりとの接触不良、浮遊物、不自然な重力、誤った遠近法、光源と矛盾する影、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌。

cases.title: Kung Fu Action Storyboard Template
cases.prompt:
Create a raw kung fu performance storyboard focused on extreme physical action. Use reference image for the character.

16:9 storyboard sheet, 12 cinematic panels. The actual storyboard drawings must be black and white only: rough pencil lines, minimal detail, fast gesture drawing energy, simple anatomy construction and strong silhouette readability. Keep the artwork lightweight, dynamic and unfinished like early fight choreography previs.

Start directly in action. Do not begin with a calm stance, preparation shot or slow introduction.

A solitary female performer executes an aggressive Tibetan kung fu master-style routine inside a vast ancient temple. The choreography is exaggerated, explosive and constantly escalating: flying diagonal kicks, monk-style low stances, rapid palm strikes, spinning cloth-like body turns, animal-form hand shapes, deep lunges, aerial twists, floor-level sweeps, sudden drops, claw-like blocks, back-arched jumps, sliding recoveries and violent sculptural impact poses.

Every panel must contain visible motion and strong body momentum. Avoid static standing poses. The performer should feel like a ritual warrior moving with discipline, fury, spiritual pressure and total body control.

Action progression:

1. begin mid-air with a flying diagonal kick already in motion

2. handheld close-up palm sweep cutting through air

3. orbiting wide shot of a full-body spin

4. low-angle impact palm strike with shockwave

5. long-lens side profile spinning kick

6. top-down aerial turn with body, hair and fabric flaring outward

7. hard floor stomp cracking the temple stone

8. sliding low sweep across the floor

9. aggressive close-up flurry of elbows, palms and backfist strikes

10. extreme low monk-style beast stance with energy rising

11. spinning elemental vortex around the body

12. final airborne action pose, suspended above the temple floor, body twisted in a powerful kung fu strike, all elements converging around her before impact

Add selective elemental energy effects as VFX-style storyboard accents. The effects should feel spiritual, ritualistic and cinematic, not superhero-like:
air bursts around spins and flying kicks,
dust and stone fragments lifting from stomps,
water-like floor ripples during slides,
fire-like trails around explosive strikes,
heat distortion around high-intensity movement,
elemental vortex near the climax.

Element progression:
early panels: subtle wind, dust and pressure lines
middle panels: stronger stone fragments, floor ripples and air shockwaves
late panels: controlled fire trails and energy spirals
final panel: the strongest combined elemental surge while the performer is still airborne

Use cinematic arthouse action camerawork:
handheld energy,
whip-pan feeling,
orbiting camera moves,
overhead shots,
side silhouettes,
aggressive close-ups,
long-lens compression,
extreme low angles,
wide negative space,
strong parallax.

Keep the temple environment minimal and atmospheric:
towering stone columns,
worn temple floor,
drifting incense smoke,
hanging fabric,
harsh light shafts,
faint dust in the air,
subtle wet floor reflections.
Do not overcrowd the frames.

Annotation color system:
red arrows = body movement
blue arrows = camera movement
green marks = framing / composition notes
orange marks = lighting direction
yellow marks = elemental VFX / energy effects
black text = short lens notes and panel labels

No timestamps. No dialogue. No singing. No extra characters. No enemies. No logos. No watermark.

cases.title: Premium Paintbrush Chameleon Ad Poster
cases.prompt:
Create an ultra-premium editorial advertising poster for Dulux, centered on one oversized hyper-real paintbrush as the absolute hero object, combined with a real animal interacting playfully and naturally with the brush. The image must feel minimalist, witty, visually striking, and highly premium, with a pure-color background, refined typography, and strong product-led composition. The final result should look like a world-class Dulux campaign poster where the animal and paint become one elegant visual idea.

Core concept:
The hero composition features a giant realistic paintbrush standing vertically in the center of the frame. A hyper-real chameleon clings naturally around the brush handle and bristle area, using its body to create the central visual metaphor of color transformation. The animal must feel completely real and tactile, while its body color transitions smoothly from its natural vivid green tones near the top into rich Dulux blue tones near the lower body and tail, as if the paint has transformed or inspired its coloration. The image should feel intelligent, playful, clean, and premium.

Composition:
Use a vertical luxury poster layout with a pure light neutral background. Place one oversized paintbrush centrally with strong clean negative space around it. The chameleon should wrap itself around the brush in a graceful, believable pose, with its claws gripping the handle and ferrule, and its tail curling elegantly around the lower section. The lower bristles should be dipped into glossy rich paint, with a few perfectly controlled drips falling downward. The overall composition must be calm, graphic, iconic, and immediately readable.

Product realism:
Render the paintbrush with absolute realism:
natural wood handle,
premium metallic ferrule,
fine realistic bristle texture,
glossy wet paint coating,
clean paint weight and viscosity,
and believable paint drips.
The brush must feel like a premium painter’s tool, tactile and physically grounded.

Animal realism:
Render the chameleon with extreme realism and fine biological detail:
sharp textured scales,
subtle skin translucency,
clear eye structure,
natural grip tension in the claws,
realistic musculature,
and elegant tail curvature.
The animal must feel alive and captivating, not cartoonish. Its pose should be calm and confident, as if it belongs on the brush.

Color transformation logic:
The color change across the animal must be the key visual story. Preserve realistic chameleon patterning while allowing a graceful transition from natural greens and warm accents into Dulux-inspired blue paint tones. The transition should feel smooth and intelligent, not artificial. The lower body and tail may reflect stronger paint influence, visually tying the animal to the dipped brush and the paint below.

Paint treatment:
Use extremely clean, premium paint behavior. The paint should be rich, glossy, and thick, coating the lower bristles with luxurious realism. Add only a few perfectly shaped drips to keep the composition elegant. The paint must connect visually with the animal’s color transformation, suggesting creativity, reinvention, and joy in color.

Background:
Use a clean pure-color or soft warm-neutral background with no clutter. The background should feel premium and spacious, allowing the brush, animal, and paint to dominate fully. Keep the field minimal and smooth, with subtle tonal refinement only.

Typography:

Suggested text direction:

“COLOR, NATURALLY.”
Chinese subtitle:
“色彩，自然发生”
Supporting English copy:
“Real color changes everything.”
Typography should be sparse, modern, and premium, placed with generous spacing and never competing with the central image.

premium paint-tool realism,
confident use of color,
clean global advertising polish,
minimal composition,
and a clear branded product packshot in the lower corner.
Include a hyper-real Dulux paint can or bucket in a restrained lower corner placement, with clean logo visibility and balanced scale.

Lighting:
Use soft studio-quality lighting with refined highlights on the chameleon scales, brush ferrule, paint gloss, and wood texture. The lighting must feel clean, controlled, and luxurious, with no harsh shadows and no visual mess.

Mood:
playful, premium, clean, intelligent, striking, elegant, tactile, globally branded, minimalist, fresh

BRAND INTELLIGENCE

1. PRIMARY COLOR
Soft pastel ASICS blue (#7FADEB style) used as the main lettering fill while remaining instantly recognizable.

2. ACCENT COLOR
Warm saturated coral-orange inspired by performance running details for speed lines and graphic accents.

3. DARK COLOR
Deep navy (#1D2C5B style) used for all outlines, extrusions, typography strokes, sparkle, and structural elements.

4. LETTERING
Large bold lowercase:
asics

Use a wide rounded geometric font.
Flat pastel blue fill.
Heavy dark navy outline.
Dark navy extrusion offset diagonally down-right approximately 10% of the letter height.
No gradients.

5. KATAKANA
Small secondary typography:
アシックス

Neatly tucked into the composition in dark navy.

6. FLAG
Small flat Japanese flag naturally integrated into the badge.

7. ICONIC GEOMETRY
Design the badge using shapes inspired by:
• sweeping ASICS stripe curves
• flowing running-track arcs
• dynamic motion ribbons
• athletic lane geometry
• intersecting speed curves

Avoid generic circles or plain ovals unless transformed into running-inspired forms.

8. ICONIC SYMBOLS
Include 1–2 tiny flat illustrations:
• running shoe
• stopwatch or finish-line ribbon

Do NOT use the ASICS logo as a decorative object.

9. LAYOUT
Invent an original badge silhouette based on athletic movement.
The lettering should be the anchor while curved speed-track geometry wraps around it.
One curved element must pass behind the letters and emerge in front to create layered depth.
Every surrounding shape should reinforce speed, balance, and Japanese sports heritage.

CANVAS
1:1 square.
Flat warm off-white background.
No texture.
No paper grain.
No gradient.

STRUCTURE
Must include:
• Central "asics" lettering

• One element weaving behind and in front of the letters
• Unified sticker/patch silhouette

Y2K DETAILS
• Parallel or radial speed lines in coral-orange

• Small "アシックス"
• Small Japanese flag
• Tiny running shoe and stopwatch illustrations

RULES
Flat vector only.
No gradients.
No shadows.
No blur.
No lighting effects.
Maximum four colors:
• Pastel ASICS blue
• Saturated coral-orange
• Deep navy
• Warm off-white
